## T07. Common-divisor cancellation with the actual prime marks

**Status: PROVED RELATIVE TO the inherited physical inputs; the sharper versions also use the explicitly imported all-finite-order Hecke strip I-HECKE.** They do not follow from a Riemann-zeta-only premise. Sources: SA Parts IV–V, CC1–CC40 and PM1–PM19. The original common-core mechanism occurs in inherited SG §8; the new scope here is the full physical compensator.

For \(G\ge1\) and a fixed smooth annular \(w\), localize the *true squarefree-core gcd*:
\[
 \mathcal C(G)=\sum_{c\ne c'}w(q_{(c,c')}/G)\langle S_c,S_{c'}\rangle.
 \tag{T07.1}
\]
For every \(\epsilon>0\), the following upper bounds hold, with \(Y^{-1}\mathcal F_AZ^\epsilon\) suppressed:

| Assumptions on the marks and analytic input | Bound for \(|\mathcal C(G)|/(Y^{-1}\mathcal F_AZ^\epsilon)\) |
|---|---:|
| Absolute core counting, original mark envelope | \(ZL/G\) |
| Bounded marks in the original slots; ordinary smooth character Poisson | \(Z^{3/2}L^{5/2}/G^2\) |
| Bounded marks in those slots; I-HECKE | \(Z^{1+b_0/2}L^{3-b_0/2}/G^2\) |
| **Actual smooth product prime weights**; I-HECKE | \(Z^{1+b_0/2}L^{1+3b_0/2}/G^2\) |

The limiting exponents in the last two rows mean arbitrary-loss estimates obtained on fixed buffered lines. No contour passes along \(\Re s=b_0/2\).

### 1. The coupled character survives all mixed embeddings

For two branches write
\[
 D=G_*d,\quad E=G_*e,\quad(d,e)=1,
 \quad m'=[D,E]^2r,
 \quad c=gu,\quad c'=gv,
\]
where \(g,u,v\) are pairwise coprime squarefree cores and \(u\ne v\). The original rows are \(e^2r,d^2r\). The cubic Gauss cocycle and row characters give, respectively,
\[
 \gamma_2(gu)\overline{\gamma_2(gv)}
 =\gamma_2(u)\overline{\gamma_2(v)}\vartheta_g(v)\overline{\vartheta_g(u)},
\]
\[
 \chi_g(e^2r)\overline{\chi_g(d^2r)}
 =\vartheta_g(e)\overline{\vartheta_g(d)}.
\]
The angular and multiplicative core phases cancel, and the remaining quadratic-refinement phase is a fixed-ray factor by M B1.4. Consequently the moving character in \(g\) is exactly
\[
 \psi(g)=\vartheta_g(ve)\overline{\vartheta_g(ud)}, \tag{T07.2}
\]
times one of finitely many characters supported on the original fixed set. Natural zeros impose
\[
 (g,ruvde)=1,\qquad(u,e)=(v,d)=1. \tag{T07.3}
\]
These conditions imply \((ve,ud)=1\). Every good prime exponent in either product is one or two. Hence the good conductor is \(\operatorname{rad}(uvde)\), with norm \(R\ll q_uq_vq_dq_e\). Its character is nonprincipal unless all four labels are units, which would give the excluded equality \(c=c'\). A fixed-place twist cannot cancel a nontrivial good conductor. This argument is performed before row Poisson or outer-column Cauchy; the outer fields are independent of \(g\) after the finite ray split.

### 2. Squarefree sums and the two weaker cancellation bounds

The inherited smooth Poisson estimate, obtained by opening \(\mu^2(k)=\sum_{a^2\mid k}\mu(a)\), is
\[
 \sum_{k\ {\rm sf},(k,M)=1}\psi(k)W(q_k/K)
 \ll(KRq_M)^\epsilon\min(K,K^{1/2}R^{1/4}).
\]
Indeed an ordinary smooth character sum of length \(U\) is \(O(\min(U,\sqrt R))\); split the \(a\)-sum at \(q_a=\sqrt K R^{-1/4}\). Finite coprimality masks are kept during the opening and cost a subpower. For a forced squarefree divisor \(F\), substitution \(g=Fk\) therefore gives
\[
 \sum_{\substack{g\ {\rm sf},\,F\mid g\\(g,M)=1}}
 \frac{\psi(g)}{q_g}W(q_g/G)
 \ll(GRq_Mq_F)^\epsilon G^{-1/2}q_F^{-1/2}R^{1/4}. \tag{T07.4}
\]
Incompatible forced divisors give zero.

For the Hecke improvement fix \(b_0<b<1\), put \(\sigma=b/2\), and keep this choice fixed before varying scales. The inherited buffered bounds and the primitive functional equation give by three lines
\[
 |L(s,\psi)|\ll R^{(b-\Re s)/2+\epsilon}T^A,
 \qquad1-b\le\Re s\le b.
\]
Here \(\sigma\ge1-b\), since \(b>2/3\). The exact series is
\[
 \sum_{\substack{g\ {\rm sf},\,F\mid g\\(g,M)=1}}\psi(g)q_g^{-s}
 =\psi(F)q_F^{-s}\frac{L^S(s,\psi)}{L^S(2s,\psi^2)}
 \prod_{p\mid FM,\,p\notin S}(1+\psi(p)q_p^{-s})^{-1}. \tag{T07.5}
\]
Ramified factors retain value zero. The good part of \(\psi^2\) is nonprincipal; its reciprocal is bounded on \(2\sigma=b>b_0\). Finite factors are nonzero for \(\Re s>0\) and cost \((q_Fq_M)^\epsilon\). Moving the Mellin line gives
\[
 \sum_{\substack{g\ {\rm sf},\,F\mid g\\(g,M)=1}}
 \frac{\psi(g)}{q_g}W(q_g/G)
 \ll(GRq_Mq_F)^\epsilon G^{\sigma-1}q_F^{-\sigma}R^{\sigma/2}T^A.
 \tag{T07.6}
\]
This has the same form as (T07.4), with \(\sigma=1/2\) in the Poisson case.

For bounded marks, assign each marked prime first to \(g\), then to its residual core, then to its cube label. This is a disjoint assignment even when cores and cubes share primes. Forced assignments give divisibility in \(g,u,v,n,n'\); priority exclusions stay inside \(M\). After applying (T07.4) or (T07.6), ideal counting gives
\[
 \sum_{A\mid u}q_u^{-1/2+\sigma/2}E(q_u/H)
 \ll H^{(1+\sigma)/2}q_A^{-1},
\]
and the cube exponents become \(1+3(1+\sigma)/2>1\). Every distinct marked prime pays at least \(q_p^{-\sigma}\). A slot marked once therefore costs at most \(P^{1-\sigma+\epsilon}\); a slot marked on both sides costs at most \(P^{2(1-\sigma)+\epsilon}\), including its equal-prime diagonal. The completed core/cube sums have bound
\[
 G^{-2}Z^{1+\sigma}(L_DL_E)^{(3-\sigma)/2}(q_dq_e)^{\sigma/2}Z^\epsilon.
 \tag{T07.7}
\]
This proves the two weaker cancellation rows after the outer/embedding accounting in §4 below. The actual profiles used in the \(g\)-sum are the annular gcd weight times the two original \(V\)-factors. Their derivatives on \(q_g\asymp G\) have the envelope factors \(E(Gq_uq_n^3/N_D)E(Gq_vq_{n'}^3/N_E)\). Divisor losses involving arbitrarily large columns are absorbed into these envelopes, so no compact truncation of the log-Gaussian is assumed.

### 3. The extra saving from the actual prime slots

For the original smooth/fixed-character prime weights, keep the assigned-to-\(g\) primes inside the transform. Set
\[
 \mathscr S_M(s)=\frac{L^S(s,\psi)}{L^S(2s,\psi^2)}
       \prod_{p\mid M,\,p\notin S}(1+\psi(p)q_p^{-s})^{-1},
 \qquad f_s(p)=\frac{\psi(p)q_p^{-s}}{1+\psi(p)q_p^{-s}}.
\]
For \((F,M\mathfrak f_\psi)=1\), the exact forced series equals
\(\mathscr S_M(s)\prod_{p\mid F}f_s(p)\). At \(\Re s=\sigma=b/2\),
\[
 f_s(p)=\psi(p)q_p^{-s}-\psi(p)^2q_p^{-2s}+O(q_p^{-3\sigma}).
 \tag{T07.8}
\]
Both leading good characters remain nonprincipal after every fixed-place factor. The inherited prime estimate therefore gives, for a fixed smooth annular \(w\), fixed real \(\Re a\), and a deleted radical \(B\),
\[
 \sum_{p\nmid B}\eta_0(p)w(q_p/P)q_p^a f_s(p)
 \ll P^{\Re a+b-\sigma+\epsilon}(Rq_B)^\epsilon T^A.
 \tag{T07.9}
\]
To see every term: the first two powers cost \(P^{\Re a+b-j\sigma+\epsilon}\), \(j=1,2\). The remaining powers cost \(P^{\Re a+1-3\sigma+\epsilon}\), which is smaller because \(1\le2b\). Removing specified primes costs their divisor count. Thus the first potentially principal third power is paid, not suppressed.

If both sides mark the same slot, independent prime sums count a common prime twice. The *exact* correction is the single-prime sum with multiplier
\[
 f_s(p)-f_s(p)^2
 =\psi(p)q_p^{-s}-2\psi(p)^2q_p^{-2s}+O(q_p^{-3\sigma}).
 \tag{T07.10}
\]
It obeys (T07.9) with the combined norm power; since \(b-\sigma>0\), its bound fits that of the product of the two slot sums. Different slots have disjoint supports.

Fix \(u,v,n,n',r,D,E\) and a priority pattern. Marks assigned outside \(g\) have divisor-many choices, because they divide those fixed cores or cube labels. Freeze them first. Their priority exclusions enter \(M\). Marks assigned to \(g\) avoid those choices and the embedded products, and are summed with (T07.9)–(T07.10). A common prime of \(D,E\) is excluded as a *mark*, but is not deleted from \(g\) unless an original character zero requires it. A prime assigned to \(g\) on one side and outside it on the other is correctly excluded. A prime in both \(g\) and a cube label remains allowed.

For completeness, the original coupled profiles survive this step as follows. Let \(a,a'\) be their independent Mellin variables and \(z\) the variable of \(w(q_g/G)\). Replace \(z\) by the squarefree-series variable \(s=1+a+a'+z\). The transformed factor is
\[
 \widehat w(s-1-a-a')G^{s-1-a-a'}\widehat V(a)\widehat{\bar V}(a')
 (Z/(q_uq_n^3))^a(Z/(q_vq_{n'}^3))^{a'}\mathscr S_M(s),
\]
times the finite prime expressions, with \(q_U^a,q_{U'}^{a'}\) still present. Fix the real parts of \(a,a'\) first and shift only \(s\) to \(\sigma\). The two Gaussian transforms and the annular transform control all three independent heights. Choosing either sign for the fixed real parts recovers rapid envelopes in both scale ratios. It follows that the complete marked \(g\)-sum is at most
\[
 Z^\epsilon G^{\sigma-1}R^{\sigma/2}(L_DL_E)^\sigma
 E\!\left(\frac{Gq_uq_n^3}{ZL_D}\right)
 E\!\left(\frac{Gq_vq_{n'}^3}{ZL_E}\right). \tag{T07.11}
\]
No arbitrary bounded prime coefficients are covered by this argument.

Put \(\nu_*=(1+\sigma)/2\). The outside coefficients are \(q_u^{-1/2}q_v^{-1/2}/(q_nq_{n'})\), and \(R^{\sigma/2}\ll(q_uq_vq_dq_e)^{\sigma/2}\). Counting \(u,v\) and summing the cube tails gives
\[
 \frac{Z^{1+\sigma}(L_DL_E)^{1/2+3\sigma/2}(q_dq_e)^{\sigma/2}}{G^2}Z^\epsilon.
 \tag{T07.12}
\]
The power of \(G\) is exactly \((\sigma-1)-2\nu_*=-2\).

### 4. Outer fields, branch summation, and endpoint allocation

The common row Cauchy inequality, after the character transform, is
\[
 \sum_r|\xi(e^2r)\xi(d^2r)\mathcal A_{D,t}(e^2r)\mathcal A_{E,t'}(d^2r)|
 \ll Z^\epsilon\sqrt{Q_DQ_E/(Y_DY_E)}\sqrt{\mathcal F_D\mathcal F_E},
\]
where \(\mathcal F_D=1+P_a^{1/6}+q_DP_a^2/Y\). It follows by injectivity of the two row maps and (T06.7). The physical normalizations multiply this by exactly
\[
 q_D^{-3/2}q_E^{-3/2}(Q_DQ_E)^{-1/2}
 \sqrt{Q_DQ_E/(Y_DY_E)}=1/(Yq_Dq_E).
\]
Use \(L_DL_E=L^2/(P_JP_{J'})\), \(q_dq_e\le q_Dq_E\asymp P_JP_{J'}\), and \(\sqrt{\mathcal F_D\mathcal F_E}\ll\mathcal F_A\). In (T07.12) the remaining embedded-slot factor is
\((P_JP_{J'})^{-(1+2\sigma)/2}\); in (T07.7) it is \((P_JP_{J'})^{-(3-2\sigma)/2}\). Both are bounded by one. Summing \(|\omega_D|/q_D\) and \(|\omega_E|/q_E\) proves the three cancellation rows of the theorem. Absolute counting instead uses harmonic \(g\)-mass and two \(u^{-1/2}\)-counts, giving \(ZL/G\).

For the strongest Hecke estimate \(\sigma=b/2\), the ratio between the numerator at \(b>b_0\) and its displayed limit is \((ZL^3)^{(b-b_0)/2}\). If \(L\le Z^\Lambda\), choose a fixed positive \(b-b_0\) small enough in terms of the final \(\epsilon\), then allocate the remaining losses, and only then vary \(Z\). The weaker Hecke row uses the ratio \((Z/L)^{(b-b_0)/2}\), also harmless. This proves the endpoint-looking arbitrary-loss statements. ∎

### 5. The remaining small-gcd problem

The strongest bound pays a smooth dyadic tail above
\[
 \boxed{G_0=Z^{1/2+b_0/4}L^{1/2+3b_0/4}.} \tag{T07.13}
\]
At the inherited \(.12551\) geometry, \(\log_ZG_0=0.916210583782689249\ldots\). A rational buffered choice \(b=7/8\) gives \(G_0=Z^{23/32}L^{37/32}\), with exponent \(0.916253443709159867\ldots\). The earlier physical-tail thresholds were \(0.9635172364\ldots\) from ordinary Poisson and \(0.9375816697\ldots\) from the Hecke strip with absolute mark counting. These compare bounds for the same physical gcd; they do not improve or identify the different reflected quadratic-core threshold in inherited SG §10.

Choose a complementary smooth partition \(w_<+w_{\ge}=1\). The exact sufficient residual is
\[
 \boxed{\sum_{c\ne c'}w_<(q_{(c,c')})\langle S_c,S_{c'}\rangle
 \ll Y^{-1}P_a^{1/6}Z^\epsilon.} \tag{OPEN-SMALL-GCD}
\]
The bound is one-sided and concerns the actual fields. It is **UNPROVED**. The tail theorem bounds full gcd-localized covariance, not its zero and nonzero pieces separately. The global complete zero may be removed using (T06.9); a gcd truncation does not preserve positivity of that form (A15 gives a two-by-two counterexample). At \(g=1\) there is no common-divisor length in which (T07.2) can cancel. Controlling that case requires a new estimate in the remaining columns, marks, or rows. Together with T06, an estimate of this strength would complete the inherited \(.12551\) physical transfer with its original numerator, contour, fixed-family, and all-height requirements. Neither T06 nor T07 establishes it.

## T08. Two-exponent finite-incidence transfer

**Status:** proved conditional implication relative to the inherited coefficient identities, holomorphy, tail estimates, common-profile separation, and completed-current criterion. The finite mean hypothesis remains open.

Let \(\mathbf D_h(s)\) be the complete finite ray/unit/deletion orbit required by FD, with its component norm. For squarefree good \(g\), the exact extraction identity is
\[
\mathbf D_h^{(g)}(s)
=\beta(g)\vartheta_g(h)q_g^{-s}\,
 U_{g,h}\mathbf D_{gh}(s),
\]
where \(U_{g,h}\) is unitary on the finite component orbit whenever the natural character is nonzero. A shared prime of \(g,h\) makes the entire term zero. Write
\[
\mathcal T(K,G;s)=
\sum_{\substack{g\ {\rm squarefree,good}\\q_g\le G}}
\sum_{0<q_h\le K}\|\mathbf D_h^{(g)}(s)\|^2.
\]
Suppose \(u,v\ge0\), \(3u+v<1\), and, for every fixed positive central buffer \(e\), every arbitrarily small loss \(\delta>0\), and every required fixed component/deletion family,
\[
\mathcal T(K,G;\tfrac12+e+it)
\ll (KG)^\delta K^{1+u}G^v(1+|t|)^A. \tag{T08.1}
\]
The constants may depend on the fixed data, buffers and specified profile seminorms; \(A\) cannot depend on moving \(K,G,t\). This is a finite trace, never an infinite \(G\)-limit.

Then the inherited current satisfies, for \(1\le K,G\le D\),
\[
|\mathfrak Q(D,K)|
\ll_\rho(DK)^\rho
\left(
 DK^{1+u}G^v+DK+
 D^2K^{1/3}G^{-1}
 +D^{5/3}K^{2/3}G^{-2/3}
\right). \tag{T08.2}
\]
Consequently,
\[
k_*=\frac{1+v/2}{1+u+v},\qquad
c_{u,v}=\frac{k_*-1/2}{3}
       =\frac{1-u}{6(1+u+v)}. \tag{T08.3}
\]
The zero-free conclusion concerns the open half-plane. For any proposed zero inside it, use a strict interior row exponent \(k<k_*\). No boundary-line assertion is needed.

### Proof of the energy implication

For the whole completed column FD (68) gives
\[
S_h^{(g)}(w)=L^S(3w-1,\xi)
\sum_{d\mid g}x_{g/d}(w)
\prod_{p\mid d}(1-x_p(w))D_h^{(d)}(w),
\quad x_a(w)=\xi(a)q_a^{1-3w}.
\]
This selector includes primes shared by a squarefree core and its outside cube. At \(\Re w=1/2+e\),
\[
|x_a|^2=q_a^{-1-6e},\qquad
\prod_{p\mid d}(1+|x_p|)\ll q_d^\delta.
\]
Divisor Cauchy therefore reduces the finite whole-column trace to (T08.1) with cutoff \(G/q_a\le G\), followed by an absolutely convergent \(a\)-sum. The angular factor is incorporated into the original radial cube profile \(\Phi_V\) of FD (69), whose nonzero angular type makes its lower endpoint rapidly decreasing. It is not divided out. Finite Mellin shifts use inherited independent holomorphy and polynomial height bounds. Squaring costs \(D^{1+2e}\); choose \(e\) and preliminary losses sufficiently small in terms of final \(\rho\). This gives the first term of (T08.2).

FD (71)–(72) supplies the unchanged large-divisor energies. The three resulting weights are
\[
\frac{DK}{q_dq_aq_j},\quad
\frac{D^2K^{1/3}}{q_d^2q_a^4q_j^4},\quad
\frac{D^{5/3}K^{2/3}}{q_d^{5/3}q_a^3q_j^3}.
\]
Their sums over \(q_aq_d>G\), with the original finite supports, are the final three terms in (T08.2). The natural core-divisor and \(j\)-overlap conditions remain intact.

Finally, FD §19.3 separates the original common product kernel before applying positive Cauchy in the same divisor/row indices. This step preserves the signed coprime covariance, all original total-column profiles, radial norm twists and both separately paid zero terms. It does not apply a signed estimate to an arbitrarily partitioned profile.

Set \(G=\max(K^{1/3},KD^{-1/2})\). If \(K\le D^{3/4}\), the first term is at most
\[
D^{7/4+3u/4+v/4},
\]
which is strictly below \(D^2\) by \(3u+v<1\). If \(K=D^k\), \(k\ge3/4\), its exponent is
\[
1-v/2+k(1+u+v)<2
\]
for \(k<k_*\). Both tails are at most \(D^2\), and \(DK\le D^2\). Exact equality in a tail is harmless: M (2.18) asks for \(D^{2+\epsilon}\), with arbitrarily small loss. It does not require a power saving below \(D^2\) in every term. This proves the conditional current criterion and (T08.3).

### Exact incidence and what it selects

The extraction identity gives
\[
\mathcal T(K,G;s)=
\sum_{q_k\le KG}\|\mathbf D_k(s)\|^2
\sum_{\substack{
g\mid\operatorname{rad}_{=1}(k)\\
q_g\le G,\ q_k/q_g\le K}}
q_g^{-2\Re s}. \tag{T08.4}
\]
The radical contains only primes of valuation exactly one. This is an equality after summing the full finite orbit: the component switches are permutations/unitary phases. For \(G\le K\), prime rows above \(K\), pure prime squares above \(K\), and pure cubes above \(K\) receive zero weight. A positive ordinary mean through \(KG\) charges rows absent from this incidence. Conversely \(g=1\) still requires an ordinary mean through \(K\); counting divisors alone cannot prove the desired trace.

### New merge corollary: common-completed finite incidence is equivalent

Let \(\widetilde{\mathcal T}(K,G;s)=\sum_{g,h}\|F(s)\mathbf D_h^{(g)}(s)\|^2\), with exactly the same finite index set as \(\mathcal T\). On every buffered strip, (T08.1) is equivalent, up to arbitrary losses and a polynomial height factor, to its version for \(\widetilde{\mathcal T}\). In one direction multiply by the fixed polynomially bounded \(F\). In the other, apply T01 to the single finite holomorphic vector \((\mathbf D_h^{(g)})_{g,h}\); its estimate is dimension-free, and neighboring lines give the required local bound. Moving finite deletions cost at most \((KG)^\delta\). Thus no arithmetic exponent is lost by a **common scalar completion** of this finite incidence.

This completes a merger of T01 with the two-exponent transfer. The symbol \(F\mathbf D_h^{(g)}\) means completion of the forced squarefree-core series. It is not the whole-column selector \(S_h^{(g)}\), which additionally counts primes in the outside cube through T02. Nor does formal multiplication by \(F\) establish a missing current-period realization or align differently completed ray components. Those obligations remain exactly as stated in T01–T02.

### New merge corollary: only the actual divisor corridor is needed

It is enough to assume (T08.1), uniformly in all scales and fixed data, only for
\[
1\le G\le C K^\gamma,\qquad
\gamma=\frac{1-u}{2+v}
      =1-\frac1{2k_*}>\frac13, \tag{T08.5}
\]
where a fixed multiplicative constant \(C\) is harmless. This closes the profile obligation left open in BA's prototype corridor.

For annular equal-length columns, if \(K\le D^k\) and \(k<k_*\), then
\[
K^{1/3}\le K^\gamma,\qquad
KD^{-1/2}\le K^{1-1/(2k)}\le K^\gamma.
\]
The chosen selector split therefore never leaves (T08.5). The cube-selector formula only shortens \(G\).

For the original unbounded profiles, retain the exact common-kernel separation of FD §19.3. On a block of column lengths \(D_1,D_2\) and effective row length \(K'\), first set
\[
D_*=\max\{2,D_1,D_2,(K')^{1/k}\}.
\]
Use one common cutoff
\[
G=\max\{(K')^{1/3},K'D_*^{-1/2}\}.
\]
Then \(K'\le D_*^k\) and \(G\le(K')^\gamma\). Both positive column energies are bounded using the common larger scale \(D_*\); any support rescaling costs only fixed polynomial factors in \(D_*/D_i\), exactly of the kind allowed in the inherited positive profile bounds. Since \(K\le D^k\) and \(K'\) is the original row dyad times \(D_1D_2/D^2\),
\[
\frac{(K')^{1/k}}D
\ll \left(
\text{row-dyad factor}\,\frac{D_1}{D}\frac{D_2}{D}
\right)^{1/k}.
\]
Thus \(D_*/D\), and every rescaled-seminorm cost, is polynomial in the original scale ratios and their inverses. More explicitly, with \(r_i=D_i/D\) and normalized row-dyad factor \(R_{\rm row}\),
\[
 D_*/D\ll 1+r_1+r_2+(R_{\rm row}r_1r_2)^{1/k}.
\]
The retained rapid column tails and the rapid upper row Fourier tail sum these costs. Below \(R_{\rm row}=1\), this enlargement introduces no adverse negative power of \(R_{\rm row}\); the nonempty dyads with \(K'\ge1\) cost at most a logarithm in the scales. Effective row lengths below one use M §2.4's original Fourier-decay estimate. All epsilons are fixed before summing, and \(k\) is fixed strictly below \(k_*\). The full-profile conclusion therefore follows from the corridor hypothesis.

For \((u,v)=(1/8,1/32)\), the exact corridor is \(G\le CK^{28/65}\), and the conditional constant is \(14/111\). A slogan such as “control \(G\) near \(K^{.43}\)” is insufficient: (T08.5) requires every divisor cutoff below that boundary, all components and all height/profile uniformities.

### Exact numerical transfers and an off-central version

\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
(u,v)&c_{u,v}\\ \hline
(\eta,\eta)&(1-\eta)/(6(1+2\eta))\\
(1/8,1/32)&14/111\\
(1/8,1/64)&28/219\\
(1/8,0)&7/54\\
(1/10,1/12)&9/71
\end{array}
\]
At \(c=.1255=251/2000\),
\[
c_{u,v}>.1255\iff1753u+753v<247.
\]
At \(u=1/8\) this is \(v<223/6024\). The general range \(3u+v<1\) extends BB's unnecessarily restricted \(0\le v\le u<1/4\).

If a mean is available only on the fixed line \(1/2+e\), do not hide the cost \(D^{2e}\) in an arbitrary epsilon. A finite trace \(K^{1+u}G^v\) on that line instead gives
\[
k_{*,e}=\frac{1-2e+v/2}{1+u+v},\qquad
c_{u,v,e}=\frac{1-u-4e}{6(1+u+v)},
\]
provided \(8e+3u+v<1\). In the ordinary-mean deduction \(v=(u-2e)_+\), this is exactly BB R05.b's two cases.

SB §6's exact interior example is correct: at \(\eta=3/32\), \(k=8813/10000\), \(g=1907/5000\), the four exponents are
\[
639897/320000,\quad18813/10000,\quad57371/30000,\quad29999/15000.
\]
Their margins below two are \(103/320000,1187/10000,2629/30000,1/15000\). The prefactor loss \(\rho=10^{-6}\) costs \(18813/10^{10}\), less than each margin. This proves exponent feasibility after the missing mean only.

**Sources:** BA D5; BB R05.a–b and R01; SB §6; FD (65)–(73); M (2.14)–(2.18). Corridor closure (T08.5) is original to the merge and was independently checked in the mathematical merge.

## T09. Scale-\(L^2\) direct detectors

### T09a. One fixed Möbius profile

Let
\[
V(u)=e^{-u-u^{-1}},\quad
\phi(u)=(uV(u))',\quad
S_\phi(x)=\sum_{n\ge1}\mu(n)\phi(n/x).
\]
For \(0<a<1\), suppose for every \(\epsilon>0\) and every sufficiently large dyadic \(X\),
\[
\int_X^{2X}|S_\phi(x)|^2\,\frac{dx}{x}
\ll_\epsilon X^{2a+\epsilon}. \tag{T09.1}
\]
Then \(\zeta\) has no zeros in \(\Re s>a\).

Indeed, on \(\Re s\ge a+\delta\), Cauchy bounds the Mellin contribution of one shell by \(X^{-\delta+\epsilon/2}\). Taking \(\epsilon<2\delta\) makes the dyadic sum and every fixed complex derivative converge locally uniformly. At zero the function is exponentially small. Thus
\[
F(s)=\int_0^\infty S_\phi(x)x^{-s}\frac{dx}{x}
\]
is holomorphic for \(\Re s>a\). Initially \(F(s)=\Phi(s)/\zeta(s)\), where [research revision] proves
\[
\Phi(s)=2(1-s)K_s(2).
\]
For completeness, a zero \(K_s(2)=0\) would give \(f(t)=K_s(2e^t)\), \(t\ge0\), with Dirichlet boundary and
\[
\int_0^\infty(|f'|^2+4e^{2t}|f|^2)\,dt
=-s^2\int_0^\infty|f|^2\,dt>0.
\]
Hence such \(s\) is purely imaginary. Therefore \(\Phi\) has no zeros in \(\Re s>0\) except \(1\). Continue
\[
(s-1)\zeta(s)F(s)=(s-1)\Phi(s).
\]
Any proposed zeta zero in \(\Re s>a\) contradicts the nonzero right side. No uniform lower bound for \(\Phi(\sigma+it)\) is used.

The exact positive scale kernel is
\[
\int_X^{2X}|S_\phi(x)|^2\frac{dx}{x}
=\sum_{m,n}\mu(m)\mu(n)
\int_1^2\phi(m/(Xt))\overline{\phi(n/(Xt))}\frac{dt}{t}.
\]
The arithmetic coefficients retain signs and all shared primes.

### The exact full shift kernel and its affordable diagonal

Define
\[
 K_X(m,n)=\int_1^2\phi(m/(Xt))\overline{\phi(n/(Xt))}\,\frac{dt}{t}.
\]
Absolute convergence, using the rapid decay of \(\phi\) at both ends, permits the exact regrouping
\[
 \int_X^{2X}|S_\phi(x)|^2\frac{dx}{x}
 =\sum_{n\ge1}\mu(n)^2K_X(n,n)
 +2\Re\sum_{h\ge1}\sum_{n\ge1}\mu(n)\mu(n+h)K_X(n,n+h).
 \tag{T09.1a}
\]
The diagonal is \(O(X)\): uniformly for \(1\le t\le2\), integer counting gives \(\sum_n|\phi(n/(Xt))|^2\ll X\), and then integrate in \(t\). It is separately affordable for \(a\ge1/2\), including every intended numerical target. For \(a<1/2\), cancellation between this diagonal and the off-diagonal would still be required. More generally,
\[
 |K_X(m,n)|\ll_A (1+m/X)^{-A}(1+n/X)^{-A}.
\]
This bound follows directly from the upper-end Schwartz bounds for each factor; the lower-end decay only improves it. It justifies the regrouping and tail truncations with explicit losses, but gives no short-shift support. When \(m,n\asymp X\), differences of order \(X\) remain. Thus the next sufficient estimate is for the complete signed weighted off-diagonal in (T09.1a), including shared-prime and product coincidences. A fixed-shift theorem alone does not establish (T09.1). This exact decomposition and diagonal bound are an additional merger result used in portfolio F01.N1.

### Frozen-dyad balanced finite form

Set, for large \(X\),
\[
L=\log X,\quad Y=\lfloor\sqrt X/L^2\rfloor,\quad
T_l=X/L^4,\quad T_u=XL^2,\quad J=\lceil8L^6\rceil.
\]
Use [research revision]'s fixed smooth cutoffs \(\rho,\chi\), and define on \(x\in[X,2X]\)
\[
\mathcal B_X(x)=
\sum_{d,e>Y}\mu(d)\mu(e)
\rho(de/T_l)\chi(de/T_u)
\sum_{\ell\le J}\phi(\ell de/x).
\]
For every \(A>0\) and fixed Euler derivative order \(r\),
\[
(x\partial_x)^r\{S_\phi(x)-\mathcal B_X(x)\}
=O_{A,r}(X^{-A}). \tag{T09.2}
\]
This is a bounded extension of [research revision] V7–V8, not a new cancellation estimate.

To prove it, apply the exact Möbius convolution identity with the same arithmetic cutoff \(Y\) throughout the dyad. The short Möbius term is exponentially small. In the Type-I term \(de/x\le L^{-4}\); lower removed Type-II products have \(de/x\le2L^{-4}\). [research revision] V6's complete Poisson cancellation bounds these by \(e^{-cL^2}\) before truncating the \(\ell\)-sum. The infinite upper product tail has \(de/x\ge L^2/2\) and is likewise superpolynomially small after divisor counting. On the retained support \(Jde/x\ge4L^2\), so truncating \(\ell>J\) costs the same. There are \(O(XL^3)\) retained pairs, all with
\[
\sqrt X/L^2<d,e<2\sqrt X L^4.
\]
Every arithmetic cutoff is fixed on the dyad; differentiating only changes the smooth profile. The same endpoint estimates hold for each fixed Euler derivative. Replacing \(S_\phi\) by \(\mathcal B_X\) in (T09.1) changes energy by \(O_A(X^{-A})\) after reserving a larger preliminary \(A\).

At \(a=.87449\), the target squared-energy exponent is \(1.74898\). The gain over the inherited baseline squared-energy bound is \(0.000793294079928262\ldots\). The energy estimate remains open; averaging does not erase a hypothetical \(x^\rho\) mode.

### T09b. Compact-profile triple-convolution criterion

Let \(P_r(y)\) be the exact [research revision] Z13–Z15 triple convolution, including equal-element projection, fixed good sectors, and all cube/core overlaps. For \(5/6<a<1\), suppose
\[
\int_Y^{2Y}\int_1^2|P_r(y)|^2\,dr\,\frac{dy}{y}
\ll_\epsilon Y^{\,2(3-2a)-\epsilon} \tag{T09.3}
\]
for every sufficiently small dyadic \(Y\) and every \(\epsilon>0\). Then \(\zeta_K^S\), and hence \(\zeta\), is zero-free in \(\Re s>a\).

Take \(H=L^2([1,2],dr)\) and \(P(y)=(P_r(y))_r\). Cauchy gives, on \(\Re s\ge a+\delta\),
\[
\left\|\int_Y^{2Y}P(y)y^{2s-3}\frac{dy}{y}\right\|_H
\ll Y^{2(\Re s-a)-\epsilon/2}.
\]
Choose \(\epsilon<4\delta\). The Bochner Mellin integral is holomorphic; large \(y\) decays exponentially uniformly on the compact \(r\)-interval. Initially its exact value is
\[
J_\bullet(s)
\frac{L^S(3s-3/2,\xi_{\rm ang})}{\zeta_K^S(s)},
\quad
J_r(s)=\int_0^\infty t^{2s}K_{1/3}(\kappa t)^2
K_{1/3}(\kappa rt)\,dt.
\]
For fixed \(\Re s>0\), \(r\mapsto J_r(s)\) is analytic on \(r>0\). [research revision] Z16 proves a nonzero gamma-product limit for \(r^{1/3}J_r(s)\) as \(r\downarrow0\). Therefore \(J_r(s)\) cannot vanish almost everywhere on \([1,2]\); its \(H\)-norm is positive. The angular numerator is nonzero because \(3\Re s-3/2>1\). Continue the identity after multiplication by \((s-1)\zeta_K^S(s)\), and evaluate at a hypothetical zero. The right side is a nonzero vector, contradiction.

This removes the need for estimates uniform as \(r\to0\) or an individual zero-free kernel \(J_1\). It does not supply the arithmetic decay. At \(a=.87449\), the squared \(Y\)-exponent is \(2.50204\); \(N=Y^{-2}\) is a different scale.

**Sources:** BB R06–R07; [research revision] V1–V10; [research revision] Z13–Z18.

statement:
### T09a. One fixed Möbius profile

Let
\[
V(u)=e^{-u-u^{-1}},\quad
\phi(u)=(uV(u))',\quad
S_\phi(x)=\sum_{n\ge1}\mu(n)\phi(n/x).
\]
For \(0<a<1\), suppose for every \(\epsilon>0\) and every sufficiently large dyadic \(X\),
\[
\int_X^{2X}|S_\phi(x)|^2\,\frac{dx}{x}
\ll_\epsilon X^{2a+\epsilon}. \tag{T09.1}
\]
Then \(\zeta\) has no zeros in \(\Re s>a\).

Indeed, on \(\Re s\ge a+\delta\), Cauchy bounds the Mellin contribution of one shell by \(X^{-\delta+\epsilon/2}\). Taking \(\epsilon<2\delta\) makes the dyadic sum and every fixed complex derivative converge locally uniformly. At zero the function is exponentially small. Thus
\[
F(s)=\int_0^\infty S_\phi(x)x^{-s}\frac{dx}{x}
\]
is holomorphic for \(\Re s>a\). Initially \(F(s)=\Phi(s)/\zeta(s)\), where [research revision] proves
\[
\Phi(s)=2(1-s)K_s(2).
\]
For completeness, a zero \(K_s(2)=0\) would give \(f(t)=K_s(2e^t)\), \(t\ge0\), with Dirichlet boundary and
\[
\int_0^\infty(|f'|^2+4e^{2t}|f|^2)\,dt
=-s^2\int_0^\infty|f|^2\,dt>0.
\]
Hence such \(s\) is purely imaginary. Therefore \(\Phi\) has no zeros in \(\Re s>0\) except \(1\). Continue
\[
(s-1)\zeta(s)F(s)=(s-1)\Phi(s).
\]
Any proposed zeta zero in \(\Re s>a\) contradicts the nonzero right side. No uniform lower bound for \(\Phi(\sigma+it)\) is used.

The exact positive scale kernel is
\[
\int_X^{2X}|S_\phi(x)|^2\frac{dx}{x}
=\sum_{m,n}\mu(m)\mu(n)
\int_1^2\phi(m/(Xt))\overline{\phi(n/(Xt))}\frac{dt}{t}.
\]
The arithmetic coefficients retain signs and all shared primes.

statement:
## T10. Two-dilation and continuum-dilation Möbius criteria

Fix \(0<\alpha<1\) and \(\Delta_bM(x)=M(bx)-b^\alpha M(x)\), where \(M(x)=\sum_{n\le x}\mu(n)\).

### Two discrete dilations

If for every \(\epsilon>0\) and all sufficiently large integers \(N\),
\[
\sum_{b\in\{2,3\}}\sum_{N\le n<2N}|\Delta_bM(n)|^2
\ll N^{2a+1+\epsilon},\qquad 0<a<1, \tag{T10.1}
\]
then \(\zeta\) is zero-free in \(\Re s>a\).

On a unit interval, \(|M(bx)-M(b\lfloor x\rfloor)|\le b\), while \(M(x)=M(\lfloor x\rfloor)\). Thus (T10.1) gives the continuous dyadic \(L^2(dx/x)\) estimate with an affordable \(O(1)\) error on a shell. The shell argument of T09 yields holomorphy of
\[
\int_0^\infty\Delta_bM(x)x^{-s}\frac{dx}{x}
=\frac{b^s-b^\alpha}{s\zeta(s)}. \tag{T10.2}
\]
Both multipliers can vanish only at
\[
s=\alpha+\frac{2\pi i m}{\log2}
 =\alpha+\frac{2\pi i n}{\log3}.
\]
The irrationality of \(\log2/\log3\) forces \(m=n=0\). The remaining real point \(\alpha\) is not a zeta zero: the alternating eta series is positive on \(0<s<1\), and \(1-2^{1-s}<0\). Thus at least one multiplier retains every prospective nontrivial zero. Their inverses need not be uniformly bounded in height.

The exact consistency identity is
\[
\Delta_2M(3x)-3^\alpha\Delta_2M(x)
=\Delta_3M(2x)-2^\alpha\Delta_3M(x).
\]
It gives no contraction or decay without a new arithmetic estimate.

### New continuum-dilation variant

Replace (T10.1) by
\[
\int_X^{2X}\int_2^3|\Delta_bM(x)|^2\,db\,\frac{dx}{x}
\ll X^{2a+\epsilon}. \tag{T10.3}
\]
The same conclusion follows by taking the Mellin integral in \(L^2([2,3],db)\). Its multiplier vector is \(m_s(b)=b^s-b^\alpha\). It vanishes as a vector only for \(s=\alpha\): a nonconstant exponential in \(\log b\) cannot be identically one on an interval.

This compact continuum also provides a useful quantitative calibration absent from the discrete two-multiplier claim. Put
\[
G_\alpha(s)=\int_2^3|b^s-b^\alpha|^2\,db.
\]
For \(\sigma\) in any fixed compact real interval,
\[
G_\alpha(\sigma+it)\gg1\qquad(|t|\ge1), \tag{T10.4}
\]
with a constant depending on that interval and \(\alpha\). Expanding the square, the cross term is
\[
2\Re\int_2^3 b^{\sigma+\alpha+it}\,db=O((1+|t|)^{-1}),
\]
uniformly in the compact \(\sigma\)-interval; the two diagonal integrals have a positive lower bound. This proves the assertion for large \(t\). Continuity and the absence of zeros prove it on the remaining compact set \(1\le|t|\le T_0\). Near \(s=\alpha\),
\[
G_\alpha(s)=|s-\alpha|^2
\int_2^3 b^{2\alpha}(\log b)^2\,db
 +O(|s-\alpha|^3).
\]
Thus the sole calibration zero is known and simple at the multiplier level; zeta is nonzero there. The proposed continuum energy is nevertheless an open Möbius estimate.

The same hypothesis has a quantitative consequence: on every compact strip \(a<\sigma_0\le\Re s\le\sigma_1\), with \(|\Im s|\ge1\),
\[
 |1/\zeta(s)|\ll_{\sigma_0,\sigma_1,\alpha}1+|\Im s|. \tag{T10.5}
\]
Indeed the shell bounds give an absolutely convergent Bochner Mellin integral \(F(s)\) whose norm is uniformly bounded on that strip; its defining norm integral has no imaginary-height growth. The exact identity is \(\|F(s)\|=\sqrt{G_\alpha(s)}/|s\zeta(s)|\). Combine it with (T10.4). This is conditional on the same open continuum energy, not on any additional arithmetic hypothesis.

On logarithmic scale, \(f(t)=e^{-\alpha t}M(e^t)\) converts \(\Delta_bM(e^t)\) to \(b^\alpha e^{\alpha t}[f(t+\log b)-f(t)]\). An averaged finite-difference/Poincaré approach is therefore an explicit next construction. It must estimate these actual increments, not invoke a generic inequality to create a Möbius power saving.

**Sources:** BA D11 for the discrete construction; continuum construction developed and independently proved during the merge.
title: T10. Two-dilation and continuum-dilation Möbius criteria

statement:
theorem actual_binned_row_count_uniform_geometry {Label : Type*} [Fintype Label]
    (η : Label → Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : ∀ label, Q ≤ (η label).modulus)
    (hβ : (51/100 : ℝ) ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (εm : ℝ) (hεm : 0 < εm) :
    ∃ (J : ℕ) (C K₀ : ℝ), 0 < C ∧ 0 ≤ K₀ ∧
      ∀ (τ ε e κaux ηaux : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
        (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτzero : τ < 1/2)
    (hτheight : 4*τ < ηaux) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε ≤ 1/1000)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < 1/1000)
    (hκ : 0 < κaux) (hκone : κaux ≤ 1) (hη : 0 ≤ ηaux)
    (hbudget : 12*e*((22 : ℝ)+2)+8*κaux+2*ηaux ≤ ε/2)
    (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8) (hI : 0 < I)
    (hwidth : (49/100 : ℝ) ≤ (I : ℝ)*e),
      ∀ᶠ U : ℝ in atTop, 1 < U ∧
      ∀ (rows : Finset FreeRow) (χ : FreeRow → Label → Character)
        (reverse : Label → Bool) (hχ : ∀ u j, (χ u j).residue ≠ 1),
      (∀ u ∈ rows, ((Ideal.span {u.val}).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ U) →
      (∀ u ∈ rows, ∀ j I,
        idealCoeff (χ u j) I =
          if reverse j then starRingEnd ℂ (idealCoeff ((momentData (η j)).character ⟨u.val, u.property.1⟩) I)
          else idealCoeff ((momentData (η j)).character ⟨u.val, u.property.1⟩) I) →
      (∀ u ∈ rows, ∀ j, ((χ u j).modulus.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ U) →
      ∀ (a height : ℝ), 167/200 ≤ a → a ≤ 7/8 →
      (∀ u ∈ rows, a ≤ zeroMaximum (χ u) (hχ u) (U^τ)) →
      2 < U^τ → 0 ≤ height →
      2*Real.pi*U^(τ/2)+((3*I : ℕ) : ℝ)*U^τ ≤ height →
      (rows.card : ℝ) ≤ ((I : ℝ)+1)^2 *
        (((Fintype.card Label : ℝ)*(dyadicLength U : ℝ)^2 *
          fiberConstant (C*(1+height)^J) height K₀) *
          U^(unmarkedDensity (2*a-1)+156*ε+εm+3*e))

theorem actual_buffered_row_count {Label : Type*} [Fintype Label]
    (η : Label → Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : ∀ label, Q ≤ (η label).modulus)
    (hβ : (51/100 : ℝ) ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (εm τ ε e κaux ηaux : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
    (hεm : 0 < εm) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτzero : τ < 1/2)
    (hτheight : 4*τ < ηaux) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεsmall : ε ≤ 1/1000)
    (he : 0 < e) (hesmall : e < 1/1000)
    (hκ : 0 < κaux) (hκone : κaux ≤ 1) (hη : 0 ≤ ηaux)
    (hbudget : 12*e*((22 : ℝ)+2)+8*κaux+2*ηaux ≤ ε/2) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ C K₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 ≤ K₀ ∧
      ∀ᶠ U : ℝ in atTop, 1 < U ∧
      ∀ (rows : Finset FreeRow) (family : rows → Label → Character)
        (reverse : Label → Bool) (hχ : ∀ u j, (family u j).residue ≠ 1),
      (∀ u ∈ rows, ((Ideal.span {u.val}).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ U) →
      (∀ u : rows, ∀ j, ∀ R : Ideal O, idealCoeff (family u j) R =
        if reverse j then starRingEnd ℂ
          (idealCoeff ((momentData (η j)).character
            ⟨u.val.val, u.val.property.1⟩) R)
        else idealCoeff ((momentData (η j)).character
          ⟨u.val.val, u.val.property.1⟩) R) →
      ∀ (a height : ℝ) (i : ℕ), i ≤ I → 51/100 < a → a ≤ 7/8 →
      (∀ u, HeckeDetectorZeros.zeroMaximum (family u) (hχ u)
        (3*(i+1 : ℕ)*U^τ) < a+2*e) →
      (∀ u, a ≤ HeckeDetectorZeros.zeroMaximum (family u) (hχ u)
        ((3*i : ℕ)*U^τ)) →
      (∀ u j, (family u j).modulus.absNorm ≤ U) →
      0 ≤ height → 2*Real.pi*U^(τ/2)+(3*i : ℕ)*U^τ ≤ height →
      (rows.card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card Label : ℝ)*(dyadicLength U : ℝ)^2 *
        fiberConstant (C*(1+height)^J) height K₀ *
          U^(unmarkedDensity (2*a-1)+156*ε+εm)

statement:
theorem actual_original_subsets_error_power
    (Wslot:ℝ→ℂ)(aslot bslot Mcap εremove lo hi εchild:ℝ)
    (a b Mslot εmask:ℝ)(hMslot:0≤ Mslot)(hεmask:0<εmask)(haPlain:0< a)(haUpper:a≤1/4)(hbPlain:1≤ b)
    (L:ℝ)(hL:0≤ L)
    (ha:0< aslot)(hWs:Function.support Wslot⊆Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (hW:ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot)(hbslot:0≤ bslot)(hMcap:0< Mcap)
    (hεchild:0<εchild)(hε:0<εremove)
    (hbeta:(51/100:ℝ)≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)(hbetaTop:HeckeZeroSupremum.beta≤7/8)
    (N:ℕ)(lower upper a0 θsource:ℝ)(hlower:0< lower)(hupper:1≤ upper)
    (ha0:0< a0)(hθsource:0<θsource)
    (lows highs:α→ℝ)(hhighs:∀i,0≤ highs i)
    (εsrc δsrc θsrc Bcap Bseed ξ saving:ℝ)
    (hεsrc:0<εsrc)(hδsrc:0<δsrc)(hθsrc:0<θsrc)(hBcap:0≤ Bcap)(hξ:0<ξ)
    (sigma cost:ℝ)(hsigma:0< sigma)(hξsmall:ξ≤ sigma/4)(hcost:1≤ cost):
    ∃Uprofile:Finset (ℕ×ℕ),∃Jheight:ℕ,
    ∀η₀:Character,∀Q:Ideal O,Q≤ M →
      internalQ Q η₀≠0 → internalQ Q η₀≠⊤ → internalQ Q η₀≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)} →
    ∃Cbound:ℝ,0< Cbound ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1< Z ∧
    ∀Aorig:Finset α,∀θ:Aorig→RayQuotient.Characters M H,
    ∀(w σ freq:Aorig→ℝ)(height mesh:ℝ),0≤ mesh → (∀i,0≤ w i) → (∀i,w i≤ mesh) →
    (∀i,w i≤(Cycle25.Energy.commonMesh Mcap 0 L εchild)) → (∀i,lo≤σ i) → (∀i,σ i≤ hi) → 0≤ height → (∀i,|freq i|≤ height) →
    ∀src:Input Aorig,Matches M H hH src η₀ θ w σ freq Wslot bslot Z →
    (∀i,src.hi i≤ bslot) → (∀i,src.M i≤ Mslot) →
    (∀i,src.lo i=lows i.val) → (∀i,src.hi i=highs i.val) →
    Fintype.card Aorig≤ N → lower≤ src.lower → src.upper≤ upper →
    0≤ src.b₁ → 0≤ src.b₂ → src.b₁≤ max 1 b → src.b₂≤ max 1 b →
    ∀(C D R0:Ideal O),∀_hC:Supported C,∀_hD:Supported D,primeSupport C=primeSupport D →
    ∀(E:Finset (CommonIndex C D))(B:actualAllocations src.pools C)(τ:Character)(t:ℝ),
    frozenCoefficient B.val C R0 src.ν src.W src.P≠0 →
    τ.modulus=src.η.modulus*Ideal.span {fixedBadMask}*Ideal.span {(72:O)}*
      Ideal.span {primeSubsetGenerator (fun P:CommonIndex C D=> P.val) E*activeConductor C D} →
    ∀K delta reserve asource:ℝ,0< K → 0< asource →
    0≤ delta → 0≤ reserve → a0≤ asource →
    ∀(prime:O),prime≠0 → ∀k:ℕ,(k=0 ∨ k=5 ∨ k=6) →
    sigma/6≤ Real.logb Z (normValue prime) →
    (∀i,∀I∈(activeInput (child src C R0 B τ t)).slots i,IsCoprime (Ideal.span {prime}) I) →
    ∀Bp:actualAllocations (activeInput (child src C R0 B τ t)).pools ((Ideal.span {prime})^(k+1)),
    ∀(υ:Character)(χerr:RayCharacter)(v0:ℝ),
    υ.modulus.absNorm≤ CenteredMomentAmplificationRadicalFamily.radicalBound
      (CenteredMomentChildRows.childCharacter τ χerr) fixedBadMask prime
      (CenteredMomentAmplificationActiveFactor.errorMovingExponent k) →
    (υ.modulus.absNorm:ℝ)≤ cost*(τ.modulus.absNorm:ℝ)*Z^(errorMoving prime Z (k+1)) →
    ∀input:Input (CenteredMomentCommonProfile.liveIndices Bp.val),
    input=errorInput src C R0 B τ t (Ideal.span {prime}) (k+1) Bp υ v0 →
    let Kerror

    ∀K delta reserve asource:ℝ,0< K → 0< asource →
    0≤ delta → 0≤ reserve → a0≤ asource →
    let P

theorem actual_free_density_eventually {Label : Type*} [Fintype Label]
    (η : Label → Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : ∀ label, Q ≤ (η label).modulus)

    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)

    (η : Label → Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : ∀ label, Q ≤ (η label).modulus)
    (hβ : (51/100 : ℝ) ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (εm : ℝ) (hεm : 0 < εm) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ C K₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 ≤ K₀ ∧
      ∀ᶠ U : ℝ in atTop, 1 < U ∧
        ∀ (a ε T allowance height : ℝ) (i : ℕ),
        1/2 ≤ a → 2*a-1 ≤ 5/6 → 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1/1000 →
        0 ≤ height → 2*Real.pi*allowance+(3*i : ℕ)*T ≤ height →
        ∀ (B : UnmarkedBatch Label U a ε (unmarkedCutoff (2*a-1)) T allowance i),

        (B.rows.card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card Label : ℝ)*(dyadicLength U : ℝ)^2 *
          fiberConstant (C*(1+height)^J) height K₀ *
            U^(unmarkedDensity (2*a-1)+156*ε+εm)

lemma squared_product_bound {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
    (U δ ε C : ℝ) (Cp : Slot → ℝ) (r₁ r₂ : ℝ) (r : Slot → ℝ)
    (p₁ p₂ : ℂ) (v : Slot → ℂ) (hU : 0 < U) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hCp : ∀ j, 0 ≤ Cp j)
    (hp₁ : ‖p₁‖^2 ≤ C*U^(δ*r₁+ε)) (hp₂ : ‖p₂‖^2 ≤ C*U^(δ*r₂+ε))
    (hv : ∀ j, ‖v j‖^2 ≤ (Cp j)^2*U^(δ*r j+2*ε)) :
    ‖p₁*p₂*∏ j, v j‖^2 ≤
      (C^2*∏ j, (Cp j)^2)*U^(δ*(r₁+r₂+∑ j, r j)+(2+2*(Fintype.card Slot : ℝ))*ε)
title: squared_product_bound

    (hn : Supported (Ideal.span {n})) :

      ∏ i : ActiveIndex C D, if activeExponent C D i = k then
        if IsCoprime n (activePrimary C D i) then (1 : ℂ) else 0 else 1

statement:
theorem actual_first_columns_reconstruct (C D : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C) :
    ∃ u : Oˣ,
      activeConductor C D = (u : O) * ∏ i, activePrimary C D i ∧
      ∀ e n : O, Supported (Ideal.span {n}) → goodLambda ^ 2 ∣ n-1 →
      (leftCoefficient e (activeConductor C D)
          (finiteSexticRow (activePrime C D) (activeGood C D hC) (activeExponent C D)) n =
        idealRowHom (e * (u : O) * leftEffectiveFactor C D) (Ideal.span {n}) *
          (∏ i, sexticReciprocityPhase (activePrimary C D i) n ^ activeExponent C D i) *
          (∏ i, if activeExponent C D i = 5 then
            if IsCoprime n (activePrimary C D i) then (1 : ℂ) else 0 else 1)) ∧
      (rightCoefficient e (activeConductor C D)
          (finiteSexticRow (activePrime C D) (activeGood C D hC) (activeExponent C D)) n =
        idealRowHom (e * (u : O) * rightEffectiveFactor C D) (Ideal.span {n}) *
          (∏ i, sexticReciprocityPhase (activePrimary C D i) n ^ (6-activeExponent C D i)) *
          (∏ i, if activeExponent C D i = 1 then
            if IsCoprime n (activePrimary C D i) then (1 : ℂ) else 0 else 1))
title: actual_first_columns_reconstruct

statement:
theorem allocatedBufferedData_admissible
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {η : Character} {w : NonzeroElement} {n : ℕ} {profileBound : ℕ → ℝ} {a e : ℝ}
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    (parent : JointParentLabel η) (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val)
    (puncture : Ideal O) (hpuncture : puncture ≠ 0)
    (D : Ideal O) (allocation : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset (ι ⊕ Fin 2)))
    (P₁ P₂ : BufferedPlainProfile n profileBound a e)
    (Z d X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (P : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (bin : ℕ)
    (η₀ : ι → Character) (A B : ι → ℝ)
    (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ)
    (hbase : 1 < Z^d) (hR : 0 ≤ Rwidth)
    (hX₁ : 0 ≤ X₁) (hX₂ : 0 ≤ X₂)
    (hX₁cap : X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) (hX₂cap : X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth)
    (hP : ∀ i, 1 ≤ P i ∧ P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth)
    (hσmin : σmin ≤ 0) (hσmax : 0 ≤ σmax)
    (hconductor : ∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
      (excluded N.character puncture) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d)
    (ht₁ : P₁.freq = t) (ht₂ : P₂.freq = t)
    (hfreq : |t|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)
    (hfour : (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux)
    (htwo : (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux)
    (hlog : ∀ i : liveIndices D allocation,
      2*(|Real.log (A i.val)|+|Real.log (B i.val)|)+1 ≤ Real.log (P i.val))
    (hbuffer : 3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T) :
    (allocatedBufferedData parent N puncture hpuncture D allocation P₁ P₂ Z d X₁ X₂ P t bin).Admissible
      M H hH (fun i : liveIndices D allocation => η₀ i.val)
        (fun i : liveIndices D allocation => A i.val) (fun i : liveIndices D allocation => B i.val)
        Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T
title: allocatedBufferedData_admissible

theorem allocated_error_reference_bound (N : ℕ) (b ε : ℝ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι],
    ∀ (s : Input ι), Fintype.card ι ≤ N → ∀ (C R seed : Ideal O), C ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (τ : Character) (t Z d K₀ c sigma delta reserve allowance E : ℝ), 0 < Z → 0 ≤ E →
    ∀ (P : Finset (Ideal O))
      (family : actualAllocations s.pools C → elementPool P → Fin 3 → RayCharacter → Character),
    (∀ B, frozenCoefficient B.val C R s.ν s.W s.P ≠ 0 →
      (56/(P.card : ℝ))*(∑ p : elementPool P,
        firstExtractedErrors (child s C R B τ t) (R*C) seed Z d K₀ c sigma delta reserve p (family B p)) ≤
        mass (child s C R B τ t)^2*
          (reference (τ.modulus.absNorm : ℝ) (volume s) (C.absNorm : ℝ) Z allowance/
            (volume s/(C.absNorm : ℝ)))*E) →
    allocatedExtractedErrors N s C R seed τ t b Z d K₀ c sigma delta reserve P family/
      ((τ.modulus.absNorm : ℝ)*(volume s/(C.absNorm : ℝ)^2)*Z^allowance) ≤
        D*(C.absNorm : ℝ)^ε*mass s^2*E

statement:
theorem original_fixed_allowance_weight_sum (B L Cr ε : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCr : 0 < Cr) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
    ∀ (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (s : Input ι) (R seed : Ideal O),
      Squarefree seed → seed ≠ 0 → s.W₁ 0=0 → s.W₂ 0=0 →
      0 < sourceRadius s → sourceRadius s ≤ Z^B →
    ∀ (m A : O) (t : ℝ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ) (K a₁ a₂ win : ℝ),
      0 < K → 0 < a₁ → 0 < a₂ →
      (∀ x, s.W₁ x ≠ 0 → a₁ ≤ x) → (∀ x, s.W₂ x ≠ 0 → a₂ ≤ x) →
      (∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ win) →
    ∀ radius : (p : Labels s R seed) → Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2) → ℝ,
      (∀ p E, radius p E ≤ Cr*Z^L) → ∀ ξ₁ ξ₂ : RayCharacter, ∀ F : Families s R seed ξ₁ ξ₂,
      sumAllowanceWeight s R seed m A t W V K Z radius
        (fun p E => (F p E).left) (fun p E => (F p E).right) ≤
        ((Real.exp win/((∏ i,s.lo i)*a₁*a₂))*fixedPresentationCost*K*(s.η.modulus.absNorm : ℝ))*
          (C₀*Z^ε/(seed.absNorm : ℝ))
title: original_fixed_allowance_weight_sum

    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot a b radial Bmask L lo hi Mcap εchild εremove : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hWs : Function.support W ⊆ Icc aslot bslot)

    (hmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hMcap : 0 < Mcap) (hεchild : 0 < εchild) (hεremove : 0 < εremove)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O)) (hbad : fixedBadPrimes ⊆ Sbad) :
    ∃ degree : ℕ, ∃ S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), ∀ η₀ : Character,
      ∀ Q : Ideal O, Q ≤ M → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)} →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
        ∀ p : O, p ∈ elementPool (primePool M H Sbad (1/2) 1 (Z^((9/500 : ℝ)/3))) →
        ∀ k : ℕ, (k=1 ∨ k=6 ∨ k=7) →
        ∀ (J : Finset α) (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H)
          (w σ v : α → ℝ) (t height mesh : ℝ),
        0 ≤ mesh → mesh ≤ Cycle25.Energy.commonMesh Mcap Bmask L εchild →
        (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i, w i ≤ mesh) →
        (∀ i, lo ≤ σ i) → (∀ i, σ i ≤ hi) → 0 ≤ height → (∀ i, |v i| ≤ height) →
        ∀ s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial, s.puncture = 1 →
          s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀ → s.width ≤ Mcap →
        ∀ (profile : Profiles a b) (X₁ X₂ loss : ℝ), 0 ≤ loss →
        0 < X₁ → 0 < X₂ → X₁ ≤ Z^L → X₂ ≤ Z^L →
        length Z X₁+length Z X₂+(9/2)*(∑ i ∈ J, w i)-s.width ≤
          37/10000+9/500+errorRemoval p Z k-errorMoving p Z k+loss →
        (localErrorCost p (k-1)*Z^(errorMoving p Z k))*

              (Z^s.width*(normValue p)^k) ≤
          C*diagonalControl s.radial.profile*(profile.control S)^2*(1+|t|+height)^degree*
            Z^(εchild+εremove+(3/4)*mesh+loss/6-53/60000)

theorem joint_buffered_data_bound (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M]
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
    (η : Character) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (Q : Ideal O)
    (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)}) (hQM : Q ≤ M) (hQη₀ : ∀ j, Q ≤ (η₀ j).modulus)
    (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (A B : Slot → ℝ) (hA : ∀ j, 0 < A j)
    (hVs : ∀ j, Function.support (V j) ⊆ Icc (A j) (B j)) (hV : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V j))
    (Rwidth dmax τ ε e κ ηaux σmin σmax loss : ℝ)
    (hRw : 0 ≤ Rwidth) (hdmax : 0 ≤ dmax) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκone : κ ≤ 1) (hη : 0 ≤ ηaux)
    (hbudget : 12*e*(Rwidth+2)+8*κ+2*ηaux ≤ ε)
    (hprimebudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ ε)
    (hloss : (2+2*(Fintype.card Slot : ℝ))*ε ≤ loss)
    (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (hprofile : ∀ k, 0 ≤ profileBound k) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ Z d : ℝ, 1 ≤ Z → 0 ≤ d → d ≤ dmax → 2 ≤ Z^d → 2 < Z^τ →
      ∀ (p : DensityWindow), p.upper < p.lower+2*e →
      ∀ (w : NonzeroElement)
        (R : JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
        (hR : ∀ label, R label ≠ 0),
      jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH η₀) Q hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH η₀ Q hQM hQη₀) R hR
        p.lower p.upper p.height w →
      ∀ D : JointBufferedProductData η w Slot n profileBound p.lower e,
      D.Admissible M H hH η₀ A B Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d p.height →
      ‖D.value M H η₀ V B Z d‖^2 ≤ C*(Z^d)^((2*p.lower-1)*D.length+loss)
title: joint_buffered_data_bound

statement:
theorem joint_buffered_product_fibers_of_le
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {β : α → Type*}
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] [DecidableEq Slot]
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (η : Character) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (Bprofile : Slot → ℝ)
    (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (a e Z d : ℝ)
    (labels : Finset α) (w : α → NonzeroElement) (fiber : (v : α) → Finset (β v))
    (weight value : (v : α) → β v → ℝ) (B E Csrc : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hCsrc : 0 ≤ Csrc)
    (gate : (v : α) → SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e →
      SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e → Prop)
    (hweight : ∀ v ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber v, 0 ≤ weight v b)
    (hvalue : ∀ v ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber v, 0 ≤ value v b)
    (hmass : ∀ v ∈ labels, (∑ b ∈ fiber v, weight v b) ≤ B)
    (hdata : ∀ v ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber v,
      ∃ DL DR : SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e,
        value v b ≤ Csrc*(‖DL.value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖*‖DR.value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖) ∧
        gate v DL DR)
    (hmain : ∀ (S : Finset α), S ⊆ labels →
      ∀ FL FR : (v : α) → SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e,
      (∀ v ∈ S, gate v (FL v) (FR v)) →
      (∑ v ∈ S, ‖(FL v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖ *
        ‖(FR v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖) ≤ E) :
    (∑ v ∈ labels, ∑ b ∈ fiber v, weight v b*value v b) ≤ B*(Csrc*E)
title: joint_buffered_product_fibers_of_le

theorem joint_buffered_product_fibers
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {β : α → Type*}
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] [DecidableEq Slot]
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (η : Character) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (Bprofile : Slot → ℝ)
    (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (a e Z d : ℝ)
    (labels : Finset α) (w : α → NonzeroElement) (fiber : (v : α) → Finset (β v))
    (DL DR : (v : α) → β v → SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e)
    (weight : (v : α) → β v → ℝ) (B E : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (gate : (v : α) → SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e →
      SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e → Prop)
    (hweight : ∀ v ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber v, 0 ≤ weight v b)
    (hmass : ∀ v ∈ labels, (∑ b ∈ fiber v, weight v b) ≤ B)
    (hgate : ∀ v ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber v, gate v (DL v b) (DR v b))
    (hmain : ∀ (S : Finset α), S ⊆ labels →
      ∀ FL FR : (v : α) → SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound a e,
      (∀ v ∈ S, gate v (FL v) (FR v)) →
      (∑ v ∈ S, ‖(FL v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖ *
        ‖(FR v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖) ≤ E) :
    (∑ v ∈ labels, ∑ b ∈ fiber v, weight v b*
      (‖(DL v b).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖ *
        ‖(DR v b).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖)) ≤ B*E

    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ d : ℝ, dmin ≤ d → ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ I →
    ∀ D : JointBufferedProductData η w Slot n profileBound a e,
    ∀ t v₁ v₂ w₁ θ₁ w₂ θ₂ : ℝ, ∀ v : Slot → ℝ,
    |t| ≤ Z^ν → |v₁| ≤ Z^ν → |v₂| ≤ Z^ν → (∀ j, |v j| ≤ Z^ν) →
    |w₁| ≤ Z^ν → |θ₁| ≤ Z^ν → |w₂| ≤ Z^ν → |θ₂| ≤ Z^ν →
    D.plain₁.freq = twoStageFrequency t v₁ w₁ θ₁ w₂ θ₂ →
    D.plain₂.freq = twoStageFrequency t v₂ w₁ θ₁ w₂ θ₂ →
    (∀ j, D.t+D.v j = twoStageFrequency t (v j) w₁ θ₁ w₂ θ₂) →
    0 ≤ D.r₁ → D.r₁ ≤ Rwidth → 0 ≤ D.r₂ → D.r₂ ≤ Rwidth →

theorem survivingBufferedData_remove_short {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] [DecidableEq Slot]
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (A B : Slot → ℝ) (lo hi : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ j, 0 < A j) (hVs : ∀ j, Function.support (V j) ⊆ Icc (A j) (B j))
    (hV : ∀ j, Continuous (V j)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement)
      (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (a e : ℝ)
      (η₀ : Slot → Character) (P : Slot → ℝ) (Z d : ℝ)
      (D : SurvivingBufferedData η w Slot
        (fun S => orders (S ∩ largePrimeSlots A B P)) profileBound a e),
      (∀ j : D.slots, (Z^d)^(D.data.r j) = P j.val) →
      (∀ j ∈ D.slots, 1 ≤ P j) →
      (∀ j : D.slots, lo ≤ D.data.σ j ∧ D.data.σ j ≤ hi) →
      ‖D.value M H η₀ V B Z d‖ ≤
        C*‖(D.restrictSlots (largePrimeSlots A B P)).value M H η₀ V B Z d‖
title: survivingBufferedData_remove_short

theorem uniform_cancellation_sector_count (B e : ℝ) (hB : 0≤ B) (he : 0< e) :
    ∃ N : ℕ,∀ {Row Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
      (s : CenteredMomentFirstAmplificationChoice.OriginalData Slot) (side : Bool)
      (labels : Finset Row) (q : Row → ActualJointSourceRow s side) (Z : ℝ),1< Z →
      (∀ x∈labels,((q x).label.C₁.absNorm : ℝ)≤ Z^B) →
      ∃ bin : (x : Row) → x∈labels → (Fin 2 → Fin (N+1)),
        ∀ x hx j,0≤(bin x hx j).val*e ∧
          (bin x hx j).val*e≤(q x).cancellationCoordinates Z j ∧
          (q x).cancellationCoordinates Z j<(bin x hx j).val*e+e

statement:
theorem eventually_joint_coarse_population (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ Z ∧
      ∀ (unit : JointReconstructionLabel → Oˣ) (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel),
      (∀ v ∈ S, v.row (unit v) ≠ 0) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧ primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (v.C₁.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (v.D₁.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (v.C₂.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (v.D₂.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ((Ideal.span {v.row (unit v)}).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ((jointMissingRadical v.C₁ (v.row (unit v))).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ Z^(16*B+1)
title: eventually_joint_coarse_population

theorem actual_literal_first_coherent_exceptional_target
    (Mpool : Ideal O) [NeZero Mpool] (Hpool : Subgroup (O ⧸ Mpool)ˣ)
    (hHpool : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits Mpool ≤ Hpool)
    (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O))
    (a b Mslot upper bplain₁ bplain₂ BRmask τ ξ reserve : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hMslot : 0 ≤ Mslot) (hBRmask : 0 ≤ BRmask)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hreserve : 0 ≤ reserve)
    (hbudget : ξ+reserve ≤ lowLocalTiny)
    (lo hi : ι → ℝ) (hlo : ∀ i,0 < lo i)
    (ηfirst : Character) (profile : Profiles a b) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    ∃ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν ∧ ν < τ ∧
    ∀ Q : Ideal O, Q ≠ 0 → Q ≠ ⊤ → Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)} →
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ hZ : 1 < Z,
    ∀ (src : Input ι) (w : ι → ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,src.P i = Z^(w i)) →
      (∀ i,src.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i,src.hi i = hi i) →
      (∀ i,src.M i ≤ Mslot) → src.upper ≤ upper →
      (∀ i,|src.hi i| ≤ upper) → |src.b₁| ≤ bplain₁ → |src.b₂| ≤ bplain₂ →
      src.W₁ = profile.profile 0 → src.W₂ = profile.profile 1 → src.η = ηfirst →
      0 < sourceRadius src →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z src.X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁+Real.logb Z src.X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
      Z^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ src.X₁ → Z^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ src.X₂ →
      Z^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ src.Y₁ → Z^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ src.Y₂ →
    ∀ (R seed : Ideal O), R ≠ 0 → (R.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^BRmask →
      Squarefree seed → seed ≠ 0 →
    let radius

statement:
theorem actual_common_second_radical_mass (B L Cr ε : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCr : 0 < Cr) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Cbound : ℝ, 0 < Cbound ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (src : Input ι) (R seed C₁ L₁ : Ideal O) (hC₁ : Supported C₁),
      Squarefree L₁ → L₁ ≠ 0 → src.W₁ 0 = 0 → src.W₂ 0 = 0 →
      sourceRadius src/(C₁.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B →
      ∀ K Radius Hsource : ℝ, 0 < K → Radius ≤ Cr*Z^L → Hsource ≤ Z^B →
      (∑ q : ActiveBlocks (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
        (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁) K Radius Hsource,

    ∃ Cbound : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cbound ∧

    ∀ (R seed C₁ L₁ : Ideal O) (hC₁ : Supported C₁), R ≠ 0 → seed ∣ C₁ →
    Squarefree L₁ → L₁ ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (η : Character) (χ₀ : RayCharacter) (m : O), m ≠ 0 → goodLambda ∣ m → (2 : O) ∣ m →
    ∀ t Kphys Tsec ξ Hsource P M Kfirst omega primeLoss : ℝ, 0 < Kphys → 0 < P →
    frequencyRadius Tsec Z ξ ≤ Cr*Z^L → Hsource ≤ Z^Bsource →
    (expandedFactor η : ℝ)*R.absNorm*(sourceRadius src)^2*(4*frequencyRadius Tsec Z ξ) ≤ Z^B →
    Z^(M/4) ≤ src.X₁ → Z^(M/4) ≤ src.X₂ → Z^(M/4) ≤ src.Y₁ → Z^(M/4) ≤ src.Y₂ →

      (Real.logb Z (C₁.absNorm : ℝ)) (9/500) omega 0 →
    ‖partEnergy true η χ₀ Q m t (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
      (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁) W Kphys Tsec Z ξ Hsource‖/(volume src.toData*P) ≤

theorem actual_literal_first_coherent_zero_target
    (Mslot B₁ B₂ upper b₁ b₂ : ℝ) (hB₁ : 0 ≤ B₁) (hB₂ : 0 ≤ B₂)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O))
    (ξamp reserve : ℝ) (hξamp : 0 < ξamp) (hreserve : 0 ≤ reserve)
    (hbudget : ξamp+reserve ≤ lowLocalTiny) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ hZ : 1 < Z,
    ∀ (src : Input ι) (w : ι → ℝ), (∀ i,src.P i = Z^(w i)) →
      (∀ i,src.M i ≤ Mslot) → (∀ i,|src.hi i| ≤ upper) →

      (∀ x,‖src.W₁ x‖ ≤ B₁) → (∀ x,‖src.W₂ x‖ ≤ B₂) →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z src.X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁+Real.logb Z src.X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (R seed : Ideal O), Squarefree seed → seed ≠ 0 →
      src.W₁ 0 = 0 → src.W₂ 0 = 0 → 0 < sourceRadius src →
    ∀ Kfirst : ℝ, 1 ≤ Kfirst →

statement:
theorem eventually_supported_low_gate_of_common_bin
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] [Nonempty Slot]
    (η₀ : Character) (radial ξ : ℝ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (Bmask d : ℝ) (s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial),
      s.width+Bmask+ξ ≤ d →
      ∀ (η : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M)
        (hQ : s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀)
        (hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
        (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η) (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val)
        (R : Ideal O), R ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (z : O) (hz : (supportedNaturalState s).radial.keep z),
      (∀ I : Ideal O,
        idealCoeff (excluded (naturalRow s.character z (s.row_ne_zero z hz.1)).character s.puncture) I =
          idealCoeff (excluded N.character R) I) →
      ∀ (τ e a : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < e →
      ∀ (holes : JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
        (hholes : ∀ label,holes label ≠ 0),
      jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Slot => η₀))
        (internalQ Q η₀) hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH (fun _ : Slot => η₀) (internalQ Q η₀)
          (inf_le_left.trans hQM) (fun _ => inf_le_right))
        holes hholes a (a+e) (3*(k+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ) w →
      NaturalLowGate M H hH (supportedNaturalState s) η₀ Q hQM hQ d τ e a k z hz
title: eventually_supported_low_gate_of_common_bin

statement:
theorem common_column_functional_allocation (D : OriginalData ι)
    (hS : ∀ i, ∀ I ∈ D.S i,I ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, ∀ I ∈ D.S (Sum.inl i),Prime I)
    (C : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C) (hseed : D.s ∣ C)
    (L : Ideal O) (f : Ideal O → ℂ) :
    (∑ I ∈ supportedColumns (residualPool C hC.1 D.columns),
      (if IsCoprime C I ∧ L ∣ I then D.beta (C*I) else 0)*f I) =
      ∑ B : actualAllocations D.S C,
        frozenCoefficient B.val C D.R D.nu D.slot D.lengths *
          ∑ I ∈ supportedColumns (allocatedData D C L B).columns,
            (allocatedData D C L B).beta I*f I
title: common_column_functional_allocation

statement:
theorem exists_input_common_error_families
    (P : Finset (Ideal O)) (hP : ∀ Q ∈ P, Prime Q)
    (hbad : ∀ Q ∈ P, Q ∉ fixedBadPrimes)
    (Z sigma b eta delta reserve : ℝ) (hZ : 1 < Z) (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigma)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hsep : b*Z^eta < Z^(sigma/6))
    (hpl : ∀ Q ∈ P, Z^(sigma/6) ≤ (Q.absNorm : ℝ))
    (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hreserve : 2 ≤ Z^reserve) :
    ∃ τ : Character → elementPool P → Fin 3 → RayCharacter → Character,
      (∀ η (p : elementPool P) i χ, ((τ η p i χ).modulus.absNorm : ℝ) ≤
        radicalBound (childCharacter η χ) fixedBadMask p.val (errorMovingExponent (errorIndex i))) ∧
      ∀ (s : Input ι), (∀ i, Function.support (s.W i) ⊆ Set.Iic b) →
      ∀ (z : ι → ℝ), (∀ i, z i ≤ eta) → (∀ i, s.P i = Z^(z i)) →
      ∀ (R seed : Ideal O) (d K₀ c : ℝ) (j : ℤ),
        Real.logb Z (dyadicScale j) ≤ K₀+delta →
        (∑ p ∈ elementPool P, ∑ h ∈ (dyadRows j).filter (fun h => eligible R seed h p),
          errorEnergy Finset.univ (sourceGenerator (original s R seed).columns)
            (sourceGenerator_supported (original s R seed).columns)
            ((original s R seed).coefficient s.η fixedBadMask s.t (volume s)) h p) ≤
          ∑ p : elementPool P,
            firstExtractedErrors s R seed Z d K₀ c sigma delta reserve p (τ s.η p)
title: exists_input_common_error_families

statement:
theorem actual_common_retained_admissible
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ profileBound : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < profileBound k) ∧
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (orders : Finset ι → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η)
        (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val) (puncture : Ideal O) (hpuncture : puncture ≠ 0)
        (s : Input ι) (C R : Ideal O) (B : actualAllocations s.pools C)
        (source : Character) (A z : O) (t : ℝ)
        (D : Ideal O) (allocation : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset
          (CenteredMomentCommonProfile.liveIndices B.val ⊕ Fin 2))) (branch : Bool)
        (Z d : ℝ) (η₀ : ι → Character) (V : ι → ℝ → ℂ)
        (alo bhi : ι → ℝ) (bin : ℕ) (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ),
      s.W₁ = W₁ → s.W₂ = W₂ →
      (∀ i, s.slots i = primePool M H (bhi i) (s.P i)) →
      (∀ i I, s.ν i I = idealCoeff (η₀ i).inverse I) → (∀ i, s.W i = V i) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight source (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (R*C)) A z t I =
        rowWeight parent.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator puncture) 1 w.val t I) →
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 ≤ Rwidth →
      s.X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      s.Y₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.Y₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ s.P i ∧ s.P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded N.character puncture) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      |t|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (∀ i : liveIndices D allocation,
        2*(|Real.log (alo i.val.val)|+|Real.log (bhi i.val.val)|)+1 ≤ Real.log (s.P i.val.val)) →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →
      secondRetainedPositive (secondCommonData s C R B source A t).toSource
        D allocation branch z ≠ 0 →
      ∃ data : SurvivingBufferedData η w ι orders profileBound edge e,
        data.slots = embeddedSlots (allocationSlotEmbedding (commonSlotEmbedding s C B) D allocation) ∧
        ‖secondRetainedPositive (secondCommonData s C R B source A t).toSource
          D allocation branch z‖ = ‖data.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖ ∧
        d*data.length ≤ Real.logb Z (secondCommonVolume s C B)-
          Real.logb Z (formalReductionFactor D allocation (fun i => s.P i.val))+
          Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        data.Admissible M H hH η₀ alo bhi Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T

theorem actual_common_retained_short_gates
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ profileBound : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < profileBound k) ∧
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (orders : Finset ι → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η)
        (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val) (puncture : Ideal O) (hpuncture : puncture ≠ 0)
        (s : Input ι) (C R : Ideal O) (B : actualAllocations s.pools C)
        (source : Character) (A z : O) (t : ℝ)
        (D : Ideal O) (allocation : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset
          (CenteredMomentCommonProfile.liveIndices B.val ⊕ Fin 2))) (branch : Bool)
        (Z d : ℝ) (η₀ : ι → Character) (V : ι → ℝ → ℂ)
        (alo bhi : ι → ℝ) (bin : ℕ) (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ),
      s.W₁ = W₁ → s.W₂ = W₂ →
      (∀ i, s.slots i = primePool M H (bhi i) (s.P i)) →
      (∀ i I, I ∈ s.slots i → s.ν i I = idealCoeff (η₀ i).inverse I) → (∀ i, s.W i = V i) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight source (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (R*C)) A z t I =
        rowWeight parent.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator puncture) 1 w.val t I) →
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 ≤ Rwidth →
      s.X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      s.Y₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.Y₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ s.P i ∧ s.P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded N.character puncture) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      |t|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →
      secondRetainedPositive (secondCommonData s C R B source A t).toSource
        D allocation branch z ≠ 0 →
      ∃ data : SurvivingBufferedData η w ι orders profileBound edge e,
        data.slots = embeddedSlots (allocationSlotEmbedding (commonSlotEmbedding s C B) D allocation) ∧
        ‖secondRetainedPositive (secondCommonData s C R B source A t).toSource
          D allocation branch z‖ = ‖data.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖ ∧
        d*data.length ≤ Real.logb Z (secondCommonVolume s C B)-
          Real.logb Z (formalReductionFactor D allocation (fun i => s.P i.val))+
          Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        data.ShortSlotGates M H hH η₀ Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T ∧
        (∀ j : data.slots, (Z^d)^(data.data.r j) = s.P j.val) ∧
        (∀ j, data.data.σ j = 0 ∧ data.data.v j = 0) ∧ data.data.t = t ∧ data.data.bin = bin

    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)

    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (loss : ℝ) (hlosspos : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ (A : ℕ) (K : ℝ), 0 < K ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 1 ≤ Y → ∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ F : Finset FreeRow,
        (∀ u ∈ F, rowNorm u ≤ Y ∧ jointNaturalZeroBin η Q hQ72
          p.lower p.upper p.height ⟨u.val, u.property.1⟩) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss)) ∧

        ∀ R : Finset ProbePhysical.NonzeroFrequency,
        (∀ u ∈ R, rawFrequencyNorm u ≤ Y ∧ jointNaturalZeroBin η Q hQ72
          p.lower p.upper p.height u) →
        (R.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss))

theorem firstExtractedErrors_refined_power_budget {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (s : Input ι) (R seed : Ideal O) (Z d K₀ c delta reserve : ℝ)
    (p : O) (hp : Prime (Ideal.span {p}))
    (hslot : ∀ j, ∀ I ∈ (activeInput s).slots j, IsCoprime (Ideal.span {p}) I)
    (family : Fin 3 → RayCharacter → Character)
    (q deficit paid eps saving : ℝ) (r : Fin 3 → RayCharacter → ℝ)
    (Hcoef : Fin 3 → RayCharacter → Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hZ : 0 < Z) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hH : ∀ i χ j, 0 ≤ Hcoef i χ j)
    (hbound : ∀ i χ,
      ∀ B : actualAllocations (activeInput s).pools ((Ideal.span {p})^(errorIndex i+1)),
        childNormalizedGaussSource (activeInput s) ((Ideal.span {p})^(errorIndex i+1))
          R seed B (family i χ) s.t ballProfile
          (errorCommonRadius Z d K₀ c (9/500) delta reserve p (errorIndex i+1)) ≤
        (∑ j, Hcoef i χ j*errorPowers p (errorIndex i+1) q Z
          (errorCommonRadius Z d K₀ c (9/500) delta reserve p (errorIndex i+1))
          (refinedErrorDeficit p Z (errorIndex i+1) (9/500) deficit) paid saving (r i χ) j*
          (volume (child (activeInput s) ((Ideal.span {p})^(errorIndex i+1)) R B (family i χ) s.t))^(powers eps j))*
          mass (child (activeInput s) ((Ideal.span {p})^(errorIndex i+1)) R B (family i χ) s.t)^2) :
    firstExtractedErrors s R seed Z d K₀ c (9/500) delta reserve p family ≤
      mass s^2*∑ i : Fin 3, 16*(errorIndex i+2 : ℝ)^2*localErrorCost p (errorIndex i)*
        ∑ χ : RayCharacter, ∑ j : Fin 4,
          Hcoef i χ j*errorPowers p (errorIndex i+1) q Z
            (errorCommonRadius Z d K₀ c (9/500) delta reserve p (errorIndex i+1))
            (refinedErrorDeficit p Z (errorIndex i+1) (9/500) deficit) paid saving (r i χ) j*
            (volume s/(normValue p)^(errorIndex i+1))^(powers eps j)

theorem actual_first_allocated_exceptional_sum
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
    (wlo whi : ℝ) (hwlo : 0 < wlo) (hwhi : 0 ≤ whi)
    (lo hi : Slot → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (Bcap Bfirst Lfirst Crfirst : ℝ)
    (hBcap : 0 ≤ Bcap) (hBfirst : 0 ≤ Bfirst) (hLfirst : 0 ≤ Lfirst) (hCrfirst : 0 < Crfirst) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), (0,0) ∈ S ∧
      ∀ Q : Ideal O, Q ≠ 0 → Q ≠ ⊤ → Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)} →
      ∃ Cfixed : ℝ, 0 < Cfixed ∧
      ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (s : Input Slot) (p₀ : Profiles wlo whi),
      (∀ i, s.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i, s.hi i = hi i) →
      s.W₁ = p₀.profile 0 → s.W₂ = p₀.profile 1 → s.upper ≤ b →
      ∀ R seed : Ideal O, Squarefree seed → seed ≠ 0 → s.W₁ 0 = 0 → s.W₂ 0 = 0 →
      0 < sourceRadius s → sourceRadius s ≤ Z^Bfirst →
      ∀ (m A : O) (t : ℝ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
        (K a₁ a₂ win M heightCap seedFloor : ℝ),
      0 < K → 0 < a₁ → 0 < a₂ → 0 ≤ heightCap → 0 < seedFloor →
      (∀ y, s.W₁ y ≠ 0 → a₁ ≤ y) → (∀ y, s.W₂ y ≠ 0 → a₂ ≤ y) →
      (∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ win) →
      1 ≤ M → M ≤ Real.logb Z K+Real.logb Z (s.η.modulus.absNorm : ℝ)+Real.logb Z fixedPresentationCost →
      Real.logb Z (CenteredMomentAmplificationChildInput.volume s) ≤ (883/1000)*M →
      Z^(M/4) ≤ s.X₁ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.X₂ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.Y₁ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.Y₂ →
      ∀ radius : (p : Labels s R seed) → Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2) → ℝ,
      (∀ p E, radius p E ≤ Crfirst*Z^Lfirst) →
      ∀ (ξ₁ ξ₂ : RayCharacter) (F : Families s R seed ξ₁ ξ₂),
      ∀ runs : (p : Labels s R seed) → (E : Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2)) →
        Blocks (effectiveScale p.val.1 p.val.2 E K) (radius p E)
          (sourceRadius s/p.val.1.absNorm) (sourceRadius s/p.val.2.absNorm) → Fin 2 → MainExceptionalRun,
      (∀ (p : Labels s R seed) (E : Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2)),
        E ∈ CenteredMomentFirstDiscardedEnergy.inactiveSubsets p.val.1 p.val.2 → ∀ n,
        (runs p E n 0).mask = R ∧ (runs p E n 1).mask = R ∧
        (runs p E n 0).Admissible s p.val.1 p.val.2 (F p E).left Z Bcap Bfirst heightCap seedFloor ∧
        (runs p E n 1).Admissible s p.val.2 p.val.1 (F p E).right Z Bcap Bfirst heightCap seedFloor) →
      (∑ p : Labels s R seed,
        ∑ E ∈ CenteredMomentFirstDiscardedEnergy.inactiveSubsets p.val.1 p.val.2,
        ∑ n : Blocks (effectiveScale p.val.1 p.val.2 E K) (radius p E)
          (sourceRadius s/p.val.1.absNorm) (sourceRadius s/p.val.2.absNorm),
          allowanceWeight s R seed m A t W V K (radius p E) Z p E (F p E).left (F p E).right n *
            (Real.sqrt ((runs p E n 0).normalizedValue s p.val.1 p.val.2 E (F p E).left K b Z Q)*
             Real.sqrt ((runs p E n 1).normalizedValue s p.val.2 p.val.1
               (swapSubset p.val.1 p.val.2 E) (F p E).right K b Z Q))) ≤
      Cfixed*p₀.control S^2*(1+heightCap)^(2*J)*mass s^6*
        ((Real.exp win/((∏ i,s.lo i)*a₁*a₂))*fixedPresentationCost*K*(s.η.modulus.absNorm : ℝ))*
          Z^(-7/100 : ℝ)/((seed.absNorm : ℝ)*seedFloor)

    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
    (wlo whi : ℝ) (hwlo : 0 < wlo) (hwhi : 0 ≤ whi)
    (lo hi : Slot → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (Bcap Bfirst : ℝ)
    (hBcap : 0 ≤ Bcap) (hBfirst : 0 ≤ Bfirst) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), (0,0) ∈ S ∧
      ∀ Q : Ideal O, Q ≠ 0 → Q ≠ ⊤ → Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)} →
      ∃ Cfixed : ℝ, 0 < Cfixed ∧
      ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (s : Input Slot) (p : Profiles wlo whi),
      (∀ i, s.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i, s.hi i = hi i) →
      s.W₁ = p.profile 0 → s.W₂ = p.profile 1 → s.upper ≤ b →
      ∀ (η τ : Character) (C D : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C) (hD : Supported D),
      primeSupport C = primeSupport D → ∀ U : Finset (CommonIndex C D),
      ∀ (K M heightCap seedFloor : ℝ), 0 < K → 0 ≤ heightCap → 0 < seedFloor →
      τ.modulus = η.modulus*Ideal.span {fixedBadMask}*Ideal.span {(72 : O)}*
        Ideal.span {primeSubsetGenerator (fun P : CommonIndex C D => P.val) U*activeConductor C D} →
      1 ≤ M → M ≤ Real.logb Z K+Real.logb Z (η.modulus.absNorm : ℝ)+Real.logb Z fixedPresentationCost →
      Real.logb Z (CenteredMomentAmplificationChildInput.volume s) ≤ (883/1000)*M →
      Z^(M/4) ≤ s.X₁ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.X₂ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.Y₁ → Z^(M/4) ≤ s.Y₂ →
      ∀ x : MainExceptionalRun, x.Admissible s C D τ Z Bcap Bfirst heightCap seedFloor →
      x.normalizedValue s C D U τ K b Z Q ≤
        Cfixed*p.control S^2*(1+heightCap)^(2*J)*mass s^6*Z^(-2/25 : ℝ)/seedFloor
title: actual_local_main_exceptional_runs

statement:
theorem joint_arithmetic_fiber_count (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (Q : Ideal O), Q ≠ 0 → ∀ S : Finset JointArithmeticCode,
      (∀ v ∈ S, v.1.1 ≠ 0 ∧ v.1.2 ≠ 0 ∧ v.2.1.1 ≠ 0 ∧ v.2.1.2 ≠ 0) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.1.1 ⊆ primeSupport Q ∧
        primeSupport v.1.2 ⊆ primeSupport Q ∧
        primeSupport v.2.1.1 ⊆ primeSupport Q ∧
        primeSupport v.2.1.2 ⊆ primeSupport Q ∧
        v.2.2.1 ⊆ primeSupport Q ∧ v.2.2.2.1 ⊆ primeSupport Q ∧
        v.2.2.2.2 ⊆ primeSupport Q) →
      ∀ X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : ℝ, 0 < X₁ → 0 < Y₁ → 0 < X₂ → 0 < Y₂ →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.1.1 : ℝ) ≤ X₁ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.1.2 : ℝ) ≤ Y₁ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.2.1.1 : ℝ) ≤ X₂ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.2.1.2 : ℝ) ≤ Y₂) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K * X₁^a * Y₁^a * X₂^a * Y₂^a * (Ideal.absNorm Q : ℝ)^(5*ε)
title: joint_arithmetic_fiber_count

theorem actual_local_natural_moment_all_heights
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot lo hi a b bΦ Bmask ε : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hsSlot : Function.support Wslot ⊆ Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (hcSlot : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot) (hbslot : 0 < bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hlo : a ≤ 1/4) (hhi : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbΦ : 0 < bΦ) (hBmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8) :
    ∃ mesh : ℝ, 0 < mesh ∧ mesh ≤ lowLocalMesh ∧
    ∀ (ηfirst η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O), Q ≤ M →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ → internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)} →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≤ ηfirst.modulus →
    ∀ (p : Profiles a b) (Wradial : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)),
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (t height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ mesh) →
    ∀ (hσlo : ∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) (hσhi : ∀ i,σ i ≤ hi),
      0 ≤ height → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
    ∀ (X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0 < X₁) (hX₂ : 0 < X₂),
      410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₁ → 410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₂ →
      Real.logb Z X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z X₁+Real.logb Z X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ s : NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ,
      s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀ → s.character = ηfirst → s.rowWidth = 1 →
      s.characterWidth = Real.logb Z (ηfirst.modulus.absNorm : ℝ) → s.radial.profile = Wradial →
      energy s.character s.mask 1 t (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i => CenteredMomentPrimeSlot.primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I*
          HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight Wslot (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (freq i) I)
        (fun i => Z^(w i)) X₁ X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
        C*(1+|t|+height)^J*Z^(1+ε)
