theorem actual_local_natural_moment_all_heights_explicit_mesh
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot lo hi a b bΦ Bmask ε : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hsSlot : Function.support Wslot ⊆ Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (hcSlot : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot) (hbslot : 0 < bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hlo : a ≤ 1/4) (hhi : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbΦ : 0 < bΦ) (hBmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8) :
    ∀ (ηfirst η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O), Q ≤ M →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ → internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)} →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≤ ηfirst.modulus →
    ∀ (p : Profiles a b) (Wradial : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)),
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (t height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ meshGuaranteed Bmask ε) →
    ∀ (hσlo : ∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) (hσhi : ∀ i,σ i ≤ hi),
      0 ≤ height → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
    ∀ (X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0 < X₁) (hX₂ : 0 < X₂),
      410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₁ → 410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₂ →
      Real.logb Z X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z X₁+Real.logb Z X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ s : NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ,
      s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀ → s.character = ηfirst → s.rowWidth = 1 →
      s.characterWidth = Real.logb Z (ηfirst.modulus.absNorm : ℝ) → s.radial.profile = Wradial →
      energy s.character s.mask 1 t (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i => CenteredMomentPrimeSlot.primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I*
          HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight Wslot (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (freq i) I)
        (fun i => Z^(w i)) X₁ X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
        C*(1+|t|+height)^J*Z^(1+ε)
title: actual_local_natural_moment_all_heights_explicit_mesh

theorem actual_literal_first_annular_targets
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot a b σlo σhi Mslot lower upper bplain₁ bplain₂ BRmask : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hWs : Function.support Wslot ⊆ Icc aslot bslot)

    (ha : 0 < a) (haUpper : a ≤ 1/4) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbplain₁ : b ≤ bplain₁) (hbplain₂ : b ≤ bplain₂)
    (hMslot : 0 ≤ Mslot) (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 1 ≤ upper) (hBRmask : 0 ≤ BRmask)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (lows highs : α → ℝ) (hlows : ∀ i,0 < lows i) (hhighs : ∀ i,0 ≤ highs i)
    (ηfirst : Character) (profile : Profiles a b)
    (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O)) (hbad : fixedBadPrimes ⊆ Sbad)
    (e : ℝ) (he : 0 < e) (hecap : e ≤ highLocalBinCap BRmask (Fintype.card α))
    (η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M)
    (hQ0 : internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0) (hQt : internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤)
    (hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)})
    (hQη : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ ηfirst.modulus)
    (S₀ : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y,0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y,φ y ≤ B₀) :
    ∃ ν C : ℝ, 0 < ν ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ lowLocalMesh) →
      (∀ i,σlo ≤ σ i) → (∀ i,σ i ≤ σhi) →
      0 ≤ height → height ≤ Z^ν → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
    ∀ (src : Input α), Matches M H hH src η₀ θ w σ freq Wslot bslot Z →
      (∀ i,src.hi i ≤ bslot) → (∀ i,src.M i ≤ Mslot) →
      (∀ i,src.lo i = lows i) → (∀ i,src.hi i = highs i) →
      lower ≤ src.lower → src.upper ≤ upper →
      (∀ i,|src.hi i| ≤ upper) → |src.b₁| ≤ bplain₁ → |src.b₂| ≤ bplain₂ →
      0 ≤ src.b₁ → 0 ≤ src.b₂ → src.b₁ ≤ max 1 b → src.b₂ ≤ max 1 b →
      profile.profile 0 = src.W₁ → profile.profile 1 = src.W₂ → src.η = ηfirst →
      0 < sourceRadius src →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z src.X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      Real.logb Z src.Y₁ ≤ 1 → Real.logb Z src.Y₂ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁+Real.logb Z src.X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
      Z^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ src.X₁ → Z^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ src.X₂ →
      Z^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ src.Y₁ → Z^(1/4:ℝ) ≤ src.Y₂ →
    ∀ (R : Ideal O), R ≠ 0 → (R.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^BRmask →
    ∀ (hz₁ : src.W₁ 0=0) (hz₂ : src.W₂ 0=0),
    let radius

theorem eventually_actual_first_annular_sector_from_local_targets
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (Wkernel : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hVrow : V 1 = logAnnulus)
    (Mwin : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hMwin : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay Ncap : ℕ) (ν F U b₁ b₂ B₁ B₂ B L Cr Amin Amax : ℝ)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hB₁ : 0 ≤ B₁) (hB₂ : 0 ≤ B₂)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hCr : 0 < Cr) :
    ∃ degree : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
    ∀ (s : Input ι) (R seed : Ideal O),
    Fintype.card ι ≤ Ncap → (∀ i, s.M i ≤ F) → s.upper ≤ U → s.b₁ ≤ b₁ → s.b₂ ≤ b₂ →
    s.W₁ 0 = 0 → s.W₂ 0 = 0 →
    (∀ x, ‖s.W₁ x‖ ≤ B₁) → (∀ x, ‖s.W₂ x‖ ≤ B₂) →
    0 < sourceRadius s → sourceRadius s ≤ Z^B →
    ∀ (M A δ a window Ch : ℝ), Amin ≤ A → A ≤ Amax → 0 < a → 0 ≤ Ch →
    volume s.toData = Z^A →
    ∀ radius : (p : Labels s R seed) → Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2) → ℝ,
    (∀ p E, radius p E ≤ Cr*Z^L) →
    let Outer

    (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
    (t₁ t₂ : Λ → ℝ) (U : Λ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (K : Λ → ℝ)

    (hU : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z : O, 0 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / K l)).re)
    (hmajor : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows,
      1 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / K l)).re) :
    (∑ l ∈ labels, ∑ z ∈ rows,
      ‖(s l).leftValue (t₁ l) z‖ * ‖(s l).rightValue (t₂ l) z‖) ≤
      Real.sqrt (∑ l ∈ labels, (s l).leftEnergy (t₁ l) (U l) (K l)) *
      Real.sqrt (∑ l ∈ labels, (s l).rightEnergy (t₂ l) (U l) (K l))

      Real.sqrt (∑ l ∈ labels, (s l).leftEnergy (t₁ l) (U l) (K l)) *
      Real.sqrt (∑ l ∈ labels, (s l).rightEnergy (t₂ l) (U l) (K l))

statement:
theorem eventually_first_fourier_targets_of_annular (ν η : ℝ) (hgap : ν < η) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
    ∀ {Λ Slot : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ] [Fintype Slot]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (q : Λ → FirstJointLabel Slot) (ref : FirstJointLabel Slot)
      (t H : Λ → ℝ) (V A Ch : ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ labels,|t i| ≤ Z^ν) →
      (∀ u : Bool → ((i : Λ) × (q i).SourceIndex) → ℝ,
        (∀ left,∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,|u left k| ≤ Z^η) →
        ∀ left,
          (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,
            ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).sideEnergy left (u left k) profile (H k.1)) ≤
          (V/((ref.sideCommon left).absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(ref.sideTargetWidth left Z A))) →
      ∀ θ w : ℝ,‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖w‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,
          ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) profile (H k.1)) ≤
          (V/(ref.C.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(ref.leftTargetWidth Z A)) ∧
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,
          ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-(-θ))) profile (H k.1)) ≤
          (V/(ref.D.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(ref.rightTargetWidth Z A))

statement:
theorem uniform_first_full_sector_sum (B e : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (he : 0 < e) :
    ∃ Ccells : ℝ, 0 < Ccells ∧
    ∀ {Row Slot : Type*} [DecidableEq Row] [Fintype Slot]
      (labels : Finset Row) (q : Row → FirstJointLabel Slot) (Z : ℝ), 1 < Z →
      (∀ u ∈ labels,(q u).C.absNorm ≤ (Z^B : ℝ) ∧ (q u).D.absNorm ≤ (Z^B : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (f : Row → ℝ) (H : ℝ), 0 ≤ H →
      (∀ (cell : Finset Row),cell ⊆ labels → ∀ ref ∈ cell,
        (∀ u ∈ cell,∀ j,|(q u).fullWidthCoordinates Z j-(q ref).fullWidthCoordinates Z j| < e) →
        (∀ u ∈ cell,(q ref).activeWidth Z/2+(q ref).punctureWidth Z ≤
          (q u).activeWidth Z/2+(q u).punctureWidth Z) →
        (∑ u ∈ cell,f u) ≤ H) →
      (∑ u ∈ labels,f u) ≤ Ccells*H

theorem actual_natural_coarse_energy
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (hW : Continuous W) (aslot bslot lo hi a b : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hWs : Function.support W ⊆ Set.Icc aslot bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (p : Profiles a b) (Φ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ,0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (Z Bmask bΦ : ℝ),1 < Z →
      ∀ (s : NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ),s.rowWidth=1 → s.radial.profile=Φ →
      ∀ (η₀ : Character) (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ)
        (hσ : ∀ i,σ i∈Set.Icc lo hi) (t X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0< X₁) (hX₂ : 0< X₂),
      Real.logb Z X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z X₂ ≤ 423/1000 → (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      energy s.character s.mask 1 t (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i=> CenteredMomentPrimeSlot.primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun i I=> idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I*
          HeckePrimeAnnular.annularWeight W (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (freq i) I)
        (fun i=> Z^(w i)) X₁ X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤ C*Z^(2:ℝ)
title: actual_natural_coarse_energy

theorem sum_packet_cells
    (hs : Squarefree seed) (hz₁ : src.W₁ 0=0) (hz₂ : src.W₂ 0=0)
    (X : Finset (Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H))
    (cell : Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H → Cell)
    (V P : ℝ) (t : First src R seed Kfirst radius → ℝ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (∑ x∈X,packetValue hs hz₁ hz₂ V P t W x) =
      ∑ c : Cell, ∑ χ : RayCharacter, ∑ ξ : RayCharacter,
        ∑ x∈rayPackets (X.filter (fun x => cell x=c)) χ ξ,
          packetValue hs hz₁ hz₂ V P t W x

theorem block_eq_kernel_children (s : FirstJointLabel ι) (t : ℝ)
    (rows : Finset O) (hrows : ∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ) (K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hK₀ : 0 < K₀) (hH₀ : 0 < H₀) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀) :
    block s.parent (fixedBadMask * idealGenerator s.data.R) 1 t s.data.columns s.data.beta
      s.C s.D s.hC s.hD s.E rows W V K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ =
    scalar s.C s.D s.hC s.E K A₀ B₀ *
      ∑ L ∈ s.projectors, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ) *
        ∑ χ : RayCharacter, ∑ ξ : RayCharacter, pairCoeff firstPhaseTable χ ξ *
          (s.childLabel L χ ξ).kernelBlock t rows W V (K₀ * H₀ / (A₀ * B₀))
            (Real.log ((K / ‖eisEmbedding s.puncture‖ ^ 2 /
              ‖eisEmbedding (activeConductor s.C s.D)‖ ^ 2) / K₀))
            (fun z => Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀)) A₀ B₀
            (fun z => star (s.activeRow z) * s.activeRow s.puncture)

statement:
theorem joint_first_blocks_from_common_energy
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay P₁ P₂ J₁ J₂ : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (t K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ) (η : Λ → ℂ),
      (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K l) → (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) →
      (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ i : (s l).SourceIndex,
        ‖η l * (s l).sourceWeight (K l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l) i‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (K l) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      ∀ E₁ E₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ E₁ → 0 ≤ E₂ →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (E₁ * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₁) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₁)) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - (-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (E₂ * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₂) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₂)) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) * η l *

statement:
theorem sourceBlock_eq_sum (s : FirstJointLabel ι) (t : ℝ)
    (rows : Finset O) (hrows : ∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ) (K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hK₀ : 0 < K₀) (hH₀ : 0 < H₀) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀) :
    s.sourceBlock t rows W V K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ =
      ∑ i : s.SourceIndex, s.sourceWeight K A₀ B₀ i *
        (s.sourceChild i).kernelBlock t rows W V (K₀ * H₀ / (A₀ * B₀))
          (s.sourceRowLog K K₀) (fun z => Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀))
          A₀ B₀ s.sourcePhase

statement:
theorem joint_first_blocks_from_local_common_energy
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay : ℕ) (ν B lower : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (target₁ target₂ Z Ch₁ Ch₂ Ct₁ Ct₂ : ℝ),
      lower ≤ target₁ → lower ≤ target₂ → 1 ≤ Z →
      0 ≤ Ch₁ → 0 ≤ Ch₂ → 0 ≤ Ct₁ → 0 ≤ Ct₂ →
      ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (t K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ) (η : Λ → ℂ),
      (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K l) → (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) →
      (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ i : (s l).SourceIndex,
        ‖η l * (s l).sourceWeight (K l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l) i‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (K l) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖w‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
          ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
            (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤ Ch₁*Z^target₁) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖w‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
          ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
            (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-(-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤ Ch₂*Z^target₂) →
      (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftCoarse (U k) (H k)) ≤ Ct₁*Z^B →
      (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightCoarse (U k) (H k)) ≤ Ct₂*Z^B →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) * η l *
        (s l).sourceBlock (t l) rows W V (K l) (K₀ l) (H₀ l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ ≤
          C * (Real.sqrt ((Ch₁+Ct₁)*Z^target₁) * Real.sqrt ((Ch₂+Ct₂)*Z^target₂))
title: joint_first_blocks_from_local_common_energy

statement:
theorem joint_first_centered_blocks_from_scalar_cap
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (Mwin : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hMwin : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay P₁ P₂ J₁ J₂ : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (t K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K l) → (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) →
      (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      ∀ F T NC ND : ℝ, 0 < F → 0 < T → 0 < NC → 0 < ND →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖scalar (s l).C (s l).D (s l).hC (s l).E (K l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ ≤ F) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (K l) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      ∀ E₁ E₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ E₁ → 0 ≤ E₂ →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (((T/NC)*E₁) * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₁) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₁)) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - (-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (((T/ND)*E₂) * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₂) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₂)) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (s l).sourceBlock (t l) rows W V (K l) (K₀ l) (H₀ l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ / T ≤
          C * (F/Real.sqrt (NC*ND)) * (Real.sqrt E₁ * Real.sqrt E₂)
title: joint_first_centered_blocks_from_scalar_cap

theorem joint_first_centered_sector_from_joint_targets
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (Mwin : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hMwin : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay P₁ P₂ J₁ J₂ : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (q : FirstJointLabel ι) (Z M A δ a window : ℝ), 1 < Z → 0 < a →
      ∀ (t K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*A₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.C.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.D.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, q.activeWidth Z ≤ (s l).activeWidth Z) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, q.punctureWidth Z ≤ (s l).punctureWidth Z) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (Z^M) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (((Z^A/(q.C.absNorm : ℝ))*Z^(q.leftTargetWidth Z A)) *
              ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₁) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₁)) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - (-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (((Z^A/(q.D.absNorm : ℝ))*Z^(q.rightTargetWidth Z A)) *
              ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₂) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₂)) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (s l).sourceBlock (t l) rows W V (Z^M) (K₀ l) (H₀ l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ / Z^A ≤
          C * (Real.exp window/a) * Z^(M+δ)
title: joint_first_centered_sector_from_joint_targets

theorem joint_first_centered_sector_from_local_joint_targets
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (Mwin : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hMwin : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ Mwin i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay : ℕ) (ν B lower : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (q : FirstJointLabel ι) (Z M A δ a window Ch Ct : ℝ), 1 < Z → 0 < a →
      0 ≤ Ch → 0 ≤ Ct → lower ≤ q.leftTargetWidth Z A → lower ≤ q.rightTargetWidth Z A →
      ∀ (t K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ rows, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*A₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, a*Z^A ≤ ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ)*Real.exp window*B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).C.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.C.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ((s l).D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^δ*(q.D.absNorm : ℝ)) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, q.activeWidth Z/2+q.punctureWidth Z ≤
        (s l).activeWidth Z/2+(s l).punctureWidth Z) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (Z^M) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖w‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
          ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
            (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤
          (Z^A/(q.C.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(q.leftTargetWidth Z A))) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖w‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
          ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
            (t k.1+2*Real.pi*(w-(-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
          (Z^A/(q.D.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ch*Z^(q.rightTargetWidth Z A))) →
      (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftCoarse (U k) (H k)) ≤
          (Z^A/(q.C.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ct*Z^B) →
      (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightCoarse (U k) (H k)) ≤
          (Z^A/(q.D.absNorm : ℝ))*(Ct*Z^B) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (s l).sourceBlock (t l) rows W V (Z^M) (K₀ l) (H₀ l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ / Z^A ≤
          C * (Ch+Ct) * (Real.exp window/a) * Z^(M+δ)

statement:

    (Wslot:ℝ→ℂ)(aslot bslot lo hi a b bΦ Bmask upper bplain₁ bplain₂ ε ξ:ℝ)

    ∃mesh:ℝ,0< mesh ∧ ∃J:ℕ,∃U Sd St:Finset (ℕ×ℕ),∃Cd Ct:ℝ,0< Cd ∧ 0< Ct ∧
    ∀ηfirst η₀:Character,∀Q:Ideal O,Q≤ M → internalQ Q η₀≠0 → internalQ Q η₀≠⊤ →
      internalQ Q η₀≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)} →
    ∃Cc:ℝ,0< Cc ∧ ∀ᶠZ:ℝ in atTop,1< Z ∧
      ∀(src:Input α)(profile:Profiles a b),
      profile.profile 0=src.W₁ → profile.profile 1=src.W₂ →
      (∀i,|src.hi i|≤ upper) → |src.b₁|≤ bplain₁ → |src.b₂|≤ bplain₂ → src.upper≤ upper →

statement:
theorem sum_ray_fibers (fallback : First src R seed Kfirst radius)
    (X : Finset (Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H))
    (hzero : ∀ x∈X,(row x).z≠0) (χ ξ : RayCharacter)
    (V P : ℝ) (t : First src R seed Kfirst radius → ℝ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) :
    (∑ x∈rayPackets X χ ξ,packetValue hs hz₁ hz₂ V P t W x) =
      ∑ q∈rayRows fallback X hzero χ ξ,
        ∑ n₁ : q.val.FirstDyadic Kfirst (radius q.val.first q.val.E) (sourceRadius src),
        ∑ n₂ : q.val.SecondDyadic (secondScale fallback K χ ξ q.val n₁)
          (secondScale fallback Radius χ ξ q.val n₁) (secondScale fallback H χ ξ q.val n₁),
        if (⟨q,n₁,n₂⟩ : FiberTarget fallback χ ξ K Radius H side)∈rayTarget fallback X hzero χ ξ
        then fiberValue hs hz₁ hz₂ fallback χ ξ V P t W ⟨q,n₁,n₂⟩ else 0
title: sum_ray_fibers

statement:
theorem sum_packets {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (labels : Finset (FirstSourceOuterIndex src R seed Kfirst radius))
    (rows : (k : First src R seed Kfirst radius) → Blocks src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H k → Finset O)
    (f : Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H → A) :
    (∑ x ∈ packets src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H labels rows,f x) =
      ∑ k ∈ firstSideSourceLabels labels (firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius)
        (fun _ => sourceRadius src) side,
        ∑ b : Blocks src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H k, ∑ z ∈ rows k b,f ⟨k,b,z⟩
title: sum_packets

statement:
theorem first_sideEnergy_from_supported_normalized
    (labels : Finset Λ) (q : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι) (ref : FirstJointLabel ι)
    (H : Λ → ℝ)
    (hsource : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ I, (q l).data.beta I ≠ 0 → (I.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ H l)
    (left : Bool) (t : ((l : Λ) × (q l).SourceIndex) → ℝ)
    (W : ((l : Λ) × (q l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))
    (K : ((l : Λ) × (q l).SourceIndex) → ℝ)
    (V Z A C loss : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V) (hZ : 1 < Z)
    (hbound : (∑ k ∈ firstSideSourceLabels labels q H left,
      ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).sideEnergy left (t k) (W k) (K k)/V) ≤
      C*Z^(ref.radicalWidth Z+A-2*ref.sideWidth left Z+ref.activeWidth Z+
        ref.punctureWidth Z+ref.sideAllowance left Z+loss)) :
    (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels q,
      ((q k.1).sourceChild k.2).sideEnergy left (t k) (W k) (K k)) ≤
      (V/(ref.sideCommon left).absNorm : ℝ)*
        (C*Z^(ref.sideTargetWidth left Z A+loss))
title: first_sideEnergy_from_supported_normalized

    (∀ p E, radius p E ≤ Cr*Z^L) →
    (Fintype.card (FirstSourceOuterIndex s R seed K radius) : ℝ) ≤ Z^(3*B+2)

theorem joint_first_variable_blocks_from_common_energy
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i)
    (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport (V 2)) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 2))
    (hV₃c : HasCompactSupport (V 3)) (hV₃s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V 3))
    (decay P₁ P₂ J₁ J₂ : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
      (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Λ → Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
      (t K K₀ H₀ A₀ B₀ : Λ → ℝ) (η : Λ → ℂ),
      (∀ l, ∀ z ∈ rows l, z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ l, 0 < K l) → (∀ l, 0 < K₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < H₀ l) →
      (∀ l, 0 < A₀ l) → (∀ l, 0 < B₀ l) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ i : (s l).SourceIndex,
        ‖η l * (s l).sourceWeight (K l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l) i‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ‖V 0 ((s l).sourceRowLog (K l) (K₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows l, ‖V 1 (Real.log (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H₀ l))‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (U : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ))
        (H : ((l : Λ) × (s l).SourceIndex) → ℝ),
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, 0 < H k) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z : O,
        0 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      (∀ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s, ∀ z ∈ rows k.1,
        1 ≤ (U k (‖eisEmbedding z‖ ^ 2 / H k)).re) →
      ∀ E₁ E₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ E₁ → 0 ≤ E₂ →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).leftEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - θ)) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (E₁ * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₁) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₁)) →
      (∀ θ w : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ firstSourceLabels labels s,
        ((s k.1).sourceChild k.2).rightEnergy
          (t k.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (w - (-θ))) (U k) (H k)) ≤
            (E₂ * ((1 + ‖θ‖) ^ P₂) ^ 2) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 * J₂)) →
      ‖∑ l ∈ labels, (((1 + K₀ l * H₀ l / (A₀ l * B₀ l)) ^ decay : ℝ) : ℂ) * η l *
        (s l).sourceBlock (t l) (rows l) W V (K l) (K₀ l) (H₀ l) (A₀ l) (B₀ l)‖ ≤
          C * (Real.sqrt E₁ * Real.sqrt E₂)

    (V₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport V₂) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V₂)
    (U : Λ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (K : Λ → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < K l)

    (hmajor : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows l,
      1 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖^2 / K l)).re)
    (J₁ J₂ : ℕ) (E₁ E₂ : ℝ) (hE₁ : 0 ≤ E₁) (hE₂ : 0 ≤ E₂)
    (hleft : ∀ w : ℝ, (∑ l ∈ labels,
      (s l).leftEnergy (t₁ l+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) (U l) (K l)) ≤

      ‖(s l).rightWindowValue (t₂ l) θ (X₂ l) V₂ z‖) ≤
      (Real.sqrt E₁ * jointColumnMoment V₁ hV₁c hV₁s J₁) *

theorem joint_first_left_window_energy {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
    (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
    (t X : Λ → ℝ) (hX : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < X l) (θ : ℝ)
    (V : ℝ → ℂ) (hVc : HasCompactSupport V) (hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (U : Λ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (K : Λ → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < K l)
    (hU : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z : O, 0 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖^2 / K l)).re)
    (hmajor : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows,
      1 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖^2 / K l)).re)
    (J : ℕ) (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (henergy : ∀ w : ℝ, (∑ l ∈ labels,
      (s l).leftEnergy (t l+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) (U l) (K l)) ≤
        E*(1+‖w‖)^(2*J)) :
    (∑ l ∈ labels, ∑ z ∈ rows, ‖(s l).leftWindowValue (t l) θ (X l) V z‖^2) ≤
      E*(∫ w : ℝ, (1+‖w‖)^J * ‖columnDensity V hVc hVs w‖)^2
title: joint_first_left_window_energy

statement:
theorem joint_first_window_abs_bound {Λ : Type*} [DecidableEq Λ]
    (labels : Finset Λ) (rows : Finset O) (s : Λ → FirstJointLabel ι)
    (t₁ t₂ X₁ X₂ : Λ → ℝ)
    (hX₁ : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < X₁ l) (hX₂ : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < X₂ l) (θ : ℝ)
    (V₁ : ℝ → ℂ) (hV₁c : HasCompactSupport V₁) (hV₁s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V₁)
    (V₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (hV₂c : HasCompactSupport V₂) (hV₂s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V₂)
    (U : Λ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℂ)) (K : Λ → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 < K l)
    (hU : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z : O, 0 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖^2 / K l)).re)
    (hmajor : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ z ∈ rows,
      1 ≤ (U l (‖eisEmbedding z‖^2 / K l)).re)
    (J₁ J₂ : ℕ) (E₁ E₂ : ℝ) (hE₁ : 0 ≤ E₁) (hE₂ : 0 ≤ E₂)
    (hleft : ∀ w : ℝ, (∑ l ∈ labels,
      (s l).leftEnergy (t₁ l+2*Real.pi*(w-θ)) (U l) (K l)) ≤
        E₁*(1+‖w‖)^(2*J₁))
    (hright : ∀ w : ℝ, (∑ l ∈ labels,
      (s l).rightEnergy (t₂ l+2*Real.pi*(w-(-θ))) (U l) (K l)) ≤
        E₂*(1+‖w‖)^(2*J₂)) :
    (∑ l ∈ labels, ∑ z ∈ rows,
      ‖(s l).leftWindowValue (t₁ l) θ (X₁ l) V₁ z‖ *
      ‖(s l).rightWindowValue (t₂ l) θ (X₂ l) V₂ z‖) ≤
      (Real.sqrt E₁ * jointColumnMoment V₁ hV₁c hV₁s J₁) *
      (Real.sqrt E₂ * jointColumnMoment (fun x => star (V₂ x))
        (conjugate_compact V₂ hV₂c) (conjugate_smooth V₂ hV₂s) J₂)
title: joint_first_window_abs_bound

statement:
theorem whole_kernel_common_majorant (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i) (A J : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ b : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ),
      (∀ ρ x u v : ℝ, wholeKernel W V R ρ x u v =
        ∫ t : ℝ, separatedKernel V ρ x u v t*b t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, (1+R)^A*‖b t‖ ≤ C*firstLogDensity J t)
title: whole_kernel_common_majorant

      ∀ θ u v, F θ u v ≤ (Ch+Ct)*Z^target*(1+‖θ‖)^N*(1+‖u‖)^N*(1+‖v‖)^N

    ∃ I : ℕ, 0 < I ∧ ∀ (η η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O)
      (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)}) (hQM : Q ≤ M) (hQη₀ : Q ≤ η₀.modulus)
      (T : ℝ), 2 < T →
    ∃ bin : NonzeroElement → Option (Fin (I+1) × Fin (I+1)),
      (∀ w,bin w = none ↔ FixedInducingRow η Q fixedBadMask 1 w.val) ∧
      (∀ w b,bin w = some b → 1 ≤ b.1.val ∧
        51/100 ≤ 51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ) ∧
        51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ) ≤ 7/8 ∧
        (∀ (R : JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
          (hR : ∀ label,R label ≠ 0),
          jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Slot => η₀))

              (fun _ => hQη₀)) R hR
            (51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ)) (51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ)+e)
            ((3*(b.1.val+1):ℕ)*T) w))

statement:
theorem actual_joint_high_contribution
    (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (Aprofile Bprofile : Slot → ℝ) (hA : ∀ j, 0 < Aprofile j)
    (hVs : ∀ j, Function.support (V j) ⊆ Icc (Aprofile j) (Bprofile j))
    (hV : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V j))
    (Rwidth dmax ε e κ ηaux σmin σmax productLoss populationLoss loss B : ℝ)
    (hRw : 0 ≤ Rwidth) (hdmax : 0 ≤ dmax) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκone : κ ≤ 1) (hη : 0 < ηaux)
    (hbudget : 12*e*(Rwidth+2)+8*κ+2*ηaux ≤ ε)
    (hprimebudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ ε)
    (hproductLoss : (2+2*(Fintype.card Slot : ℝ))*ε ≤ productLoss)
    (hpopulationLoss : 0 < populationLoss) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hloss : populationLoss+dmax*productLoss ≤ loss)
    (τdetector dmin heightLoss : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
    (hτdetector : 0 < τdetector) (hdmin : 0 < dmin) (hheightLoss : 0 < heightLoss)
    (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (hprofile : ∀ k, 0 ≤ profileBound k) :
    ∃ (τ ν : ℝ) (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ),
      0 < ν ∧ ν < τ ∧ τ < τdetector ∧ 4*τ < dmin*ηaux ∧
      (∀ J, orders J ≤ N) ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (Z d P W : ℝ), 1 < Z → 0 ≤ d → d ≤ dmax → 2 ≤ Z^d → 2 < Z^τ →
      P ≤ B → W ≤ B →
      ∀ (p : DensityWindow), p.upper < p.lower+2*e →
      ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ I → p.height = (3*(i+1 : ℕ))*Z^τ →
      ∀ (unit : JointReconstructionLabel → Oˣ) (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel)
        (w : JointReconstructionLabel → NonzeroElement),
      (∀ v ∈ S, (w v).val = v.row (unit v)) →
      ∀ (R : JointReconstructionLabel →
        JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
        (hR : ∀ v label, R v label ≠ 0),
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧
        primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH η₀) Q hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH η₀ Q hQM hQη₀) (R v) (hR v)
        p.lower p.upper p.height (w v)) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {(w v).val}) : ℝ) ≤ Z^W) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (jointMissingRadical v.C₁ (w v).val) : ℝ) ≤ Z^P) →
      ∀ (DL DR : ∀ v, SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound p.lower e),
      (∀ v ∈ S, (DL v).Admissible M H hH η₀ Aprofile Bprofile
        Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d p.height) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (DR v).Admissible M H hH η₀ Aprofile Bprofile
        Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d p.height) →
      ∀ (A c d₁ π R₁ R₀ E Bc L b₂ g₂ t₂ omegaLoss geometryLoss lengthLoss missingLoss c₂ d₂ : ℝ),
      2*b₂ = c₂+d₂ →
      (∀ v ∈ S, d*(DL v).length ≤ A-c-c₂+lengthLoss) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, d*(DR v).length ≤ A-c-d₂+lengthLoss) →
      67/100 ≤ 2*p.lower-1 → 2*p.lower-1 ≤ 3/4 → A ≤ 883/1000 →
      0 ≤ π → π ≤ c → π ≤ d₁ → R₁ ≤ π →
      0 ≤ R₀ → 0 ≤ E → 0 ≤ Bc → L ≤ 5*(R₁-R₀) →
      0 ≤ b₂ → g₂ ≤ b₂ → 0 ≤ t₂ →
      0 ≤ geometryLoss → 0 ≤ lengthLoss →
      W ≤ 1-R₁-max (c-d₁) 0+L-6*(3/500)+geometryLoss →
      P ≤ π-R₁-E+R₀+missingLoss →
      omegaLoss+loss+heightLoss+geometryLoss+lengthLoss+missingLoss ≤ 144011/109800000 →
      Z^(A-min c d₁+R₁+E-1+5*(3/500)+g₂-t₂-b₂+omegaLoss)*
        (∑ v ∈ S, ‖(DL v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖ *
          ‖(DR v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖) ≤
        C*Z^(π+A-c+R₁+E+Bc-144011/109800000)

    Z^(firstMainExponent A (ref.sideWidth side Z-e) (ref.sideWidth (!side) Z-e)
        (ref.activeWidth Z) (ref.punctureWidth Z) M (3/500) (omega-8*e)) ≤

theorem recovered_main_sector_bounds
    (fallback : First src R seed Kfirst radius)
    (x : Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H)
    (ref : FirstJointLabel ι) (Z A M omega e : ℝ) (hZ : 1 < Z) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hc : |(firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius x.1.1).sideWidth side Z-ref.sideWidth side Z| ≤ e)
    (hd : |(firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius x.1.1).sideWidth (!side) Z-ref.sideWidth (!side) Z| ≤ e)
    (hR : |(firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius x.1.1).activeWidth Z-ref.activeWidth Z| ≤ e)
    (hE : |(firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Kfirst radius x.1.1).punctureWidth Z-ref.punctureWidth Z| ≤ e)
    (n : (row x).FirstDyadic Kfirst (radius (row x).first (row x).E) (sourceRadius src)) :
    secondScale fallback (mainScale src R seed Kfirst radius side Z A M omega)
        x.1.2.2.1 x.1.2.2.2 (row x) n ≤
      Z^(firstMainExponent A (ref.sideWidth side Z) (ref.sideWidth (!side) Z)
        (ref.activeWidth Z) (ref.punctureWidth Z) M (3/500) (omega+6*e)) ∧
    Z^(firstMainExponent A (ref.sideWidth side Z-e) (ref.sideWidth (!side) Z-e)
        (ref.activeWidth Z) (ref.punctureWidth Z) M (3/500) (omega-8*e)) ≤
      secondScale fallback (mainScale src R seed Kfirst radius side Z A M omega)
        x.1.2.2.1 x.1.2.2.2 (row x) n
title: recovered_main_sector_bounds

    Z^(ref.sideWidth side Z-e) ≤ ((q.sideCommon side).absNorm : ℝ) ∧
    normValue q.puncture ≤ Z^(ref.punctureWidth Z+e) ∧
    normValue (leftEffectiveFactor (q.sideCommon side) (q.sideCommon (!side))) ≤
      Z^(Real.logb Z (normValue (leftEffectiveFactor (ref.sideCommon side) (ref.sideCommon (!side))))+e) ∧
    Z^(ref.activeWidth Z-e) ≤ normValue (activeConductor q.C q.D) ∧

    ((canceledIdeal (q.sideCommon side) (q.sideCommon (!side)) 5).absNorm : ℝ) ≤
      Z^(Real.logb Z ((canceledIdeal (ref.sideCommon side) (ref.sideCommon (!side)) 5).absNorm : ℝ)+e)

theorem actual_joint_high_kernel_contribution
    (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (Aprofile Bprofile : Slot → ℝ) (hA : ∀ j, 0 < Aprofile j)
    (hVs : ∀ j, Function.support (V j) ⊆ Icc (Aprofile j) (Bprofile j))
    (hV : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V j))
    (ηcommon : Character) (hanchor : ∀ j, η₀ j = ηcommon)
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (hVslot : ∀ j, V j = Wslot)
    (bslot : ℝ) (hBslot : ∀ j, Bprofile j = bslot)
    (Rwidth dmax ε e κ ηaux σmin σmax productLoss populationLoss loss B : ℝ)
    (hRw : 0 ≤ Rwidth) (hdmax : 0 ≤ dmax) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκone : κ ≤ 1) (hη : 0 < ηaux)
    (hbudget : 12*e*(Rwidth+2)+8*κ+2*ηaux ≤ ε)
    (hprimebudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ ε)
    (hproductLoss : (2+2*(Fintype.card Slot : ℝ))*ε ≤ productLoss)
    (hpopulationLoss : 0 < populationLoss) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hloss : populationLoss+dmax*productLoss ≤ loss)
    (τdetector dmin heightLoss : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
    (hτdetector : 0 < τdetector) (hdmin : 0 < dmin) (hheightLoss : 0 < heightLoss)
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂plain : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂plain) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂)
    (lo hi : Slot → ℝ) (fiberLoss : ℝ) (hfiberLoss : 0 < fiberLoss)
    (Wkernel : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (decay : ℕ)
    (tailA tailV targetLower plainBound₁ plainBound₂ : ℝ)
    (hplainBound₁ : 0 ≤ plainBound₁) (hplainBound₂ : 0 ≤ plainBound₂)
    (hplainNorm₁ : ∀ x, ‖W₁ x‖ ≤ plainBound₁) (hplainNorm₂ : ∀ x, ‖W₂ x‖ ≤ plainBound₂) :
    ∃ profileBound : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < profileBound k) ∧
    ∃ (τ ν : ℝ) (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (N Nkernel : ℕ) (C : ℝ),
      0 < ν ∧ ν < τ ∧ τ < τdetector ∧ 4*τ < dmin*ηaux ∧
      (∀ J, orders J ≤ N) ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (d P W : ℝ), 0 ≤ d → d ≤ dmax → 2 ≤ Z^d → 2 < Z^τ → P ≤ B → W ≤ B →
      ∀ (p : DensityWindow), p.upper < p.lower+2*e →
      ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ I → p.height = (3*(i+1 : ℕ))*Z^τ →
      ∀ (unit : JointReconstructionLabel → Oˣ) (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel)
        (w : JointReconstructionLabel → NonzeroElement),
      (∀ v ∈ S, (w v).val = v.row (unit v)) →
      ∀ (R : JointReconstructionLabel →
        JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
        (hR : ∀ v label, R v label ≠ 0),
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧ primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH η₀) Q hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH η₀ Q hQM hQη₀) (R v) (hR v)
        p.lower p.upper p.height (w v)) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {(w v).val}) : ℝ) ≤ Z^W) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (jointMissingRadical v.C₁ (w v).val) : ℝ) ≤ Z^P) →
      ∀ (s : JointReconstructionLabel → CommonSecondKernelLabel Slot)
        (Ds : JointReconstructionLabel → Finset (Ideal O))
        (z : JointReconstructionLabel → O) (t K Radius : JointReconstructionLabel → ℝ)
        (n : JointReconstructionLabel → Fin 4 → ℤ) (rayWeight : JointReconstructionLabel → ℂ)
        (σ freq : JointReconstructionLabel → Slot → ℝ)
        (θ : JointReconstructionLabel → Slot → RayQuotient.Characters M H)
        (slotWidth : JointReconstructionLabel → Slot → ℝ)
        (aSource : ℝ), 0 < aSource →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ‖rayWeight v‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (∀ j, (s v).input.lo j = lo j) ∧ (∀ j, (s v).input.hi j = hi j)) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.1).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^(2*B) ∧
        (((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.2).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^(2*B)) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ∀ L ∈ Ds v, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ) ≠ 0 →
        (L.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^(2*B)) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, 0 < dyadicScale (n v 2) ∧ 0 < dyadicScale (n v 3) ∧
        aSource*CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume (s v).input.toData/
          (((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.1).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ dyadicScale (n v 2) ∧
        aSource*CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume (s v).input.toData/
          (((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.2).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ dyadicScale (n v 3)) →
      ∀ (parentL parentR : JointReconstructionLabel → JointParentLabel η)
        (NL : ∀ v, CenteredMomentNaturalRowSource.NaturalRow (parentL v).val (w v).val)
        (NR : ∀ v, CenteredMomentNaturalRowSource.NaturalRow (parentR v).val (w v).val)
        (punctureL punctureR : JointReconstructionLabel → Ideal O),
      (∀ v, punctureL v ≠ 0) → (∀ v, punctureR v ≠ 0) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (s v).input.W₁ = W₁ ∧ (s v).input.W₂ = W₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, CenteredMomentAllocatedRayDictionary.Matches M H hH (s v).input

      (∀ v ∈ S, ∀ height : ℝ, ∀ J : Ideal O, CenteredMomentHeckeExpansion.rowWeight

        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator ((s v).puncture*((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.1)))
        (s v).toKernelLabel.frequency (z v) height J =
        CenteredMomentHeckeExpansion.rowWeight (parentL v).val
          (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (punctureL v)) 1 (w v).val height J) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ∀ height : ℝ, ∀ J : Ideal O, CenteredMomentHeckeExpansion.rowWeight
        (CenteredMomentChildRows.childCharacter (s v).parent ((s v).rightRay⁻¹))
        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator ((s v).puncture*((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.2)))
        (s v).toKernelLabel.frequency (-(z v)) height J =
        CenteredMomentHeckeExpansion.rowWeight (parentR v).val
          (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (punctureR v)) 1 (w v).val height J) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (s v).input.X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth ∧ (s v).input.X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth ∧
        (s v).input.Y₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth ∧ (s v).input.Y₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ∀ j, 1 ≤ (s v).input.P j ∧ (s v).input.P j ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (CenteredMomentNaturalRowSource.excluded (NL v).character (punctureL v)) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (CenteredMomentNaturalRowSource.excluded (NR v).character (punctureR v)) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      (∀ ξ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, ‖ξ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖u₁‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖u₂‖ ≤ Z^ν → ∀ v ∈ S, |(t v+2*Real.pi*(u₁-ξ))|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*i+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ ∧ |(t v+2*Real.pi*(u₂-(-ξ)))|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*i+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ) →
      (3+(3*i+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux → (3+(3*i+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →

theorem actual_literal_high_packet_data
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ modulus)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits modulus ≤ H)
    (η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)})
    (hQM : Q ≤ modulus) (hQη₀ : Q ≤ η₀.modulus)
    (Wslot : ℝ → ℂ) (bslot BR e σmin σmax : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (b₁ b₂plain : ℝ) (lo hi : Slot → ℝ) (Mslot upper : ℝ)
    (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O)) (Wkernel : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))
    (src : Input Slot) (R seed : Ideal O) (hs : Squarefree seed)
    (hz₁ : src.W₁ 0=0) (hz₂ : src.W₂ 0=0)

    (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (hτ : 2 < Z^τ) (hBR : 0 ≤ BR)
    (he : 0 < e) (heFirst : 0 ≤ eFirst) (heFirstCap : eFirst ≤ lowLocalTiny)
    (heSecond : 0 ≤ eSecond) (heSecondCap : eSecond ≤ lowLocalTiny)
    (hA₀ : 0 ≤ A) (hA : A ≤ 883/1000)
    (homega : 0 ≤ omega) (homegaCap : omega ≤ lowLocalTiny)
    (hξamp : ξamp ≤ 1) (hξsecond : 0 ≤ ξsecond) (hξsecondCap : ξsecond ≤ lowLocalTiny)
    (hR : R ≠ 0) (hRN : (R.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^BR)
    (hsource₀ : 0 < sourceRadius src) (hsource : sourceRadius src ≤ Z^(1:ℝ))
    (hsourceA : sourceRadius src ≤ Z^(A+lowLocalTiny))
    (hvolume : volume src.toData = Z^A)
    (hprofile : src.W₁ = W₁ ∧ src.W₂ = W₂)
    (hbplain : src.b₁ ≤ b₁ ∧ src.b₂ ≤ b₂plain)
    (hM : ∀ j,src.M j ≤ Mslot) (hupper : src.upper ≤ upper)
    (hlo : ∀ j,src.lo j = lo j) (hhi : ∀ j,src.hi j = hi j)
    (hsupport : (max 1 src.upper)^Fintype.card Slot ≤ Z^lowLocalTiny)
    (hclip : Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂plain) ≤ 2*lowLocalTiny)
    (θ : Slot → RayQuotient.Characters modulus H) (w σ freq : Slot → ℝ)
    (hmatch : CenteredMomentAllocatedRayDictionary.Matches modulus H hH src
      η₀ θ w σ freq Wslot bslot Z)
    (hP : ∀ j,src.P j = Z^(w j)) (hw : ∀ j,0 ≤ w j)
    (hwcap : ∀ j,w j ≤ lowLocalMesh)
    (hX₁ : Real.logb Z src.X₁ ≤ 423/1000) (hX₂ : Real.logb Z src.X₂ ≤ 423/1000)
    (hY₁ : Real.logb Z src.Y₁ ≤ 1) (hY₂ : Real.logb Z src.Y₂ ≤ 1)
    (hσ : ∀ j,σmin ≤ σ j ∧ σ j ≤ σmax) (hfreq : ∀ j,|freq j| ≤ Z^ν)
    (bin : NonzeroElement → Option (Fin (I+1) × Fin (I+1)))
    (b : Fin (I+1) × Fin (I+1))
    (hbinLower : 167/200 ≤ 51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ))
    (hbinUpper : 51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ) ≤ 7/8)
    (hclass : ∀ w b,bin w = some b →
      ∀ (P : JointRelativeLabel src.η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters modulus H)) → Ideal O)
        (hP : ∀ label,P label ≠ 0),
        jointRelativeSourceZeroBin src.η (relativeSlotTranslate modulus H hH (fun _ : Slot => η₀))
          Q hQ72 (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ modulus H hH (fun _ : Slot => η₀) Q hQM
            (fun _ => hQη₀)) P hP
          (51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ)) (51/100+(e/2)*(b.2.val : ℝ)+e)
          ((3*(b.1.val+1):ℕ)*Z^τ) w)

    (labels : Finset (FirstSourceOuterIndex src R seed Z (actualLowFirstRadius src R seed Z Z ξamp)))

    (ref : FirstJointLabel Slot)
    (hCref : (ref.C.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^(1:ℝ)) (hDref : (ref.D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^(1:ℝ))
    (hfull : ∀ i∈labels,∀ j,
      |(firstSourceOuterLabel src R seed Z (actualLowFirstRadius src R seed Z Z ξamp) i).fullWidthCoordinates Z j-
        ref.fullWidthCoordinates Z j| < eFirst)
    (X : Finset (LivePacket src R seed Z (actualLowFirstRadius src R seed Z Z ξamp)
      side Z A 1 omega ξsecond))
    (hX : X ⊆ liveBinPackets src R seed Z (actualLowFirstRadius src R seed Z Z ξamp)
      side Z A 1 omega ξsecond hs hz₁ hz₂ bin b height Wkernel labels)
    (hzero : ∀ x∈X,(row x).z≠0)
    (fallbackFirst : First src R seed Z (actualLowFirstRadius src R seed Z Z ξamp))
    (fallback : NonzeroJointSourceRow (original src R seed) side) (χ₁ ξ₁ : RayCharacter)
    (edge : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hedge : ∀ j,0 ≤ edge j)
    (hsector : ∀ v∈(rayRows fallbackFirst X hzero χ₁ ξ₁).image NonzeroJointSourceRow.label,∀ j,
      edge j ≤ (sourceKernel src R seed side hs hz₁ hz₂ fallback src.η χ₁ ξ₁⁻¹ 1 1 v).secondWidthCoordinates Z j ∧
      (sourceKernel src R seed side hs hz₁ hz₂ fallback src.η χ₁ ξ₁⁻¹ 1 1 v).secondWidthCoordinates Z j ≤ edge j+eSecond) :
    ∃ exponent : ℝ, LocalHighPacketData modulus H hH src.η η₀ Q hQ72 hQM hQη₀
      Wslot bslot BR e σmin σmax I W₁ W₂ b₁ b₂plain lo hi Mslot upper Sbad Wkernel Z τ ν
      (∑ x∈rayPackets X χ₁ ξ₁,packetValue hs hz₁ hz₂ (volume src.toData)
        (actualHighPrimeCount modulus H Sbad Z) height Wkernel x) exponent ∧
      exponent ≤ ref.radicalWidth Z+A-2*ref.sideWidth side Z+ref.activeWidth Z+
        ref.punctureWidth Z+ref.sideAllowance side Z-1/10000

statement:
theorem actual_joint_high_retained_contribution
    (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (Aprofile Bprofile : Slot → ℝ) (hA : ∀ j, 0 < Aprofile j)

    (hRw : 0 ≤ Rwidth) (hdmax : 0 ≤ dmax) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκone : κ ≤ 1) (hη : 0 < ηaux)
    (hbudget : 12*e*(Rwidth+2)+8*κ+2*ηaux ≤ ε)
    (hprimebudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ ε)
    (hproductLoss : (2+2*(Fintype.card Slot : ℝ))*ε ≤ productLoss)
    (hpopulationLoss : 0 < populationLoss) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hloss : populationLoss+dmax*productLoss ≤ loss)
    (τdetector dmin heightLoss : ℝ) (I : ℕ)
    (hτdetector : 0 < τdetector) (hdmin : 0 < dmin) (hheightLoss : 0 < heightLoss)
    (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (hprofile : ∀ k, 0 ≤ profileBound k)
    (lo hi : Slot → ℝ) (fiberLoss : ℝ) (hfiberLoss : 0 < fiberLoss) :
    ∃ (τ ν : ℝ) (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ),
      0 < ν ∧ ν < τ ∧ τ < τdetector ∧ 4*τ < dmin*ηaux ∧
      (∀ J, orders J ≤ N) ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (d P W : ℝ), 0 ≤ d → d ≤ dmax → 2 ≤ Z^d → 2 < Z^τ → P ≤ B → W ≤ B →
      ∀ (p : DensityWindow), p.upper < p.lower+2*e →
      ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ I → p.height = (3*(i+1 : ℕ))*Z^τ →
      ∀ (unit : JointReconstructionLabel → Oˣ) (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel)
        (w : JointReconstructionLabel → NonzeroElement),
      (∀ v ∈ S, (w v).val = v.row (unit v)) →
      ∀ (R : JointReconstructionLabel →
        JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
        (hR : ∀ v label, R v label ≠ 0),
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧ primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH η₀) Q hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH η₀ Q hQM hQη₀) (R v) (hR v)
        p.lower p.upper p.height (w v)) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →

theorem actual_local_independent_plain_moment
    (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)

    (hcSlot : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Wslot) (hbslot : 0 < bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hlo : a ≤ 1/4) (hhi : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbΦ : 0 < bΦ) (hBmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (ηfirst η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M)
    (hQzero : internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0) (hQtop : internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤)
    (hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72:O)})
    (hQη : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ ηfirst.modulus)
    (p : Profiles a b) (Wradial : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (hWradial : ∀ x, 0 ≤ (Wradial x).re) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (t₁ t₂ height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ meshGuaranteed Bmask ε) →
    ∀ (hσlo : ∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) (hσhi : ∀ i,σ i ≤ hi),
      0 ≤ height → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
    ∀ (X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (hX₁ : 0 < X₁) (hX₂ : 0 < X₂),
      410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₁ → 410/1000 ≤ Real.logb Z X₂ →
      Real.logb Z X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      2*Real.logb Z X₁+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
      2*Real.logb Z X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ s : NaturalState Z Bmask bΦ,
      s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀ → s.character = ηfirst → s.rowWidth = 1 →
      s.characterWidth = Real.logb Z (ηfirst.modulus.absNorm : ℝ) → s.radial.profile = Wradial →

        (fun i => CenteredMomentPrimeSlot.primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I*

        (fun i => Z^(w i)) t₁ t₂ X₁ X₂ s.radial.keep s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
        C*(1+|t₁|+|t₂|+height)^J*Z^(1+ε)

statement:
theorem whole_kernel_joint_estimate (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (V : Fin 4 → ℝ → ℂ)
    (M : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, 0 ≤ M i)
    (hV : ∀ i y, V i y ≠ 0 → |y| ≤ M i) (decay J : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {κ : Type*} {α β : κ → Type*}
      (rows : Finset κ) (S : (k : κ) → Finset (α k)) (T : (k : κ) → Finset (β k))
      (c : (k : κ) → α k → ℂ) (d : (k : κ) → β k → ℂ)
      (u : (k : κ) → α k → ℝ) (v : (k : κ) → β k → ℝ)
      (R ρ x : κ → ℝ) (η : κ → ℂ), (∀ k, 0 < R k) →
      (∀ k ∈ rows, ‖η k‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ k ∈ rows, ‖V 0 (ρ k)‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ k ∈ rows, ‖V 1 (x k)‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ E : ℝ,
      (∀ t : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ rows, ‖leftColumn (S k) (c k) (V 2) (u k) t‖*
        ‖rightColumn (T k) (d k) (V 3) (v k) t‖) ≤ E*(1+‖t‖)^J) →
      ‖∑ k ∈ rows, (((1+R k)^decay : ℝ):ℂ)*η k*
        (∑ i ∈ S k, ∑ j ∈ T k, (c k i*star (d k j))*
          wholeKernel W V (R k) (ρ k) (x k) (u k i) (v k j))‖ ≤ C*E
title: whole_kernel_joint_estimate

statement:
theorem actual_live_common_source_pointwise (lo hi : ι → ℝ) (Bcap δ : ℝ)
    (hBcap : 0 ≤ Bcap) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ C0 : ℝ,0 < C0 ∧ ∀ (s : Input ι),
      (∀ i,s.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i,s.hi i = hi i) →
      ∀ (r : Radial) (C : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C) (R seed L : Ideal O),
      seed ∣ C → Squarefree L → ∀ (E Z : ℝ),0 ≤ E → 1 < Z →
      (C.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Bcap → (L.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Bcap →
      (∀ B : actualAllocations s.pools C,
        frozenCoefficient B.val C R s.ν s.W s.P ≠ 0 →
        ∀ a ∈ (commonData s C R B).toSource.active L,
          childEnergy (commonData s C R B) r L a ≤ E) →
      sourceEnergy s r C hC R seed L ≤
        C0*Z^δ*(profileCost s*E)/((C.absNorm : ℝ)*L.absNorm)
title: actual_live_common_source_pointwise

theorem joint_error_four_average {Λ : Type*}
    (labels : Finset Λ) (weight : Λ → ℝ) (Hcoef exponent : Λ → Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (P : Finset (Ideal O)) (hne : P.Nonempty)
    (hp : ∀ Q ∈ P, Prime Q) (hbad : ∀ Q ∈ P, Q ∉ fixedBadPrimes)
    (Z : ℝ) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z)
    (f : elementPool P → Λ → Fin 3 → RayCharacter → Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ l ∈ labels, 0 ≤ weight l)
    (hH : ∀ l ∈ labels, ∀ j, 0 ≤ Hcoef l j)
    (hf : ∀ p l, l ∈ labels → ∀ i χ j, f p l i χ j ≤ Z^(exponent l j)) :
    (56/(P.card : ℝ))*(∑ p : elementPool P, ∑ l ∈ labels, weight l*
      ∑ i : Fin 3, 16*(errorIndex i+2 : ℝ)^2*
        ∑ χ : RayCharacter, ∑ j : Fin 4, Hcoef l j*f p l i χ j) ≤
      (56*1872*(Fintype.card RayCharacter : ℝ))*
        (∑ l ∈ labels, weight l*∑ j : Fin 4, Hcoef l j*Z^(exponent l j))
title: joint_error_four_average

statement:
theorem actual_joint_low_contribution
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot a b radial Bmask L lo hi Mcap εmoment : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hWs : Function.support W ⊆ Icc aslot bslot)
    (hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hbslot : 0 ≤ bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (haUpper : a ≤ 1/4) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hrad : 0 < radial)
    (hmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hMcap : 0 < Mcap) (hεmoment : 0 < εmoment)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (Rwidth d τ εslot e κ ηheight loss : ℝ)
    (hRw : 0 < Rwidth) (hd : 0 < d) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hεslot : 0 < εslot)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hη : 0 ≤ ηheight)
    (hbudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ εslot)
    (mesh : ℝ) (hmesh : 0 < mesh)
    (hmeshInc : mesh ≤ Cycle25.Energy.commonMesh Mcap Bmask L εmoment)
    (hmeshWidth : mesh ≤ d*Rwidth)
    (hmeshLoss : εmoment+(67/100)*mesh+2*d*εslot*(Fintype.card α) ≤ loss) :
    ∃ (degree : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)),
      ∀ (η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M), internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ → internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)} →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (J : Finset α) (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ v : α → ℝ)
        (t height : ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i, w i ≤ mesh) →
      (∀ i, lo ≤ σ i) → (∀ i, σ i ≤ hi) → 0 ≤ height → (∀ i, |v i| ≤ height) →
      ∀ (s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial) (hQ : s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀),
      s.width ≤ Mcap → ∀ (low : O → Prop) (abin : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
      51/100 ≤ abin → abin ≤ 167/200 → 2 ≤ Z^d → 2 < Z^τ →
      (∀ z, ∀ hz : s.radial.keep z, low z → NaturalLowGate M H hH s η₀ Q hQM hQ d τ e abin k z hz) →
      (∀ i ∈ J, |t+v i|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*k+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ) →
      (3+(3*k+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηheight →
      ∀ (p : Profiles a b) (X₁ X₂ : ℝ), 0 < X₁ → 0 < X₂ → X₁ ≤ Z^L → X₂ ≤ Z^L →
      ∀ nominal pad g allowance ledgerLoss : ℝ,
      0 ≤ pad → s.width ≤ nominal+pad → 0 ≤ g → g ≤ 37/10000 →
      3/500 ≤ allowance → 0 ≤ ledgerLoss →
      length Z X₁+length Z X₂+(9/2)*(∑ i ∈ J, w i)-nominal ≤ g+6*(3/500)+ledgerLoss →
      pad+loss+(67/450)*ledgerLoss ≤ 401/9000000 →
      energy s.character s.mask 1 t (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i : J => primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun (i : J) I => idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I *
          annularWeight W (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (v i) I)
        (fun i : J => Z^(w i)) X₁ X₂ (fun z => s.radial.keep z ∧ low z)
        s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
      C*diagonalControl s.radial.profile*(p.control S)^2*(1+|t|+height)^degree *
        Z^(nominal+allowance-401/9000000)
title: actual_joint_low_contribution

statement:
theorem eventually_supported_low_gate_of_deleted_common_bin
    {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] [Nonempty Slot]
    (η₀ : Character) (radial ξ : ℝ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (Bmask d : ℝ) (s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial),
      s.width+Bmask+ξ ≤ d →
      ∀ (η : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M)
        (hQ : s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀)
        (hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
        (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η) (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val)
        (R T : Ideal O), R ≠ 0 → T ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (z : O) (hz : (supportedNaturalState s).radial.keep z),
      (∀ I : Ideal O,
        idealCoeff (excluded (excluded
          (naturalRow s.character z (s.row_ne_zero z hz.1)).character s.puncture) T) I =
          idealCoeff (excluded N.character R) I) →
      ∀ (τ e a : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < e →
      ∀ (holes : JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
        (hholes : ∀ label,holes label ≠ 0),
      jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Slot => η₀))
        (internalQ Q η₀) hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH (fun _ : Slot => η₀) (internalQ Q η₀)
          (inf_le_left.trans hQM) (fun _ => inf_le_right))
        holes hholes a (a+e) (3*(k+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ) w →
      NaturalLowGate M H hH (supportedNaturalState s) η₀ Q hQM hQ d τ e a k z hz

statement:
theorem naturalLowGate_of_deleted_joint_maximum {Z Bmask radial : ℝ}
    (s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial) (η η₀ : Character)
    (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M) (hQ : s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀)
    (hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (w : NonzeroElement) (hex : ¬FixedInducingRow η (internalQ Q η₀) fixedBadMask 1 w.val)
    (parent : JointParentLabel η) (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val)
    (R T : Ideal O) (hR : R ≠ 0) (hT : T ≠ 0)
    (z : O) (hz : s.radial.keep z)
    (hcoeff : ∀ I : Ideal O,
      idealCoeff (excluded (excluded (naturalRow s.character z (s.row_ne_zero z hz)).character s.puncture) T) I =
        idealCoeff (excluded N.character R) I)
    (d τ e a : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hupper : zeroMaximum
      (fun label => (momentData (jointRelativeParent η
        (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀)) label)).character w)
      (jointRelativeMoment_nonprincipal η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀))
        (internalQ Q η₀) hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀) (internalQ Q η₀)
          (inf_le_left.trans hQM) (fun _ => inf_le_right)) w hex)
      (3*(k+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ) < a+2*e)
    (hconductor : ∀ θ : RayQuotient.Characters M H,
      (twistedFamily M H hH ((excluded
        (naturalRow s.character z (s.row_ne_zero z hz)).character s.puncture).product η₀.inverse) θ).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) :
    NaturalLowGate M H hH s η₀ Q hQM hQ d τ e a k z hz

theorem actual_first_low_bins_sum
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot a b Bmask L lo hi Mcap εmoment : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hWs : Function.support W ⊆ Icc aslot bslot)
    (hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hbslot : 0 ≤ bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (haUpper : a ≤ 1/4) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hMcap : 0 < Mcap) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hεmoment : 0 < εmoment)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (Rwidth d τ εslot e κ ηheight loss : ℝ)
    (hRw : 0 < Rwidth) (hd : 0 < d) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hεslot : 0 < εslot)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hη : 0 ≤ ηheight)
    (hbudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ εslot)
    (mesh : ℝ) (hmesh : 0 < mesh)
    (hmeshInc : mesh ≤ Cycle25.Energy.commonMesh Mcap Bmask L εmoment)
    (hmeshWidth : mesh ≤ d*Rwidth)
    (hmeshLoss : εmoment+(67/100)*mesh+2*d*εslot*(Fintype.card α) ≤ loss)
    (Mslot εmask : ℝ) (hMslot : 0 ≤ Mslot) (hεmask : 0 < εmask)
    (loInput hiInput : α → ℝ) (Bcommon δcommon : ℝ) (hBcommon : 0 ≤ Bcommon) (hδcommon : 0 < δcommon)
    (ηfirst : Character) (parentLoss : ℝ) (hparentLoss : 0 < parentLoss)
    (ξconductor : ℝ) (hξconductor : 0 < ξconductor)
    (Bfirst LfirstRad Crfirst εouter : ℝ)
    (hBfirst : 0 ≤ Bfirst) (hLfirstRad : 0 ≤ LfirstRad)
    (hCrfirst : 0 < Crfirst) (hεouter : 0 < εouter) :
    ∃ (degree : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)),
    ∀ (I : ℕ) (Wkernel : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (ν tailRows tailV lower tailSaving upper bplain₁ bplain₂ BRmask : ℝ)
      (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O)) (primeLoss Bsource Lrad Cr εsum : ℝ),
      0 < ν → ν < τ → 2*τ < d*ηheight → 0 ≤ tailRows → 0 < primeLoss → 0 ≤ Bsource → Bsource ≤ Bcommon →
      0 ≤ Lrad → 0 < Cr → 0 < εsum → Lrad+1 ≤ tailRows → Bfirst ≤ Bsource →
    ∃ (Nkernel : ℕ) (Ckernel Csum : ℝ), 0 ≤ Ckernel ∧ 0 < Csum ∧
    ∀ (η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M), internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)},
    ∃ Cbound : ℝ, 0 < Cbound ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ hZ : 1 < Z,
      ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ mesh) → (∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) → (∀ i,σ i ≤ hi) →
      0 ≤ height → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
      ∀ (p : Profiles a b) (src : Input α), Matches M H hH src η₀ θ w σ freq W bslot Z →
      (∀ i,src.hi i ≤ bslot) → (∀ i,src.M i ≤ Mslot) →
      p.profile 0 = src.W₁ → p.profile 1 = src.W₂ →
      (∀ i,src.lo i = loInput i) → (∀ i,src.hi i = hiInput i) →
      src.X₁ ≤ Z^L → src.X₂ ≤ Z^L → src.Y₁ ≤ Z^L → src.Y₂ ≤ Z^L →
      src.η = ηfirst →
      ∀ (Rmask seed : Ideal O), Rmask ≠ 0 → ∀ hs : Squarefree seed, seed ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (hz₁ : src.W₁ 0 = 0) (hz₂ : src.W₂ 0 = 0),
      0 < sourceRadius src → sourceRadius src ≤ Z^Bfirst →
      ∀ (Kfirst : ℝ), 0 < Kfirst →
      ∀ radius : (v : Labels src Rmask seed) → Finset (CommonIndex v.val.1 v.val.2) → ℝ,
      (∀ v E,radius v E ≤ Crfirst*Z^LfirstRad) →
      let q

statement:
theorem actual_local_first_low_target
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot a b lo hi Mslot upper bplain₁ bplain₂ BRmask : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hWs : Function.support W ⊆ Icc aslot bslot)
    (hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hbslot : 0 ≤ bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (haUpper : a ≤ 1/4) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hMslot : 0 ≤ Mslot) (hBRmask : 0 ≤ BRmask)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (loInput hiInput : α → ℝ) (hloInput : ∀ i,0 < loInput i)
    (ηfirst : Character) (profile : Profiles a b) (Wkernel : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))
    (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O)) (I : ℕ) (e τ : ℝ)
    (he : 0 < e) (hecap : e ≤ lowLocalBinCap (Fintype.card α))
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτcap : τ ≤ 1/8)
    (LfirstRad Crfirst : ℝ) (hLfirstRad : 0 ≤ LfirstRad) (hCrfirst : 0 < Crfirst) :
    ∃ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν ∧ ν < τ ∧
    ∀ (η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M), internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 → internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)},
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, ∀ hZ : 1 < Z,
    ∀ (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ freq : α → ℝ) (height : ℝ),
      (∀ i,0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i,w i ≤ lowLocalMesh) →
      (∀ i,lo ≤ σ i) → (∀ i,σ i ≤ hi) →
      0 ≤ height → height ≤ Z^ν → (∀ i,|freq i| ≤ height) →
    ∀ (src : Input α), Matches M H hH src η₀ θ w σ freq W bslot Z →
      (∀ i,src.hi i ≤ bslot) → (∀ i,src.M i ≤ Mslot) →
      profile.profile 0 = src.W₁ → profile.profile 1 = src.W₂ →
      (∀ i,src.lo i = loInput i) → (∀ i,src.hi i = hiInput i) →
      (∀ i,|src.hi i| ≤ upper) → src.upper ≤ upper →
      |src.b₁| ≤ bplain₁ → |src.b₂| ≤ bplain₂ → src.η = ηfirst →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁ ≤ 423/1000 → Real.logb Z src.X₂ ≤ 423/1000 →
      Real.logb Z src.Y₁ ≤ 1 → Real.logb Z src.Y₂ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i,w i) ≤ 37/1000 →
      Real.logb Z src.X₁+Real.logb Z src.X₂+(22/5)*(∑ i,w i) ≤ 1 →
    ∀ (Rmask seed : Ideal O), Rmask ≠ 0 → (Rmask.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^BRmask →
    ∀ hs : Squarefree seed, seed ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (hz₁ : src.W₁ 0 = 0) (hz₂ : src.W₂ 0 = 0), 0 < sourceRadius src →
    ∀ Kfirst : ℝ, 0 < Kfirst →
    ∀ radius : (v : Labels src Rmask seed) → Finset (CommonIndex v.val.1 v.val.2) → ℝ,
      (∀ v E,radius v E ≤ Crfirst*Z^LfirstRad) →
    let q
title: actual_local_first_low_target

statement:
theorem actual_joint_low_moment
    (W : ℝ → ℂ) (aslot bslot a b radial Bmask L lo hi Mcap εmoment : ℝ)
    (haslot : 0 < aslot) (hWs : Function.support W ⊆ Icc aslot bslot)
    (hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hbslot : 0 ≤ bslot)
    (ha : 0 < a) (haUpper : a ≤ 1/4) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hrad : 0 < radial)
    (hmask : 0 ≤ Bmask) (hMcap : 0 < Mcap) (hεmoment : 0 < εmoment)
    (hbeta : 51/100 ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta) (hbetaTop : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (Rwidth d τ εslot e κ ηheight loss : ℝ)
    (hRw : 0 < Rwidth) (hd : 0 < d) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hεslot : 0 < εslot)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hη : 0 ≤ ηheight)
    (hbudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ εslot)
    (mesh : ℝ) (hmesh : 0 < mesh)
    (hmeshInc : mesh ≤ Cycle25.Energy.commonMesh Mcap Bmask L εmoment)
    (hmeshWidth : mesh ≤ d*Rwidth)
    (hmeshLoss : εmoment+(67/100)*mesh+2*d*εslot*(Fintype.card α) ≤ loss) :
    ∃ (degree : ℕ) (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)),
      ∀ (η₀ : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M), internalQ Q η₀ ≠ 0 →
      internalQ Q η₀ ≠ ⊤ → internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)} →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (J : Finset α) (θ : α → RayQuotient.Characters M H) (w σ v : α → ℝ)
        (t height : ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i, w i ≤ mesh) →
      (∀ i, lo ≤ σ i) → (∀ i, σ i ≤ hi) → 0 ≤ height → (∀ i, |v i| ≤ height) →
      ∀ (s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial) (hQ : s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀),
      s.width ≤ Mcap → ∀ (low : O → Prop) (abin : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
      51/100 ≤ abin → abin ≤ 167/200 → 2 ≤ Z^d → 2 < Z^τ →
      (∀ z, ∀ hz : s.radial.keep z, low z → NaturalLowGate M H hH s η₀ Q hQM hQ d τ e abin k z hz) →
      (∀ i ∈ J, 2*(|Real.log aslot|+|Real.log bslot|)+1 ≤ Real.log (Z^(w i))) →
      (∀ i ∈ J, |t+v i|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*k+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ) →
      (3+(3*k+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηheight →
      ∀ (p : Profiles a b) (X₁ X₂ : ℝ), 0 < X₁ → 0 < X₂ → X₁ ≤ Z^L → X₂ ≤ Z^L →
      energy s.character s.mask 1 t (p.profile 0) (p.profile 1)
        (fun i : J => primePool M H bslot (Z^(w i)))
        (fun (i : J) I => idealCoeff (relativeCharacter M H hH η₀ (θ i)) I *
          annularWeight W (Z^(w i)) (σ i) (v i) I)
        (fun i : J => Z^(w i)) X₁ X₂ (fun z => s.radial.keep z ∧ low z)
        s.radial.profile s.radial.scale ≤
      C*diagonalControl s.radial.profile*(p.control S)^2*(1+|t|+height)^degree *
        Z^(s.width+(67/450)*max (length Z X₁+length Z X₂+(9/2)*(∑ i ∈ J, w i)-s.width) 0+loss)
title: actual_joint_low_moment

    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    (p : ActiveLabel (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
      (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁))
    (η : Character) (U : Finset (CommonIndex p.val.1 p.val.2))
    (family : RayCharacter → Character)
    (hfamily : Family η p.val.1 p.val.2 (lowActiveLeftSupported p) (lowActiveRightSupported p) U family)
    (χL χR : RayCharacter) (vL vR HL HR : ℝ) (hHL : 0 < HL) (hHR : 0 < HR)
    (L : Ideal O) (rL rR : Radial) (rows : Finset O)
    (hkeepL : ∀ z ∈ rows,rL.keep z) (hkeepR : ∀ z ∈ rows,rR.keep (-z))
    (hmajorL : ∀ z ∈ rows,1 ≤ (rL.profile (‖ConcreteTraceCRT.eisEmbedding z‖^2/rL.scale)).re)
    (hmajorR : ∀ z ∈ rows,1 ≤ (rR.profile (‖ConcreteTraceCRT.eisEmbedding (-z)‖^2/rR.scale)).re) :
    (∑ z ∈ rows,
      ‖secondChildValue η vL
        (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
        (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁) p.val.1 (lowActiveLeftSupported p)
        (commonFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2*nonunitFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2 U)
        L χL z HL‖ *
      ‖secondChildValue η vR
        (commonSecondColumns (original src R seed) C₁ hC₁)
        (commonSecondBeta (original src R seed) C₁ L₁) p.val.2 (lowActiveRightSupported p)
        (commonFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2*nonunitFrequencyGenerator p.val.1 p.val.2 U)
        L χR (-z) HR‖) ≤
      (volume src.toData/Real.sqrt (HL*HR))*
        (Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy (withHeight src (family χL) vL) rL (C₁*p.val.1)
          ((supported_mul_iff _ _).mpr ⟨hC₁,lowActiveLeftSupported p⟩) R seed L)*
         Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy (withHeight src (family χR) vR) rR (C₁*p.val.2)
          ((supported_mul_iff _ _).mpr ⟨hC₁,lowActiveRightSupported p⟩) R seed L))

theorem eventually_supported_low_gate
    (η₀ : Character) (radial ξ : ℝ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (Bmask d : ℝ) (s : NaturalState Z Bmask radial),
      s.width+Bmask+ξ ≤ d →
      ∀ (η : Character) (Q : Ideal O) (hQM : Q ≤ M)
        (hQ : s.fixedModulus = internalQ Q η₀)
        (hQ72 : internalQ Q η₀ ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)}),
      ∀ (w : NonzeroElement)
        (hex : ¬FixedInducingRow η (internalQ Q η₀) fixedBadMask 1 w.val),
      ∀ (parent : JointParentLabel η) (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val)
        (R : Ideal O), R ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (z : O) (hz : (supportedNaturalState s).radial.keep z),
      (∀ I : Ideal O,
        idealCoeff (excluded (naturalRow s.character z (s.row_ne_zero z hz.1)).character s.puncture) I =
          idealCoeff (excluded N.character R) I) →
      ∀ (τ e a : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
      zeroMaximum
          (fun label => (momentData (jointRelativeParent η
            (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀)) label)).character w)
          (jointRelativeMoment_nonprincipal η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀))
            (internalQ Q η₀) hQ72
            (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH (fun _ : Unit => η₀) (internalQ Q η₀)
              (inf_le_left.trans hQM) (fun _ => inf_le_right)) w hex)
          (3*(k+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ) < a+2*e →
      NaturalLowGate M H hH (supportedNaturalState s) η₀ Q hQM hQ d τ e a k z hz
title: eventually_supported_low_gate

    (fallback : First src R seed Kfirst radius)

    (X : Finset (Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H))
    {N : ℕ} (code : Packet src R seed Kfirst radius side K Radius H → Fin 4 → Fin (N+1))
    (cell : Fin 4 → Fin (N+1)) (Z e : ℝ)
    (hcode : ∀ x∈X, ∀ j, 0 ≤ secondWidthEdge e (code x) j ∧
      secondWidthEdge e (code x) j ≤ (packetLabel hs hz₁ hz₂ x).secondWidthCoordinates Z j ∧

    (hzero : ∀ x∈X.filter (fun x => code x=cell), (row x).z≠0)
    (v : JointReconstructionLabel)
    (hv : v ∈ (rayRows fallback (X.filter (fun x => code x=cell)) hzero χ ξ).image label) :
    ∀ j, 0 ≤ secondWidthEdge e cell j ∧
      secondWidthEdge e cell j ≤
        (sourceKernel src R seed side hs hz₁ hz₂ rowDefault η χ ξ⁻¹ χ₂ ξ₂ v).secondWidthCoordinates Z j ∧
      (sourceKernel src R seed side hs hz₁ hz₂ rowDefault η χ ξ⁻¹ χ₂ ξ₂ v).secondWidthCoordinates Z j ≤
        secondWidthEdge e cell j+e

statement:
theorem joint_population_count (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (u : Oˣ) (W : Finset O) (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel),
      (∀ w ∈ W, w ≠ 0) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧
        primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, v.row u ∈ W) →
      ∀ X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ Yw Yr : ℝ,
      0 < X₁ → 0 < Y₁ → 0 < X₂ → 0 < Y₂ → 0 ≤ Yw → 0 ≤ Yr →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ X₁ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Y₁ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ X₂ ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Y₂) →
      (∀ w ∈ W, (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {w}) : ℝ) ≤ Yw) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (jointMissingRadical v.C₁ (v.row u)) : ℝ) ≤ Yr) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K * W.card * Yr * X₁^a * Y₁^a * X₂^a * Y₂^a * (Yr*Yw)^(5*ε)
title: joint_population_count

statement:
theorem joint_reconstruction_fiber_count (a ε : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (u : Oˣ) (w : O), w ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (R : Ideal O), R ≠ 0 → ∀ S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel,
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧
        primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, v.row u = w ∧ jointMissingRadical v.C₁ w = R) →
      ∀ X₁ Y₁ X₂ Y₂ : ℝ, 0 < X₁ → 0 < Y₁ → 0 < X₂ → 0 < Y₂ →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ X₁ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Y₁ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ X₂ ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Y₂) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K * X₁^a * Y₁^a * X₂^a * Y₂^a *
        (Ideal.absNorm (R * Ideal.span {w}) : ℝ)^(5*ε)
title: joint_reconstruction_fiber_count

statement:
theorem actual_joint_relative_density {SlotLabel : Type*} [Fintype SlotLabel]
    (η : Character) (ν : SlotLabel → Character) (Q : Ideal O) [NeZero Q]
    (hQtop : Q ≠ ⊤) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hQη : Q ≤ η.modulus) (hQν : ∀ j, Q ≤ (ν j).modulus)
    (hβ : (51/100 : ℝ) ≤ HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
    (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H) (S : Finset (Ideal O))
    (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ Ioi 0) (hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) (hφne : φ ≠ 0)
    (a₀ b₀ B₀ : ℝ) (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (hab₀ : a₀ ≤ b₀) (hB₀ : 0 < B₀)
    (hφs : Function.support φ ⊆ Ioo a₀ b₀) (hφB : ∀ y, φ y ≤ B₀)
    (hβupper : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta ≤ 7/8)
    (loss : ℝ) (hlosspos : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ (A : ℕ) (K : ℝ), 0 < K ∧
      (∀ Y : ℝ, 1 ≤ Y → ∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ F : Finset FreeRow,
        (∀ u ∈ F, rowNorm u ≤ Y ∧
          ∃ (R : JointRelativeLabel η SlotLabel → Ideal O) (hR : ∀ label, R label ≠ 0),
          jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η ν Q hQ72 hQν R hR
            p.lower p.upper p.height ⟨u.val, u.property.1⟩) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss)) ∧
      (∀ p : DensityWindow, ∀ Y : ℝ, 0 < Y →
        ∀ F : Finset ProbePhysical.NonzeroFrequency,
        (∀ u ∈ F, rawFrequencyNorm u ≤ Y ∧
          ∃ (R : JointRelativeLabel η SlotLabel → Ideal O) (hR : ∀ label, R label ≠ 0),
          jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η ν Q hQ72 hQν R hR p.lower p.upper p.height u) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Y^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)+loss))
title: actual_joint_relative_density

statement:
theorem actual_retained_buffered_data
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ profileBound : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < profileBound k) ∧
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (orders : Finset ι → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parentL parentR : JointParentLabel η)
        (NL : NaturalRow parentL.val w.val) (NR : NaturalRow parentR.val w.val)
        (punctureL punctureR : Ideal O) (hpunctureL : punctureL ≠ 0) (hpunctureR : punctureR ≠ 0)
        (s : CommonSecondKernelLabel ι) (Ds : Finset (Ideal O)) (z : O) (t₁ t₂ Z d : ℝ)
        (η₀ : ι → Character) (V : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (alo bhi : ι → ℝ)
        (bin : ℕ) (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ),
      s.input.W₁ = W₁ → s.input.W₂ = W₂ →
      (∀ i, s.input.slots i = primePool M H (bhi i) (s.input.P i)) →
      (∀ i I, s.input.ν i I = idealCoeff (η₀ i).inverse I) → (∀ i, s.input.W i = V i) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight (childCharacter s.parent s.leftRay)
        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1)))
        s.toKernelLabel.frequency z t₁ I =
        rowWeight parentL.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator punctureL) 1 w.val t₁ I) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight (childCharacter s.parent (s.rightRay⁻¹))
        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2)))
        s.toKernelLabel.frequency (-z) t₂ I =
        rowWeight parentR.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator punctureR) 1 w.val t₂ I) →
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 ≤ Rwidth →
      s.input.X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.input.X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      s.input.Y₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.input.Y₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ s.input.P i ∧ s.input.P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded NL.character punctureL) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded NR.character punctureR) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      |t₁|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ → |t₂|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (∀ i, 2*(|Real.log (alo i)|+|Real.log (bhi i)|)+1 ≤ Real.log (s.input.P i)) →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →
      ∀ q ∈ s.liveFullRetainedFiber Ds t₁ t₂ z,
      ∃ DL DR : SurvivingBufferedData η w ι orders profileBound edge e,
        s.fullFiberValue t₁ t₂ z q =
          ‖DL.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖*‖DR.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖ ∧
        d*DL.length ≤ s.fullLeftLength Z q+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        d*DR.length ≤ s.fullRightLength Z q+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        DL.Admissible M H hH η₀ alo bhi Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T ∧
        DR.Admissible M H hH η₀ alo bhi Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T
title: actual_retained_buffered_data

statement:
theorem actual_complete_retained_fiber_mass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (lo hi : ι → ℝ) (Bcap loss : ℝ) (hBcap : 0 ≤ Bcap) (hloss : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (s : CommonSecondKernelLabel ι), (∀ i, s.input.lo i = lo i) →
      (∀ i, s.input.hi i = hi i) →
      ((s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Bcap →
      ((s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Bcap →
      ∀ (Ds : Finset (Ideal O)),
      (∀ L ∈ Ds, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ) ≠ 0 → (L.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^Bcap) →
      ∀ (t₁ t₂ H₁ H₂ a : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < H₁ → 0 < H₂ →
      a*CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume s.input.toData/
        ((s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ H₁ →
      a*CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume s.input.toData/
        ((s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ H₂ →
      s.fullFiberMass Ds t₁ t₂ H₁ H₂ ≤
        C*Z^loss*((secondProfileScalar s.input.toData)^2*commonSourceProfile s.input/a)

            ∑ a ∈ (s.leftData B t₁).toSource.active L,
              ∑ b ∈ (s.rightData F t₂).toSource.active L,
                secondAllocationScalar (s.leftData B t₁) (s.rightData F t₂) L a b)
