statement:
theorem actual_retained_buffered_short_gates
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ profileBound : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < profileBound k) ∧
      ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (orders : Finset ι → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parentL parentR : JointParentLabel η)
        (NL : NaturalRow parentL.val w.val) (NR : NaturalRow parentR.val w.val)
        (punctureL punctureR : Ideal O) (hpunctureL : punctureL ≠ 0) (hpunctureR : punctureR ≠ 0)
        (s : CommonSecondKernelLabel ι) (Ds : Finset (Ideal O)) (z : O) (t₁ t₂ Z d : ℝ)
        (η₀ : ι → Character) (V : ι → ℝ → ℂ) (alo bhi : ι → ℝ)
        (bin : ℕ) (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ),
      s.input.W₁ = W₁ → s.input.W₂ = W₂ →
      (∀ i, s.input.slots i = primePool M H (bhi i) (s.input.P i)) →
      (∀ i I, I ∈ s.input.slots i → s.input.ν i I = idealCoeff (η₀ i).inverse I) → (∀ i, s.input.W i = V i) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight (childCharacter s.parent s.leftRay)
        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1)))
        s.toKernelLabel.frequency z t₁ I =
        rowWeight parentL.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator punctureL) 1 w.val t₁ I) →
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight (childCharacter s.parent (s.rightRay⁻¹))
        (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2)))
        s.toKernelLabel.frequency (-z) t₂ I =
        rowWeight parentR.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator punctureR) 1 w.val t₂ I) →
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 ≤ Rwidth →
      s.input.X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.input.X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      s.input.Y₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → s.input.Y₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ s.input.P i ∧ s.input.P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded NL.character punctureL) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded NR.character punctureR) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      |t₁|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ → |t₂|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →
      ∀ q ∈ s.liveFullRetainedFiber Ds t₁ t₂ z,
      ∃ DL DR : SurvivingBufferedData η w ι orders profileBound edge e,
        s.fullFiberValue t₁ t₂ z q =
          ‖DL.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖*‖DR.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖ ∧
        d*DL.length ≤ s.fullLeftLength Z q+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        d*DR.length ≤ s.fullRightLength Z q+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        DL.ShortSlotGates M H hH η₀ Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T ∧
        DR.ShortSlotGates M H hH η₀ Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T ∧
        (∀ j : DL.slots, (Z^d)^(DL.data.r j) = s.input.P j.val) ∧
        (∀ j : DR.slots, (Z^d)^(DR.data.r j) = s.input.P j.val) ∧
        (∀ j, DL.data.σ j = 0 ∧ DL.data.v j = 0) ∧ DL.data.t = t₁ ∧ DL.data.bin = bin ∧
        (∀ j, DR.data.σ j = 0 ∧ DR.data.v j = 0) ∧ DR.data.t = t₂ ∧ DR.data.bin = bin
title: actual_retained_buffered_short_gates

theorem joint_second_kernel_norm_sum_from_values (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (decay P J₁ J₂ : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {κ : Type*} (labels : Finset κ)
      (s : κ → SecondKernelLabel) (t K R : κ → ℝ) (n : κ → Fin 4 → ℤ)
      (z : κ → O) (weight : κ → ℂ) (E : ℝ),
      (∀ θ u v : ℝ, (∑ k ∈ labels, ‖weight k‖ *
        ‖(s k).leftValue (t k+2*Real.pi*(u-θ)) (z k) (dyadicScale (n k 2))‖ *
        ‖(s k).rightValue (t k+2*Real.pi*(v-(-θ))) (z k) (dyadicScale (n k 3))‖) ≤
          (E*(1+‖θ‖)^P)*(1+‖u‖)^J₁*(1+‖v‖)^J₂) →
      (∑ k ∈ labels, ‖(((1+SecondKernelLabel.kernelScale (n k))^decay : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        weight k * (s k).kernelRow (t k) (z k) W (K k) (R k) (n k)‖) ≤ C*E

theorem joint_second_kernel_from_local_retained_absolute
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (decay : ℕ) (ν B target : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :

        (labels : Finset α) (s : α → CommonSecondKernelLabel ι) (Ds : α → Finset (Ideal O))
        (t K R : α → ℝ) (n : α → Fin 4 → ℤ) (z : α → O) (weight : α → ℂ),
      (∀ k ∈ labels, ‖weight k‖ ≤ 1) → ∀ Z scale Ch Ct : ℝ,

      (∀ θ u v : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖u‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖v‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        secondProjectedJointRetained labels s Ds t n z scale θ u v ≤ Ch*Z^target) →

            ((s k).withProjector L).toKernelLabel.kernelRow
              (t k) (z k) W (K k) (R k) (n k)‖) ≤ C*((Ch+Ct)*Z^target)

statement:
theorem actual_second_scalar_mass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (lo hi : ι → ℝ) (B δ : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ (J K : Finset ι) (s : Data J) (v : Data K),
      (∀ i : J, s.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i : J, s.hi i = hi i) →
      (∀ i : K, v.lo i = lo i) → (∀ i : K, v.hi i = hi i) →
      ∀ Ds : Finset (Ideal O),
      (∀ L ∈ Ds, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ) ≠ 0 → (L.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (∑ L ∈ Ds, ‖(UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ)‖ *
        ∑ a ∈ s.toSource.active L, ∑ b ∈ v.toSource.active L,
          secondAllocationScalar s v L a b) ≤
        C*Z^δ*(secondProfileScalar s*secondProfileScalar v)
title: actual_second_scalar_mass

statement:
theorem rawRow_eq_scaled (s : SecondKernelLabel) (t : ℝ) (z : O)
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K R : ℝ) (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) :
    secondBlockRowPhase s.C s.D s.hC s.hD s.U R z *
      (∑ I : s.LeftIndex, ∑ J : s.RightIndex,
        (secondBlockChildCoefficient s.parent t s.columns s.beta s.C s.hC s.frequency
            s.projector s.leftRay z I *
          star (secondBlockChildCoefficient s.parent t s.columns s.beta s.D s.hD s.frequency
            s.projector (s.rightRay⁻¹) (-z) J)) *
          secondBlockKernel s.C s.D s.U W K n z I J) =
      (Real.sqrt (dyadicScale (n 2)*dyadicScale (n 3)) : ℂ) *
        s.kernelRow t z W K R n
title: rawRow_eq_scaled

statement:
theorem joint_second_projector_kernel_from_cutoff
    (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (decay : ℕ) (ν B target : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (labels : Finset α) (s : α → CommonSecondKernelLabel ι) (Ds : α → Finset (Ideal O))
        (t K R : α → ℝ) (n : α → Fin 4 → ℤ) (z : α → O) (weight : α → ℂ),
      (∀ k ∈ labels, ‖weight k‖ ≤ 1) → ∀ Z scale Ch Ct : ℝ,
      1 ≤ Z → 0 ≤ scale → 0 ≤ Ch → 0 ≤ Ct →
      (∀ θ u v : ℝ, ‖θ‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖u‖ ≤ Z^ν → ‖v‖ ≤ Z^ν →
        secondProjectedJointRetained labels s Ds t n z scale θ u v ≤ Ch*Z^target) →
      (∀ θ u v : ℝ,
        secondProjectedJointRetained labels s Ds t n z scale θ u v ≤ Ct*Z^B) →
      (∑ k ∈ labels, ∑ L ∈ Ds k,
        ‖(((1+SecondKernelLabel.kernelScale (n k))^decay : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius L : ℂ)*((scale : ℂ)*weight k)) *
            ((s k).withProjector L).toKernelLabel.kernelRow
              (t k) (z k) W (K k) (R k) (n k)‖) ≤ C*((Ch+Ct)*Z^target)

statement:
theorem actual_joint_second_allocation_budget {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (lo hi : ι → ℝ) (B δ : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ {α : Type*} (Λ : Finset α) (J L : α → Finset ι)
        (s : ∀ ℓ, Source (J ℓ)) (v : ∀ ℓ, Source (L ℓ)),
      (∀ ℓ, ∀ i : J ℓ, (s ℓ).lo i = lo i) →
      (∀ ℓ, ∀ i : J ℓ, (s ℓ).hi i = hi i) →
      (∀ ℓ, ∀ i : L ℓ, (v ℓ).lo i = lo i) →
      (∀ ℓ, ∀ i : L ℓ, (v ℓ).hi i = hi i) →
      ∀ Ds : α → Finset (Ideal O),
      (∀ ℓ ∈ Λ, ∀ D ∈ Ds ℓ, (moebius D : ℂ) ≠ 0 → (D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      ∀ E₁ E₂ : α → ℝ, (∀ ℓ, 0 ≤ E₁ ℓ) → (∀ ℓ, 0 ≤ E₂ ℓ) →
      (∑ ℓ ∈ Λ, (∑ D ∈ Ds ℓ, ‖(moebius D : ℂ)‖ *
        ∑ a ∈ (s ℓ).active D, ∑ b ∈ (v ℓ).active D,
          1 / Real.sqrt (formalReductionFactor D a (s ℓ).P *
            formalReductionFactor D b (v ℓ).P)) *
        (Real.sqrt (E₁ ℓ) * Real.sqrt (E₂ ℓ))) ≤
        C*Z^δ*(Real.sqrt (∑ ℓ ∈ Λ, E₁ ℓ) * Real.sqrt (∑ ℓ ∈ Λ, E₂ ℓ))
title: actual_joint_second_allocation_budget

theorem actual_joint_second_envelope_budget (B δ : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ {α ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (Λ : Finset α) (s : α → Input ι)
        (C D : α → Ideal O) (hD : ∀ ℓ, Supported (D ℓ))
        (S : α → Finset (Ideal O)) (Hsource : α → ℝ),
      (∀ ℓ ∈ Λ, Hsource ℓ/((D ℓ).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      ∀ (Ce : ℝ) (J₁ J₂ : ℕ) (t : α → ℝ)
        (E₁ E₂ : α → Ideal O → ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : ℝ),
      (∀ L ∈ jointSecondProjectors Λ D hD S Hsource,
        jointSecondWindowEnergy Λ D hD S Hsource J₁ t
          (fun ℓ L => core (s ℓ) (C ℓ) Ce Z δ (E₁ ℓ L)) L ≤ F₁) →
      (∀ L ∈ jointSecondProjectors Λ D hD S Hsource,
        jointSecondWindowEnergy Λ D hD S Hsource J₂ t
          (fun ℓ L => core (s ℓ) (D ℓ) Ce Z δ (E₂ ℓ L)) L ≤ F₂) →
      (∑ ℓ ∈ Λ, ∑ L ∈ liveSecondProjectors (D ℓ) (hD ℓ) (S ℓ) (Hsource ℓ),
        ‖(moebius L : ℂ)‖ *
          (windowBudget J₁ (t ℓ) (envelope (s ℓ) (C ℓ) L Ce Z δ (E₁ ℓ L)) *
            windowBudget J₂ (t ℓ) (envelope (s ℓ) (D ℓ) L Ce Z δ (E₂ ℓ L)))) ≤
        K*Z^δ*(Real.sqrt F₁*Real.sqrt F₂)

statement:
theorem joint_second_projector_budget (B δ : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ {α : Type*} (Λ : Finset α) (D : α → Ideal O) (hD : ∀ ℓ, Supported (D ℓ))
        (S : α → Finset (Ideal O)) (Hsource : α → ℝ),
      (∀ ℓ ∈ Λ, Hsource ℓ/((D ℓ).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      ∀ (J₁ J₂ : ℕ) (t : α → ℝ) (E₁ E₂ : α → Ideal O → ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : ℝ),
      (∀ L ∈ jointSecondProjectors Λ D hD S Hsource,
        jointSecondWindowEnergy Λ D hD S Hsource J₁ t E₁ L ≤ F₁) →
      (∀ L ∈ jointSecondProjectors Λ D hD S Hsource,
        jointSecondWindowEnergy Λ D hD S Hsource J₂ t E₂ L ≤ F₂) →
      (∑ ℓ ∈ Λ, ∑ L ∈ liveSecondProjectors (D ℓ) (hD ℓ) (S ℓ) (Hsource ℓ),
        ‖(moebius L : ℂ)‖ *
          (windowBudget J₁ (t ℓ) (E₁ ℓ L/(L.absNorm : ℝ)) *
            windowBudget J₂ (t ℓ) (E₂ ℓ L/(L.absNorm : ℝ)))) ≤
        C*Z^δ*(Real.sqrt F₁*Real.sqrt F₂)
title: joint_second_projector_budget

theorem uniform_second_width_sector_count (B e : ℝ) (he : 0 < e) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ {Row Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
      (labels : Finset Row) (s : Row → CommonSecondKernelLabel Slot) (Z : ℝ), 1 < Z →
      (∀ u ∈ labels, (s u).second.val.1.absNorm ≤ (Z^B : ℝ) ∧
        (s u).second.val.2.absNorm ≤ (Z^B : ℝ)) →
      ∃ bin : (u : Row) → u ∈ labels → (Fin 4 → Fin (N+1)),
        ∀ u hu j, 0 ≤ secondWidthEdge e (bin u hu) j ∧
          secondWidthEdge e (bin u hu) j ≤ (s u).secondWidthCoordinates Z j ∧
          (s u).secondWidthCoordinates Z j < secondWidthEdge e (bin u hu) j+e
title: uniform_second_width_sector_count

statement:
theorem actual_source_allocated_admissible
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ C : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < C k) ∧
      ∀ {ι Slot : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype Slot] [DecidableEq Slot]
        (f : ι ↪ Slot) (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η)
        (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val) (puncture : Ideal O) (hpuncture : puncture ≠ 0)
        (source : Character) (m A z : O) (t : ℝ),
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight source m A z t I =
        rowWeight parent.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator puncture) 1 w.val t I) →
      ∀ (D : Ideal O) (allocation : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset (ι ⊕ Fin 2)))
        (Z d X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ)
        (alo bhi : Slot → ℝ) (P : ι → ℝ) (bin : ℕ)
        (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ),
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 < X₁ → 0 < X₂ → 0 ≤ Rwidth →
      X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ P i ∧ P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded N.character puncture) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      |t|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (∀ i : liveIndices D allocation,
        2*(|Real.log (alo (f i.val))|+|Real.log (bhi (f i.val))|)+1 ≤ Real.log (P i.val)) →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →
      allocatedPositiveRow source m A z t (fun i => primePool M H (bhi (f i)) (P i))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (η₀ (f i)).inverse I*V (f i) ((I.absNorm : ℝ)/P i)) P
        D allocation W₁ W₂ X₁ X₂ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ data : SurvivingBufferedData η w Slot orders C edge e,
        data.slots = embeddedSlots (allocationSlotEmbedding f D allocation) ∧
        ‖allocatedPositiveRow source m A z t (fun i => primePool M H (bhi (f i)) (P i))
          (fun i I => idealCoeff (η₀ (f i)).inverse I*V (f i) ((I.absNorm : ℝ)/P i)) P
          D allocation W₁ W₂ X₁ X₂‖ = ‖data.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖ ∧
        d*data.length ≤ Real.logb Z (X₁*X₂*∏ i, P i)-
          Real.logb Z (formalReductionFactor D allocation P)+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        data.Admissible M H hH η₀ alo bhi Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T
title: actual_source_allocated_admissible

theorem actual_physicalBlock_exceptional_bin_partition {Slot κ : Type*}
    [Fintype Slot] [Fintype κ] {η : Character}
    (F : FirstSidePresentation η) (s : CommonSecondKernelLabel Slot)
    (hs : s.parent = F.sourceParent) (bin : NonzeroElement → Option κ)
    (Q : Ideal O) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)})
    (hbin : ∀ w, bin w = none ↔ FixedInducingRow η Q fixedBadMask 1 w.val)
    (χ : RayCharacter) (m : O) (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (hmLam : goodLambda ∣ m) (hm2 : (2 : O) ∣ m)
    (t : ℝ) (S : Finset (Ideal O)) (β : Ideal O → ℂ)
    (R : ℝ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K : ℝ) (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) :
    physicalBlock s.parent t S β s.second.val.1 s.second.val.2
      s.toKernelLabel.hC s.toKernelLabel.hD s.partition R
      (sourceRows s.second.val.1 s.second.val.2 s.partition R) W K n =
    physicalBlock s.parent t S β s.second.val.1 s.second.val.2
      s.toKernelLabel.hC s.toKernelLabel.hD s.partition R
      (partRows true s.parent χ Q m s.second.val.1 s.second.val.2 s.partition R) W K n +
    ∑ b : κ, physicalBlock s.parent t S β s.second.val.1 s.second.val.2
      s.toKernelLabel.hC s.toKernelLabel.hD s.partition R
      ((sourceRows s.second.val.1 s.second.val.2 s.partition R).filter
        (fun z => F.sourceBin s bin z = some b)) W K n

theorem physicalBlock_complete_bin_partition {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (η : Character) (t : ℝ) (S : Finset (Ideal O)) (β : Ideal O → ℂ)
    (C D : Ideal O) (hC : Supported C) (hD : Supported D)
    (U : Finset (CommonIndex C D)) (R : ℝ) (rows : Finset O)
    (bin : O → Option κ) (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (K : ℝ) (n : Fin 4 → ℤ) :
    physicalBlock η t S β C D hC hD U R rows W K n =
      physicalBlock η t S β C D hC hD U R (rows.filter (fun z => bin z = none)) W K n +
      ∑ b : κ, physicalBlock η t S β C D hC hD U R
        (rows.filter (fun z => bin z = some b)) W K n
title: physicalBlock_complete_bin_partition

theorem actual_source_allocated_buffered
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)

    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ C : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < C k) ∧
      ∀ {ι Slot : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype Slot] [DecidableEq Slot]
        (f : ι ↪ Slot) (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η)
        (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val) (puncture : Ideal O) (hpuncture : puncture ≠ 0)
        (source : Character) (m A z : O) (t : ℝ),
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight source m A z t I =
        rowWeight parent.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator puncture) 1 w.val t I) →
      ∀ (D : Ideal O) (allocation : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset (ι ⊕ Fin 2)))
        (Z d X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ)
        (b : Slot → ℝ) (P : ι → ℝ) (bin : ℕ),
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 < X₁ → 0 < X₂ → (∀ i, 0 < P i) →
      allocatedPositiveRow source m A z t (fun i => primePool M H (b (f i)) (P i))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (η₀ (f i)).inverse I*V (f i) ((I.absNorm : ℝ)/P i)) P
        D allocation W₁ W₂ X₁ X₂ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ P₁ P₂ : BufferedPlainProfile
          (orders (embeddedSlots (allocationSlotEmbedding f D allocation))) C edge e,
        P₁.W = dilated W₁ (clipDilation (X₁/(Ideal.absNorm (selectedPlain D allocation 0) : ℝ))) ∧
        P₂.W = dilated W₂ (clipDilation (X₂/(Ideal.absNorm (selectedPlain D allocation 1) : ℝ))) ∧
        P₁.σ = 0 ∧ P₂.σ = 0 ∧ P₁.freq = t ∧ P₂.freq = t ∧
        let data

theorem PhysicalNaturalPair.inducing_iff {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot]
    {η : Character} {w : NonzeroElement} {s : CommonSecondKernelLabel Slot}
    {z : O} {TL TR : Ideal O} (P : PhysicalNaturalPair η w s z TL TR)
    (Q : Ideal O) (hQ72 : Q ≤ Ideal.span {(72 : O)}) :
    (FixedInducingRow (childCharacter s.parent s.leftRay) Q
      (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.1)))
      s.toKernelLabel.frequency z ↔ FixedInducingRow η Q fixedBadMask 1 w.val) ∧
    (FixedInducingRow (childCharacter s.parent (s.rightRay⁻¹)) Q
      (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator (s.puncture*(s.firstCommon*s.second.val.2)))
      s.toKernelLabel.frequency (-z) ↔ FixedInducingRow η Q fixedBadMask 1 w.val)
title: PhysicalNaturalPair.inducing_iff

statement:
theorem second_projected_absolute_physical_power
    {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset α) (s : α → CommonSecondKernelLabel ι) (Ds : α → Finset (Ideal O))
    (n : α → Fin 4 → ℤ) (Z scale A B C N V B₁ B₂ a : ℝ)
    (hZ : 0 < Z) (hscale : 0 ≤ scale) (hscale' : scale ≤ Z^A)
    (hcard : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ Z^B)
    (hB₁ : 0 ≤ B₁) (hB₂ : 0 ≤ B₂) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hplain : ∀ v ∈ S, (s v).input.W₁ 0 = 0 ∧ (s v).input.W₂ 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ x, ‖(s v).input.W₁ x‖ ≤ B₁) ∧ (∀ x, ‖(s v).input.W₂ x‖ ≤ B₂))
    (hvolume : ∀ v ∈ S, CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume (s v).input.toData ≤ Z^V)
    (hprojectors : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ D ∈ Ds v, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius D : ℂ) ≠ 0 →
      (D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^C)
    (hcommon : ∀ v ∈ S, (((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.1).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^N ∧
      (((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.2).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^N)
    (hphysical : ∀ v ∈ S,
      0 < dyadicScale (n v 2) ∧ 0 < dyadicScale (n v 3) ∧
      a*CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume (s v).input.toData/
        (((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.1).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ dyadicScale (n v 2) ∧
      a*CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume (s v).input.toData/
        (((s v).firstCommon*(s v).second.val.2).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ dyadicScale (n v 3)) :
    secondProjectedAbsoluteEnvelope S s Ds n scale ≤
      (128/a*(originalAbsoluteEnvelope S s B₁ B₂)^2)*Z^(A+B+C+N+V)
title: second_projected_absolute_physical_power

statement:
theorem actual_joint_natural_population (B loss : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hloss : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ (A : ℕ) (K : ℝ), 0 < K ∧
      ∀ (Z P W : ℝ), 1 < Z → P ≤ B → W ≤ B →
      ∀ (p : DensityWindow) (unit : JointReconstructionLabel → Oˣ)
        (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel)
        (R : JointReconstructionLabel → JointRelativeLabel η SlotLabel → Ideal O)
        (hR : ∀ v label, R v label ≠ 0),
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧
        primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ∃ hw : v.row (unit v) ≠ 0,
        jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η ν Q hQ72 hQν (R v) (hR v)
          p.lower p.upper p.height ⟨v.row (unit v),hw⟩) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →

theorem eventually_source_row_geometry (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop, 1 < Z ∧
      ∀ {Slot : Type*} [Fintype Slot] (s : OriginalData Slot) (side : Bool)
        (q : ActualJointSourceRow s side) (η : Character) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : RayCharacter) (hz : q.z ≠ 0)
        (A c d R e M a ω L H εH εE ξ K W : ℝ),
      0 ≤ H → H ≤ Z^(A+εH) → Z^c ≤ (q.label.C₁.absNorm : ℝ) →
      normValue (primeSubsetGenerator
        (fun P : CommonIndex q.label.C₁ q.label.D₁ => P.val) q.label.E) ≤ Z^(e+εE) →
      normValue (leftEffectiveFactor q.label.C₁ q.label.D₁) ≤ Z^L →
      Z^(2*A-c-d+R+e-M+max (d-c) 0+6*a+ω) ≤ K →
      M-R-max (c-d) 0+L-6*a-ω+2*εH+εE+ξ/2+ε ≤ W →
      ∀ rows : Finset O, q.z ∈ liveRows q.second.val.1 q.second.val.2 q.U
        (frequencyRadius ((H/(q.label.C₁.absNorm : ℝ))^2/K) Z ξ) rows →
      ((Ideal.span {(q.reconstructed η ξ₁ ξ₂ hz).val}).absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^W

statement:
theorem actual_source_allocated_short_gates
    (W₁ W₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (ha₂ : 0 < a₂)
    (hs₁ : Function.support W₁ ⊆ Icc a₁ b₁) (hW₁ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₁)
    (hs₂ : Function.support W₂ ⊆ Icc a₂ b₂) (hW₂ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W₂) :
    ∃ C : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 < C k) ∧
      ∀ {ι Slot : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype Slot] [DecidableEq Slot]
        (f : ι ↪ Slot) (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (edge e : ℝ), edge ≤ 1 → e ≤ 1/1000 →
      ∀ (M : Ideal O) [NeZero M] (H : Subgroup (O ⧸ M)ˣ)
        (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M ≤ H)
        (η : Character) (w : NonzeroElement) (parent : JointParentLabel η)
        (N : NaturalRow parent.val w.val) (puncture : Ideal O) (hpuncture : puncture ≠ 0)
        (source : Character) (m A z : O) (t : ℝ),
      (∀ I : Ideal O, rowWeight source m A z t I =
        rowWeight parent.val (fixedBadMask*idealGenerator puncture) 1 w.val t I) →
      ∀ (D : Ideal O) (allocation : Allocation D (Finset.univ : Finset (ι ⊕ Fin 2)))
        (Z d X₁ X₂ : ℝ) (η₀ : Slot → Character) (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ)
        (alo bhi : Slot → ℝ) (P : ι → ℝ) (Pfull : Slot → ℝ) (bin : ℕ)
        (Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax T : ℝ),
      (∀ i, P i = Pfull (f i)) →
      1 < Z → d ≠ 0 → 1 < Z^d → 0 < X₁ → 0 < X₂ → 0 ≤ Rwidth →
      X₁ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth → X₂ ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ P i ∧ P i ≤ (Z^d)^Rwidth) → σmin ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ σmax →
      (∀ label, (bufferedProductFamily M H hH η₀
        (excluded N.character puncture) label).modulus.absNorm ≤ Z^d) →
      |t|+Z^τ/2 ≤ (3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^4 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      (3+(3*bin+2 : ℕ)*Z^τ)^2 ≤ (Z^d)^ηaux →
      3*(bin+1 : ℕ)*Z^τ ≤ T →
      allocatedPositiveRow source m A z t (fun i => primePool M H (bhi (f i)) (P i))
        (fun i I => idealCoeff (η₀ (f i)).inverse I*V (f i) ((I.absNorm : ℝ)/P i)) P
        D allocation W₁ W₂ X₁ X₂ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ data : SurvivingBufferedData η w Slot orders C edge e,
        data.slots = embeddedSlots (allocationSlotEmbedding f D allocation) ∧
        ‖allocatedPositiveRow source m A z t (fun i => primePool M H (bhi (f i)) (P i))
          (fun i I => idealCoeff (η₀ (f i)).inverse I*V (f i) ((I.absNorm : ℝ)/P i)) P
          D allocation W₁ W₂ X₁ X₂‖ = ‖data.value M H η₀ V bhi Z d‖ ∧
        d*data.length ≤ Real.logb Z (X₁*X₂*∏ i, P i)-
          Real.logb Z (formalReductionFactor D allocation P)+Real.logb Z (max 1 b₁*max 1 b₂) ∧
        data.ShortSlotGates M H hH η₀ Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d T ∧
        (∀ j : data.slots, (Z^d)^(data.data.r j) = Pfull j.val) ∧
        (∀ j, data.data.σ j = 0 ∧ data.data.v j = 0) ∧ data.data.t = t ∧ data.data.bin = bin
title: actual_source_allocated_short_gates

theorem second_projected_absolute_input_power
    {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset α) (s : α → CommonSecondKernelLabel ι) (Ds : α → Finset (Ideal O))
    (n : α → Fin 4 → ℤ) (Z scale A B C F V B₁ B₂ : ℝ)
    (hZ : 0 < Z) (hscale : 0 ≤ scale) (hscale' : scale ≤ Z^A)
    (hcard : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ Z^B)
    (hB₁ : 0 ≤ B₁) (hB₂ : 0 ≤ B₂)
    (hplain : ∀ v ∈ S, (s v).input.W₁ 0 = 0 ∧ (s v).input.W₂ 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ x, ‖(s v).input.W₁ x‖ ≤ B₁) ∧ (∀ x, ‖(s v).input.W₂ x‖ ≤ B₂))
    (hvolume : ∀ v ∈ S, CenteredMomentExceptionalAmplitudePair.volume (s v).input.toData ≤ Z^V)
    (hprojectors : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ D ∈ Ds v, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius D : ℂ) ≠ 0 →
      (D.absNorm : ℝ) ≤ Z^C)
    (hdyad : ∀ v ∈ S, (Real.sqrt (dyadicScale (n v 2)))⁻¹ ≤ Z^F ∧
      (Real.sqrt (dyadicScale (n v 3)))⁻¹ ≤ Z^F) :
    secondProjectedAbsoluteEnvelope S s Ds n scale ≤
      (128*(originalAbsoluteEnvelope S s B₁ B₂)^2)*Z^(A+B+C+2*F+2*V)
title: second_projected_absolute_input_power

statement:
theorem actual_joint_surviving_high_product
    (V : Slot → ℝ → ℂ) (Aprofile Bprofile : Slot → ℝ) (hA : ∀ j, 0 < Aprofile j)
    (hVs : ∀ j, Function.support (V j) ⊆ Icc (Aprofile j) (Bprofile j))
    (hV : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V j))
    (Rwidth dmax ε e κ ηaux σmin σmax productLoss populationLoss loss B : ℝ)
    (hRw : 0 ≤ Rwidth) (hdmax : 0 ≤ dmax) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (he : 0 < e) (he' : e < 1/1000) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκone : κ ≤ 1) (hη : 0 ≤ ηaux)
    (hbudget : 12*e*(Rwidth+2)+8*κ+2*ηaux ≤ ε)
    (hprimebudget : 8*e*Rwidth+κ ≤ ε)
    (hproductLoss : (2+2*(Fintype.card Slot : ℝ))*ε ≤ productLoss)
    (hpopulationLoss : 0 < populationLoss) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hloss : populationLoss+dmax*productLoss ≤ loss)
    (profileBound : ℕ → ℝ) (hprofile : ∀ k, 0 ≤ profileBound k) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
    ∃ (orders : Finset Slot → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (C : ℝ), (∀ I, orders I ≤ N) ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (Z d P W : ℝ), 1 < Z → 0 ≤ d → d ≤ dmax → 2 ≤ Z^d → 2 < Z^τ →
      P ≤ B → W ≤ B →
      ∀ (p : DensityWindow), p.upper < p.lower+2*e →
      ∀ (unit : JointReconstructionLabel → Oˣ) (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel)
        (w : JointReconstructionLabel → NonzeroElement),
      (∀ v ∈ S, (w v).val = v.row (unit v)) →
      ∀ (R : JointReconstructionLabel →
        JointRelativeLabel η (Option (Slot × RayQuotient.Characters M H)) → Ideal O)
        (hR : ∀ v label, R v label ≠ 0),
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧
        primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, jointRelativeSourceZeroBin η (relativeSlotTranslate M H hH η₀) Q hQ72
        (relativeSlotTranslate_fixedQ M H hH η₀ Q hQM hQη₀) (R v) (hR v)
        p.lower p.upper p.height (w v)) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {(w v).val}) : ℝ) ≤ Z^W) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (jointMissingRadical v.C₁ (w v).val) : ℝ) ≤ Z^P) →
      ∀ (DL DR : ∀ v, SurvivingBufferedData η (w v) Slot orders profileBound p.lower e),
      (∀ v ∈ S, (DL v).Admissible M H hH η₀ Aprofile Bprofile
        Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d p.height) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (DR v).Admissible M H hH η₀ Aprofile Bprofile
        Rwidth τ ηaux σmin σmax Z d p.height) →
      ∀ A c c₂ d₂ b₂ : ℝ, 2*b₂ = c₂+d₂ →
      (∀ v ∈ S, d*(DL v).length ≤ A-c-c₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, d*(DR v).length ≤ A-c-d₂) →
      (∑ v ∈ S, ‖(DL v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖ *
        ‖(DR v).value M H η₀ V Bprofile Z d‖) ≤
        C*(1+|p.height|)^J *
          Z^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)*W+P+(2*p.lower-1)*(A-c-b₂)+loss)

theorem actual_joint_variable_unit_population (B loss : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hloss : 0 < loss) :
    ∃ (A : ℕ) (K : ℝ), 0 < K ∧
      ∀ (Z P W : ℝ), 1 ≤ Z → 0 ≤ P → P ≤ B → 0 ≤ W → W ≤ B →
      ∀ (p : DensityWindow) (unit : JointReconstructionLabel → Oˣ)
        (S : Finset JointReconstructionLabel),
      (∀ v ∈ S, Supported v.C₁ ∧ Supported v.D₁ ∧ Supported v.C₂ ∧ Supported v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, primeSupport v.C₁ = primeSupport v.D₁ ∧
        primeSupport v.C₂ = primeSupport v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, Squarefree v.L ∧ v.L ∣ v.C₂ ∧ v.L ∣ v.D₂) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, ∃ hw : v.row (unit v) ≠ 0, rawZeroBin (fun j => momentData (η j))
        p.lower p.upper p.height ⟨v.row (unit v), hw⟩) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm v.C₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.D₁ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧
        (Ideal.absNorm v.C₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B ∧ (Ideal.absNorm v.D₂ : ℝ) ≤ Z^B) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (Ideal.span {v.row (unit v)}) : ℝ) ≤ Z^W) →
      (∀ v ∈ S, (Ideal.absNorm (jointMissingRadical v.C₁ (v.row (unit v))) : ℝ) ≤ Z^P) →
      (S.card : ℝ) ≤ K*(1+|p.height|)^A*Z^(unmarkedDensity (2*p.lower-1)*W+P+loss)

statement:
theorem exists_joint_fiber_maximizers
    (labels : Finset α) (fiber : (a : α) → Finset (β a))
    (weight value : (a : α) → β a → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hweight : ∀ a ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber a, 0 ≤ weight a b)
    (hvalue : ∀ a ∈ labels, ∀ b ∈ fiber a, 0 ≤ value a b)
    (hmass : ∀ a ∈ labels, (∑ b ∈ fiber a, weight a b) ≤ B) :
    ∃ pick : (a : liveFiberLabels labels fiber) → β a,
      (∀ a : liveFiberLabels labels fiber, pick a ∈ fiber a) ∧
      (∀ a : liveFiberLabels labels fiber, ∀ b ∈ fiber a, value a b ≤ value a (pick a)) ∧
      (∑ a ∈ labels, ∑ b ∈ fiber a, weight a b*value a b) ≤
        B*(∑ a : liveFiberLabels labels fiber, value a (pick a))
title: exists_joint_fiber_maximizers
